title: Dial 1975
overview: In 1975, India was declared in a state of emergency. This movie tells a story of that year and how the first mobile phone arrived to India.

title: Strawberry Fields Forever
overview: The year-round residents in a lakeside campsite have to leave because of a sale.

title: Enola Holmes 3
overview: Adventure follows detective Enola Holmes to Malta, where her plans to tie the knot unravel when Sherlock's disappearance plunges her into a perilous case.

title: Veranda
overview: After the sudden death of her husband, Ha-yeon is left in shock and quietly tries to return to everyday life. But an unexpected threatening phone call makes her feel that she is being watched. In a state of anxiety and isolation, Ha-yeon gradually finds comfort in Hyun-woo, the neighbor who lives upstairs. As details surrounding her husband's death begin to surface, she is drawn into an increasingly complex web of secrets and suspicion.

title: Miss Mermaid
overview: Freshly divorced, Fanny, a thirty-something from Fécamp, has nothing left of her marriage but a sky-blue sofa, debts she refuses to pay, and an absolute determination never to 'start her life' with a man again. Despite her burning need for freedom, this cleaning lady finds herself stuck back at her parents' house.  That is, until the day she crosses paths with Anemone, a professional mermaid passing through the region. She decides to take the plunge and dive into the world of mermaiding.

title: The Second Child
overview: After three years of coma, Su-an wakes up to find the ghost of her dead sister asking for help but cannot understand what exactly she requires. Their mother, Geum-ok, believed to have lost her firstborn child to suicide, searches for the truth behind the death as a centuries-old family curse slowly reveals itself. As the two collide in a quest to discover the past and present reality, they come across Jae-in, an exact look-alike of the deceased sister.

title: Playground
overview: A lonely teenage girl joins a school for promising killers and trains hard to become an professional assassin as she uncovers the mysteries of her parents' death.

title: François.e
overview: A struggling screenwriter falsely claims to be transgender to get funding.

title: The Social Distance
overview: In an attempt to make the most of their limited fun during the summer of the  Covid-19 lockdown, a science nerd and her boy-crazy best friend decide to build  a spaceship to escape the quarantine before the summer ends and they start at  different highschools, but as the lift-off draws near, they find that building a  rocket may prove easier than maintaining their friendship.

title: Sylvia
overview: Sylvia is waiting for her life to begin, withering under the weight of her hypochondriac mother until a stranger comes into her world and changes everything.

title: The Crucian
overview: Born never to cry, Fish seeks his missing mother through the underworld. He believes her ghost is imprisoned within a deity puppet — yet, it conceals neither his mother nor an informant, but a survivor. Through the puppet’s mouth, the seaside street’s buried past unfolds.

title: Living Corpse
overview: Yosuke Shinkai is haunted by a past he cannot recall - and a body that is rapidly decomposing. He is a living corpse, unclear who he is or why he has been brought back to life only to suffer again a slow gruesome death. Based on the 1986 horror manga by Hideshi Hino.

title: No Volveré
overview: A lonely ventriloquist is served divorce papers at the showroom bar where he works. Things take a strange turn when he tries to remedy the situation with his puppet, Luis.

title: The Big Ashtray
overview: In a closed room, a man prepares for the arrival of an unknown figure who brings eternal rapture.

title: Life Coach
overview: A lonely Muay Thai instructor (Mark Bale) seeks self-confidence through an online life-coaching app, gradually surrendering control to an unseen mentor.

title: 'Mr. Paradise'
overview: Rejected by the person he changed for, Tyler Terry, a picture-perfect boy must become who he truly is after losing himself to being someone else's paradise.

title: Heathen
overview: A young priest's faith is tested when his mentor returns from a mystical encounter.

title: Polymer
overview: A cuck smokes a cigarette backwards while a failed rapper reminisces on his downfall. They come to realize a startling existential truth.

title: Unification of Japan 75
overview: Kyowakai acting chairman Baba (Akihiko Kuwata) is attacked, and despite Himuro (Yasukaze Motomiya) and Tamura (Yoshiyuki Yamaguchi) rushing to the scene, the assailant escapes. The Keihin Alliance and Marugami-kai suspect Hirakawa (Hitomi Matsuda), who had poor relations with Baba, but based on witness Reiko’s (Reira Arai) description of the attacker, Himuro identifies a likely suspect. Ordering Reiko to stay silent and refusing police involvement, Kyowakai launches its own manhunt. As Baba remains in critical condition and suspicion toward Hirakawa grows among investigators and Kyowakai executives, Himuro quietly burns with thoughts of revenge.

title: RUNTME
overview: Cybersecurity lead Jordan Miller discovered something at work that he can't ignore, armed with a stolen USB drive, can he put things right before it's too late?

title: Drifters
overview: In an attempt to escape their problems, three struggling college students take an impromptu trip to Japan. As they aimlessly roam this foreign country, the struggles of everyday life, and their lives back home, begin to resurface.

title: Uprising Smoke
overview: A film director. A protest against the 6x1 work schedule. And there is always this guiding, meditative voice that controls the impulse to revolt, that isolates, atomizes the being. In this confusion, it's necessary to choose a side - or at least be aware of the side chosen. There is no not choosing.

title: EROS
overview: Beatriz is trapped in a vicious cycle where she doesn’t feel seen. All of that changes once she meets Sofia.

title: Blood and Filth
overview: A wild Israeli horror-comedy, with neither boundaries nor responsibility, combining  a dysfunctional family, demons, murders, a dark legend and a lot of chaos.

title: Colors
overview: Different colors moving into harmony of Children's Corner, L. 113: IV. The snow Is dancing.

title: Burnt Ends
overview: Ten filmmakers were tasked with making surreal short film segments that loosely involve a cigarette. The result is Lynchian chaos in anthology form - the good ends, the bad ends, the loose ends, and the burnt ends. A sprawling anthology about all things cigarettes.

title: We shouldn't be at Sea
overview: Four rescuers and a migrant person find themselves in the immense and unpredictable heart of the Mediterranean.  Vanessa, Sheila, Denny and Max tell the story of a continuous human condition, impossible to deny.

title: Window.Water.Raining.Moving.Landscape.
overview: A juxtaposition of rainy landscapes.

title: Fuera de Lugar: Lo que se esconde detrás del campo
late quietus
overview: the woods are wordless, the eye is magic. night becomes spiral dancers

title: DOG TALK
overview: Two dog owners have an uncomfortable encounter at their local dog park.

title: Vidas Enredadas
overview: When his estranged son returns to confront him with the remnants of the past, an elderly deaf fisherman retreats into silence. However, a final memory forgotten at the bottom of a box calls into question what he believed to have been a sacrifice for his family.

title: Ślady głosów. Tereny nagrań Rafała Kołackiego
Pity & Fear
overview: Conrad's friends stage an intervention the night of his going away party.

title: Pine Hollow
overview: …After uncovering a hidden clue tied to a local treasure, a group of teens embark on a treasure hunt through an unforgiving forest, where each discovery brings them closer to the truth and farther from the lives they knew.

title: Opus Magnum
overview: Two estranged brothers must learn to work together while clearing out their late grandfather's overgrown garden to earn their inheritance, only to discover the reward isn't nearly as impressive as they expected.

title: While the Rain Falls
overview: When a rainstorm forces a young IT technician to stay longer than expected at an elderly woman's house, a routine service call turns into an afternoon of shared memories, unexpected conversations, and a meaningful connection between two generations.

title: Redacted
overview: Clocking in at a gripping one hour, this dark-comedy horror experience throws audiences headfirst into chaos, following Detective Leslie Morose as he investigates six chilling unsolved cases completely oblivious to the terrifying presence stalking him within his own office. As the mysteries spiral from ritualistic cults to alien parasites to sinister folklore creatures, one thing becomes clear: the real horror is not just in the files… it is already inside the room.

title: ESPECTRO
overview: As her mother's Alzheimer's progresses, Maria Rita struggles with the growing weight of becoming her sole caregiver.

title: My Irish Goodbye
overview: Follows a young girl appreciating her surroundings in her final moments before taking her life.

title: Célosia
overview: A grieving man visits his wife's grave, where a mysterious woman hands him an envelope. He soon finds himself immersed in memories of the past, haunted by the strange stranger he met at the cemetery.

title: Eagles Become Doves
overview: A party, but its not what he expects.

title: Eternal Disco - The Greatest Hits
overview: ABBA, Michael Jackson, Boney M., Chic, Edwin Starr, Lio and Gloria Gaynor: the biggest stars of the 1970s and 1980s took turns appearing on the German TV programme “Musikladen”.  Here’s a selection of these cult moments to let loose to classic disco hits!

title: YMCA - Die Erfindung der Village People
They Took My Daugther
overview: When her daughter goes missing and kidnapped into a world of high-class corruption - a dishonorably discharged mom stops at nothing to find her.

title: Laruan
overview: Ines reenacts her sister's wartime abduction through a game of dolls, only to discover that some games are really just memories wearing a disguise.

title: Jerry
overview: Two roommates pet sit their neighbor's bearded dragon when an honest mistake turns deadly.

title: Action
overview: When two actors—Luke and Carlo— meet for their last chemistry read, their relationship is changed by the masks they put on, and the scripts they play out.

title: Whirlwind
overview: On the outskirts of town, in a small house beneath a hill, Bela lives in the quiet rhythm of her daily household routines. After hanging laundry, she is approached by Nada, a Roma girl, who tells her fortune from the coffee grounds. Guided by this small sign, Bela spends the rest of the day awaiting her son. When she learns that he will not come, silence settles back into the house. In that silence, Bela turns inward, where she begins to feel the presence of her late husband return.

title: rutina.
overview: After making plans to meet later that evening, four friends spend the day caught in a chain of bizarre and unexpected events. A dark comedy exploring perspective, absurdity and the strange ways people experience misfortune.

title: Orange Justice
overview: Two bumbling but well-meaning NYPD cops on suspension, Murph and Taylor, are tasked with escorting a disinterested Gen Alpha teen, Lacey, to meet her estranged father in Canada.

title: Weez-MUTATION
overview: The story of how world-famous band, Dudd, got their powers.

title: De Marker presenteert: Missie Flotilla
overview: The Global Sumud Flotilla sailed towards Gaza, and we provided independent coverage. Gijs Sanders, along with cameraman Diederick Groenewoud, was the first Dutch journalist to board. Until the Israeli army intercepted the fleet.  More than 1,000 activists headed for Gaza on 75 boats. The goal: to break the Israeli naval blockade to deliver aid to the permanent population in Gaza. Previous attempts were intercepted, the passengers arrested, detained in Israel, and deported. Like in October 2025, when the Israeli army intercepted about 40 boats from the Global Sumud Flotilla and arrested more than 450 participants, including climate activist Greta Thunberg.  In April 2026, another aid fleet departed for Gaza. It became the largest Flotilla mission ever. A number of participants went along for a second time. We ask them: why would you go?

title: Alpha
overview: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

title: Silent Friend
overview: In the heart of a botanical garden in a medieval university town in Germany stands a majestic ginkgo tree. This silent witness has observed over a century the quiet rhythms of transformation across three human lives. At three distinct moments across the 20th and 21st centuries, these people — each carrying their own questions and inner struggles — inevitably find themselves drawn into the presence of this tree, full of mystery and meaning.

title: Sima's Unfinished Story
overview: Dr Arash Samin, one of the prominent professors in the field of sociology, lives a calm and peaceful life with his doctor wife and young daughter. But the publication of a picture of him in cyberspace puts his personal and family life on a new path..

title: Grizzly Night
overview: On August 12, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happened: that same night, nine miles apart, there were not one—but two—fatal grizzly bear attacks.

title: Transit Times
overview: A year in the life of a family in a typical backyard in the center of the Moldovan capital Chisinau in the 1990s: Zina lives here with her husband Victor and daughter Eva and, like the other inhabitants of the house, struggles for the family's financial survival. Through the eyes of the family, we experience a country in transition after the fall of the Iron Curtain.

title: Youthful Grace
overview: Amir and Eliyahu, two teens living on the outskirts of Jerusalem, try to survive in a world of adult neglect. An unusual encounter on Passover Eve leads them on an unexpected journey.

title: Good Boy
overview: Tommy, a volatile 19-year-old, revels in drugs, parties and violence. After getting separated from his friends on a drunken bender, he is abducted by a shadowy figure. He wakes to find himself imprisoned in the basement of a remote Yorkshire house, inhabited by a very strange family. But what unfolds is not what he could possibly expect.

title: Nagabandham: The Secret Treasure
overview: A chosen warrior protects a mystical, serpent-bound Himalayan temple from those seeking to steal the power of the Brahma Kamalam, a divine relic.

title: The Birthday Trip
overview: An unflinchingly funny satire following three millennial couples whose relationships are thrown into disarray when they descend on a luxury Southern Highlands farmstay for a birthday weekend they'll never forget.

title: About the Dream to Be Unsinkable
overview: The film traces the rise  and fall of GDR deep-sea fishing fleet - and the afterlives of its last surviving ships. Once more than a hundred strong, only a few vessels remain, now under new names, with new missions and new dreams: repurposed as rescue boats, cultural platforms, or sound spaces.

title: Касса невест
overview: A near future where people can travel through time-though only a select few. Lavrik, a charming con man and gigolo, has been exposed and left without a source of income. The only way for the hero to improve his situation is to fulfill a task assigned by the billionaire Boltzmann and travel back in time to retrieve the Hymen Cup. Lavrik is transported to Moscow in 1913 and begins hunting for an artifact located in the Bridal Cashier's Office, a bank where dowries are accumulated. But Varya, a principled woman who is also a member of the Cashier's Office and has a keen sense of deception, seeks to ruin Lavrik's plans. Lavrik devises a plan to outwit Varya and, with her help, pull off the scam.

title: I Was a Teenage Sex Pistol
overview: Experience the Pistols' rise to global infamy with an honest, insightful account of a group of malcontents, determined to change the music business and to attack hypocrisy and stale conventions in society at large. Based off the novel written by Glen Matlock, one of the founding members of the Sex Pistols who co-wrote ten of twelve iconic songs on their only studio album, NEVER MIND THE BOLLOCKS. Glen describes in detail the mindset of the UK in the early 70's and divulges a mine of information; Steve's thievery, Wally Nightingale, the search for a singer, the exploding punk scene and a bleak backdrop providing a contrast to the excitement and energy of McLaren's shop. The public will now have a chance to hear the story, not just from a member of the band, but also from a man who had his contributions exceptionally downplayed.

title: Once Upon A Time
overview: After failing in the big city, Chen Tao returns home and unexpectedly reunites with his deceased father through an old book, leading to whimsical adventures that heal their rift and inspire him to start anew.

title: Jackass: Best and Last
overview: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

title: Wind Up: The Movie
overview: A pitcher who can't throw strikes and his unlikely manager form a heartfelt bond.

title: RED VELVET
overview: Seven criminal's are sent out to retrieve multiple item's for their employer as they uncover the true meaning of their missions.

title: Petaka Gunung Welirang
overview: Five friends camp on Mount Welirang. On their way to the summit, they encounter a Queen and her royal troops. What mysteries lie hidden within Mount Welirang?

title: Para los jóvenes: a 20 años del 2006
23 000 Lives
overview: A group of young people sets sail for the Mediterranean to save the lives of refugees — a mission that puts their ideas of law and justice to the test.

title: Cinta Lama Babak Kedua #CLBK
overview: Ambar and Raka have planned their wedding and dreamed of a happy future together, just like any other couple. But their plans are put to the test when Akung Abi and Nin Sita — their grandfather and grandmother — turn out to be former lovers who parted ways 56 years ago. Since their youth, the relationship between Abi and Sita has been shaped by a past filled with stories that were never truly resolved. Without realizing it, that unfinished history begins to affect Ambar and Raka’s relationship in the present. The deeper they uncover their grandparents’ past, the more they feel that something has remained unsettled for the last 56 years.

title: NEOT: The Movie
overview: The long-awaited finale to NEOT! Will the cast finally make a funny joke? Will Mappy return again? And will the sloppily constructed lore finally coalesce into something somewhat coherent? There's only one way to find out!

title: Dua Nafas
overview: Anto was entrusted to his grandmother in the village, grew up to become a successful doctor, and then returned to make her proud—only to find that his grandmother had died while waiting for him.

title: Jackie the Stripper
overview: A female empowerment grind house comedy action thriller. Jackie and her band of female vigilante assassins hatch a plan to kill six members of the evil male dominated court. With deadly and hilarious consequences

title: Julien Doré - Le Dernier Pestacle
overview: Filmed during the final date of his triumphant tour, Julien Doré’s concert is being shown exclusively in cinemas for a one-night-only event. A monumental show. A spectacular and immersive stage production. In a rich visual universe that is both poetic and dreamlike, blending humor and emotion, each song becomes a living tableau, alternating between grand, awe-inspiring moments and more intimate ones. Applauded by more than one million spectators, this unforgettable tour, which has become iconic, comes to a close on the big screen, offering one last moment of escape.

title: Revelations
overview: Nuca, one of the world’s leading bee specialists, celebrates her birthday surrounded by family traditions. As the family matriarch, time is relentless in its toll on her memory loss. In an attempt to remember, she revisits family photographs, and as the past and present intertwine, secrets begin to surface. At this celebration, it won't just be the photos that are revealed.

title: Mirage
overview: A young man searches the city at night for a woman and is led by her into an initiation ritual.

title: The Keris
overview: A battle over the Keris Tempa Melaka, a legendary blade linked to warrior Hang Tuah, drawing in a Muay Thai practitioner and a Russian mafia syndicate.

title: Anna, Postmortem
overview: When a young woman is murdered for mysterious reasons, her ghost searches for answers - and revenge.

title: Suite Dreams
overview: “Suite Dreams” is a three-episode fiction film set in hotel rooms that hold historical, social, and symbolic layers of Brazil. At Hotel Riazor (Rio de Janeiro), the story unfolds on the night of August 24, 1954, facing the windows of Catete Palace — when entering history can mean leaving life behind. Madeira Palace (São Paulo), a well-known downtown hotel associated with chemsex encounters, receives a character immersed in delirium and confinement, confronted with his own duplication. Freely inspired by Campos de Carvalho. At Hotel Glória (Rio de Janeiro), the rise of a new real estate icon unfolds — because even ghosts are forced to update themselves.

title: The Ballad from Wednesday to Thursday
overview: During the course of a single night, various people cross paths in the pubs, bars, and hookah lounges of Cologne. The issues that all of Germany is talking about are put on the table: the patriarchy, the Middle East conflict, rising rents, and whether Jesus would still buy everyone drinks today. Political convictions are stiffened by alcohol, and old wounds are reopened.

title: Папа, купи песика
overview: Milana receives a long-awaited gift from her parents—a puppy named Dippy. Her joy knows no bounds, but one day, while out for a walk, the girl gets distracted, and the puppy gets lost in the park, left all alone to face the big city. Dippy meets a street cat and a rat named Bangs, and even falls in love with a Chihuahua named Tabby. While Milana searches for her beloved pup, exciting adventures await Dippy—adventures in which he must become a true hero, capable of protecting not only himself but also his friends.

title: Le Pigeon, le Clodo & l'Épopée du Sandwich
The Trouble With Mistletoe
overview: An acquisitions executive who returns home for Christmas and unexpectedly reconnects with the former fiancé she left behind. As the traditions of her hometown rekindle old memories, she begins to wonder if the life she walked away from may still be the one meant for her.

title: Anatomia do Caos
overview: With unprecedented access to the Brazilian Senate, director Dandara Ferreira follows the entire trajectory of the Covid-19 Parliamentary Inquiry from the inside, transforming this exclusive footage into a cinematic record of one of the most defining moments of the pandemic in Brazil.

title: What Happens After Murder
overview: At a birthday party, Sandra publicly exposes her boyfriend’s betrayals—then she is brutally murdered during a sudden blackout. The story then shifts into an intense whodunit. Trapped with her closest friends, paranoia erupts as secrets, affairs, hidden and deadly motives surface. As secrets unravel and trust collapses, they discover the murder was only the beginning. The real horror isn’t just who killed her, but what the murder reveals about them all.

title: We Bark in the Same Tone of Voice
SOS: A Misstep that Changes Life
overview: A young trainee teacher begins his journey into the teaching profession with hopes and ideals. His convictions are put to the test when he finds himself caught in an emotional triangle involving a female student and a male LGBTQ+ student, both deeply devoted to him. As affection turns into an increasingly complicated bond, he must confront difficult choices between professional responsibility and personal emotions.

title: Last Day of Season
overview: On her final day working in a greenhouse, Romanian migrant worker Ana is followed by a documentary crew manipulating her story. Under pressure from her father and boss, tensions escalate. As she realizes she’s losing control, a turning point at work forces her to attempt an escape.

title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 4
overview: The fourth night of Road to G1 Climax 36 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on July 2, 2026, at Tokorozawa Municipal Gymnasium in Tokorozawa, Saitama, Japan.

title: Ara què faig, amb això?
overview: A man buys a table from a woman. Little did he know this simple exchange would end up being more complicated.

title: Lutèce, sur les traces des Parisii
So Many Explosions
overview: Exploding a factory, going to KFC and going inside some chamber with bombs; some are interesting, like the exploding bottle of soda...

title: City of Palys
overview: The film introduces architect Jurgis Rimvydas Palys, his multifaceted world, and the city of Kaunas, which he spent his entire life shaping.

title: ¡Pícaro!
overview: Enrique Zuniga, a man looking for a job, faces a setback after losing the wallet he needed to buy the suit that would secure his position at the company. However, he decides to obtain the suit in a different way.

title: FbG
overview: At the request of subscribers, bloggers go to the forest with a mystical reputation, anger the spirits and, having split up, pay for disturbing them.

title: Sonho Estrangeiro
overview: In a future where 75% of humanity lives in a virtual reality and the rest remains on an abandoned Earth, an artificial intelligence is unable to recreate images of the physical world. Helena, one of the few people still living outside, is called upon to teach the machine what it cannot comprehend: reality.

title: Saat Masakan Ibu Tak Lagi Hangat
Le Mal Des Ardents
overview: In a small village ravaged by wars and epidemics, Vera becomes the perfect target and is accused of witchcraft. But her unexplained disappearance during her execution leads her sister Michelle to investigate what really happened.

title: Super Subbu
overview: When Subbu takes a covert job teaching sex ed in rural Makhipur, his life flips upside down; to pursue his dreams, he must educate a resistant village without provoking his traditional father's wrath and balancing his romance.

title: Yellow
overview: A therapist's patients all report the same terrifying vision: a yellow doppelganger coming to replace them. His search for answers uncovers a dark secret hidden in the past.

title: Chop Breakfast
overview: CHOP BREAKFAST is a romantic drama in which, Femi, a charming Casanova who is also a gold-digger bites off more than he can chew. His entanglement with Ella, the rich and mighty single mother, turns his world around in ways you’ll never see coming. Hell, they say, hath no fury like a woman scorned.

title: Graamaayana
overview: In a rustic village, young Seena earns his "Sixth Sense" nickname through remarkable intuition. His journey through community conflicts, romantic entanglements, and family bonds reveals the essence of rural existence.

title: A River's Gaze
overview: Lavinia, a single mother trying to make a better life on her own terms for herself and her 13-year-old son, live in a poor Romanian village. She is impulsive, prone to misreading situations, and not sure how to love. But her son, on the threshold between childhood and adolescence, needs his mother more than ever, and over the course of four seasons their relationship is put to the test.

title: Satluj
overview: Triggered by the search for his missing aunt, human rights activist Jaswant Singh Khalra takes on a broken system in a courageous fight to uncover the conspiracy behind thousands of disappearances and extrajudicial killings during the nadir of Punjab’s period of insurgency.

title: Keep Real
overview: Thirty years ago, the Super Ying Association led by Superman Wang Changhai crushed the aliens. Years later, Wang Changhai was appointed to return to his hometown to set up a combat squad, but in the town of Rheinland, which had been peaceful for many years, human feelings and courtesies have left Wang Changhai overwhelmed, creating layers of obstacles to Wang's ability to complete his mission.

title: The Gang
overview: Ayman, a teenager of Moroccan descent, is invited by Sara to a party at the same house where his mother works as a domestic worker. Along with Eric and Robert, his lifelong friends, they set off on a journey filled with confrontations and disappointments -with society and with themselves- putting their gang's friendship to the test. Once at the party, they discover that life isn't what they thought, and that wanting something doesn't always make it possible.

title: Wings of Dread
overview: Air police officer Gu Chaoyang encounters a hijacking crisis on his flight back to China. With his extremely high professional ethics, he fights desperately to stop the hijacker, and a life-and-death struggle that takes place at an altitude of ten thousand meters begins.

title: Focus
overview: Eun-ho, a photographer, acquires a used camera, only to discover a ghost appearing in his photos and reality. As the camera behaves erratically, he experiences terrifying hallucinations, ruining his relationship and jeopardizing his career. Seeking help, he turns to Gwang-myeong, a forensic hypnosis expert, to uncover the camera’s secrets and perform an exorcism.

title: 9 Moons
overview: Ángel is a personal trainer who, after taking a year off, has just landed a job at the most prestigious gym in the city, and life finally seems to be back on track. But everything changes when he begins to feel unwell, goes to the hospital, and receives shocking news: he’s pregnant. A trans man on the verge of completing his transition, Ángel is now confronted with a life-altering decision—one that will challenge his identity, his aspirations, and his very understanding of masculinity.

title: Baby Do Die Do
overview: A deaf and mute serial killer in Mumbai can only hear her dead sister's voice as she commits murders for mysterious reasons.

title: Brunch for a Depressed Zombie
overview: One day, a wife suffering from depression turned into a zombie. However, instead of despairing, the husband begins developing strange yet lovely survival recipes to get through each day with his wife. Set against the backdrop of a quiet and mysterious rural village, the husband attempts extraordinary dishes to satisfy his wife's appetite and discovers a crucial hint in his late grandmother's old recipes.

title: White Haired Witch's Blood Phoenix
overview: Adapted from the novel series “Baifa Monü Zhuan” by Liang Yu Sheng.

title: Ananya's Call
overview: Faced with an impossible encounter in her own home, a young woman must race against time to stop a tragedy that defies the laws of nature.

title: Just a Joke
overview: Ji Hong, a sanitation worker, is desperate to secure a school enrollment spot for her child. She finds herself subjected to inappropriate advances disguised as "jokes" by her supervisor at work. While her colleagues turn a blind eye to such behavior, the stubborn Ji Hong resolves to fight back.

title: Aroopi
overview: A vengeful Yakshini, once sealed inside a doll at the Aryanattu estate, is accidentally unleashed by two thieves. When a brutal murder draws Niranjan, the last surviving heir of the lineage, back to his ancestral home, he must confront an ancient curse and the dark secrets surrounding his family's past.

title: Summer's Last Resort
overview: Determined to save her mom from another bad relationship, a teen accidentally turns a luxury vacation into total chaos.

title: Sardines
overview: A mother doesn't understand the life that her daughter wants to live. A daughter wants to be free but finds herself trapped by family, religion and gender. The mother tries to enter her daughter's world, she doesn't know how to live with it. Should we try and break this eternal generational gap, or keep still, trapped inside a little can of sardines. Symbols and suffocation chase us.

title: Granny
overview: Rony, a home nurse movies into a remote house to take care of a strange old woman only know an 'Granny'. His sanity starts slipping as her behavior turns increasingly eccentric.

title: Le Temps d'une Tartine 2
overview: While Mixel tries the best he can to help along with Martin's parents, Charlène and Martin have escaped the flames and appeared somewhen else, where twists and turns won't end. Why is everything happening? To find that out... they must go Back to the Toaster!

title: SOMEWHERE OVER THE RAINBOW
overview: A surreal odyssey follows a 16 year old throught music

title: How They Really Are
overview: A boy named Tyler Ortin is struggling with lonlieness and the problem of his parents constant fighting when he becomes friends with a classmate Louey. Tyler helps his class get their grades back on track but the stress catches up to him.

title: Night of the Living Dead
overview: A ragtag group barricade themselves in an old Pennsylvania farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls ravaging the Northeast.

title: Tropical SOV: Bizarre Sci-fi Samba
overview: Once again, 23 Brazilian filmmakers come together for the second Tropical SOV anthology, now exploring sci-fi in humorous stories involving aliens and their space invasions, mad scientists, time travel, dystopias, and a myriad of end-of-the-world scenarios.

title: Why Wait, Just Die
overview: A woman named Asami Kashima is found strangled. A woman named Eiko Watarai starts confronting various people who knew her – her boss, her neighbor, her boyfriend, her mother – riling them up into revealing their feelings about Asami, and saying she wants to know more about her.

title: Gurthukosthunnayi
overview: Follows Santosh, a young man who forgets his past including his school days and love Vaishali, as his friends and family help him retrieve his memory by walking him through his early life experiences.

title: THE ORIGIN OF ULTRAMAN
overview: The landmark Japanese Tokusatsu TV series Ultraman became a massive social phenomenon upon its debut in 1966, reaching a staggering peak viewership rating of 42.8%. Six decades later, Tsuburaya Productions continues to introduce new entries into the Ultraman series, expanding its unique universe to a global audience across generations. This documentary brings together leading voices from the fields of cinema, Tokusatsu, and design. Witness profound testimonies from an international assembly of creators, including: Guillermo del Toro, Hirokazu Kore-eda, Hideo Kojima, Hideaki Anno, Shinji Higuchi, and Nicolas Winding Refn.

title: JE VEUX FAIRE UN FILM ABSTRAIT !
overview: Émile, a cinema student at Janot High School, must make a short-film for his film studies diploma. To carry out his project, he needs to form a group with some of his classmates, with whom he will be confronted, given the rather strange nature of his project...

title: Echoed Blood
overview: Engaged in online forums and exploration, three friends investigate a desolate forest for proof of a vampiric creature.

title: Action Stage: Helios Rising Heroes -New Dawn-
overview: Four years have passed since the "Lost Zero" incident.  Keith Max still believes in the survival of Dino Albani, who was presumed dead, and continues to pursue him.  Meanwhile, Brad Beams keeps a close eye on Keith's precarious actions, striving to find answers to his own doubts.  At this time, a new "Eclipse" threat creeps into the city.  In the midst of this chaotic situation, standing before the "Heroes" is "Zero," with whom they have fought countless times.  As they confront each other once again, the lost time begins to move violently once more.

title: The Odyssey
overview: Based on the Ancient Greek epic. After ten years of war, King Odysseus sets sail for Ithaca, eager to reunite with his beloved. But his journey home is far more treacherous than the battlefield, as he must face deadly monsters and vengeful gods to survive.

title: Wish You Were Dead
overview: On a night when thunder and lightning strike, the deceased grandfather returns home as a zombie. Eighteen-year-old granddaughter Seohyun leads her family to launch an operation to kill the grandfather who became a zombie.

title: Line
overview: On an ordinary day, mysterious red lines suddenly begin to appear, throwing a village into chaos as its people begin to fight one another.

title: Blankets
overview: A mother attempts to resurrect her dead husband with the help of her eleven year old son.

title: The old Lady and the Eternity
overview: Josefa Centeno, an 86-year-old woman, refuses to be uploaded to a digital afterlife, facing the consequences of defying the authoritarian regime. Built around archival footage, the director re-imagines his grandmother's life as a sci-fi fable about love, resistance and what it means to choose your own ending.

title: Man of War
overview: When an aid worker vanishes in the first hours of war in Ukraine, a former Navy SEAL and CIA operative crosses into the shattered country to bring her home-facing mercenaries, shifting battle lines, and ghosts he thought he left behind.

title: Pipes
overview: Although Hassan has retired from his job at the water authority, his neighbors are used to him always helping them out. This time, the situation is serious: The entire town is without water, and tensions are rising among the population with every passing day. Hassan would like to help them all, but he also needs time to mourn a friend who recently died under unclear circumstances. Lebanese director Karim Kassem skillfully works with various cinematic genres to create an elegant double portrait of an aging man and the town of which he has been a part all his life. He does so with a sense of nostalgia, subtle humor, and an almost meditative melancholy, mixed with a touch of detective work.

title: Homo Sive Natura
overview: In the remote forests of eastern Cambodia lives a community of indigenous inhabitants. An unnamed forty-year-old businessman arrives with seemingly selfless intentions: he claims he is merely a tourist seeking to discover the life of his “brothers”. In actuality, however, he is gathering information for the possible expropriation of their land. Italian globetrotter Giovanni C. Lorusso lives up to his reputation as a filmmaker balancing on the line between fiction and documentary. Through unique locations, mesmerizing camera work, and immersive sound design, he captures the slow inner transformation of his protagonist along with the rich cultural and spiritual life of a community facing a modern form of colonialism.

title: The Friend's House is Here
overview: Pari and Hanna, roommates and friends, live in modern-day Tehran. Pari is a curator and director of an independent theatre group; Hanna is a dancer, who wants to get out of Iran as soon as possible. The situation of both women becomes more complicated, but their friendship is strong in the face of political oppression. The Friend’s House is Here is a rewarding cinematic experience, conveying a sense of freedom and hope, even though it originated under the exact opposite conditions. Just a few days after the June War in Iran, the crew, headed by directing duo Hossein Keshavarz and Maryam Ataei, took to the streets of Tehran to make a film about a generation that no longer wants to live according to imposed rules and is striving to achieve one of the fundamental human rights, the right to freedom of artistic expression.

title: Switch Off
overview: When a seemingly dead phone comes back to life, it begins documenting a man’s reality and his future. As the images turn fatal, he finds himself trapped in a moment he can’t escape.

title: object and object
overview: Chung-jae, a repairman, cannot stop turning "a round golden doorknob" in a client's bedroom. He visits a consulting room to find its cause.  Da-gam, an actor, visits his friend Doo-joon to borrow "a funeral suit" when someone dies. "So who died this time?" Doo-joon asks over a beer. "An actress I worked with."  Two men, each in an empty seat, begin to tell their story — about object and object.

title: The Wife You Never Knew
overview: On a fateful night , within the walls of their opulent mansion. An elegant housewife Zhou Ruoying commits the unthinkable, she murders her husband, Wu Jianan. As she races against time to cover up the crime, hidden shadows from her husband’s violent family past begin to close in, each secret more dangerous than the last.

title: Nevermind
overview: In the neon-lit streets of Kolkata, a woman searching for redemption crosses paths with a mysterious bar singer whose past remains hidden. Over the course of a restless day, their lives intertwine with strangers carrying their own conflicts and secrets, until a buried truth changes everything.

title: One word, not two
overview: In December of 2024, Hrvoje Turković sent Kino klub Osijek a notice – kinoklub is written as one word, not two.

title: Sunlit
overview: What am I to myself?

title: Epiphany
overview: The power went out twice that night. Other things happened as well.

title: Tip-top
overview: I did everything tip-top, a then...

title: Igor and After
overview: This year’s gallery of artistically inspiring portraits of uncompromising eccentrics (among them The Hanging of Stuart Cornfeld, Robert Richardson: The White Devil and A Pint of Ink) features another unobtrusive stand-out in the shape of Igor Luther, a key figure of Slovak and European cinematography. Ivan Ostrochovský’s perspective is rare, dynamic and also meditative, while Luther himself co-authored the project during the last few months of his life. Works such as Juraj Jakubisko’s Birds, Orphans and Fools, Volker Schlöndorff’s The Tin Drum and Andrzej Wajda’s Danton, in the persuasive words of their creators, wouldn't have the same timeless energy today if it weren't for Luther's visionary endeavours.

title: Quaternité
overview: An experimental film, developed from an interactive installation and composed of 64 episodes. Its structure is based on coin tosses and the ancient Chinese "Book of Changes," where chance determines the order of events, editing, and the very logic of the narrative. The film follows the journey of several people through different spaces, the flow of unpredictable events in their lives, and the unexpected intersections of their destinies.

title: Sidekicks
overview: Two best friends debate what should be done with their newly acquired superpowers.

title: Heidi Wrangles Cats
overview: A young woman quits her day job to help Brooklyn's street cats. Along the way, she builds a social media following that financially sustains her rescue efforts.

title: The Wucket Bucket Crew
overview: Two brothers, Bryson and Perry, start a gang and hang out.

title: Ask Me Anything
overview: One question. Seven worlds. In an unidentified space, among participants suspicious of one another, a woman wearing the number tag "4235" steps into an interview chamber. Waiting for her are an unsettling interviewer and a mysterious black spherical device. With the question, "What are you most afraid of?", she is thrown into worlds of deep oceans, collapsing airplanes, ruined cities, frozen wastelands, and hell-like realms, where she confronts buried memories, guilt, and the darkest corners of human nature. As participants begin disappearing one by one, she realizes that the interview is not a simple test, but a massive experiment designed to examine the boundaries of human nature and existence itself.

title: Al Murray: All You Need Is Guv
overview: With a fresh and frothing pint to hand, a barrel of laughs to pour from, and a flower in his heart, Guv is all you need.

title: La belle histoire de la chanson française
Dear Sis Dolly
overview: An ambitious and intellectual psychologist finds herself having to dismantle her identity when she lands a job as an agony aunt for famed Drum Magazine and learns that being 'real' is as important as being 'clever'.

title: Qaid
overview: The wait ends.The night begins.

title: In the Darkness of Water
overview: Mauro Morandi has lived isolated from society for 30 years on Budelli, an italian island. He is now 83 years old and, despite his advanced age, he is concerned about caring for and preserving the island's nature. One day he discovers that he will be evicted. At the same time, someone contacts him and encourages him to abandon this lifestyle and return to society. Both factors will have repercussions in Mauro's life, who, certainly disturbed, will have to deal with the conflict and assume the possibility of leaving his beloved island, with which he has a truly special connection.

title: Koka Deuta Nati Aru Hati 2
overview: After years of living in America, Prasanta returns to his ancestral village in Assam, carrying cherished memories of his childhood elephant companion. When his American-raised grandson Ankur visits, a generational divide keeps them apart. As Ankur reconnects with his roots and discovers the warmth of village life, the family embarks on a heartfelt journey of love, belonging, and self-discovery.

title: Helena
overview: Helena, the only hilot in a small town who secretly has affairs with her patients' husbands. After a pregnant patient dies upon discovering Helena's affair with her own husband, the enraged townsfolk turn against her.

title: Find Me
overview: During the COVID-19 lockdown, a series of mysterious murders spreads fear across the city. As the investigation unfolds, hidden secrets and unexpected twists make it increasingly difficult to identify the killer. Every clue leads to another mystery in this Tamil crime thriller.

title: Simpsley
overview: When penniless con-artist Marge Bouvier is sent to Italy to convince wealthy sap Seymour Skinner to come home, she’s tempted by the trappings of his affluent lifestyle. But there’s a big fat fly in the ointment: Skinner’s clingy, dim-witted mooch of a houseguest, Homer Simpsley. Lies, lust and Italian lira are abound.

title: Hangman
overview: Sivayya, an executioner, sees a girl resembling his late daughter. She rebuffs his stares. They're both subjected to assault. Enraged, Sivayya turns vigilante, accompanied by his son, seeking justice beyond his official role.

title: Satluj
overview: Triggered by the search for his missing aunt, Punjab human rights activist Jaswant Singh launches a dangerous investigation in his attempts at uncovering the conspiracy behind thousands of disappearances and extrajudicial killings.

title: You're Not Going Home
overview: A high school drama club's productions are put into danger when students begin to go missing.

title: Don’t come out
overview: a boy hides in a closet from intruders to save his life

title: America: Birth Of A Nation
overview: As the United States celebrates 250 years of American exceptionalism, The Onion looks back on the pivotal moments and enlightened fathers who gave birth to the greatest nation on Earth.

title: Double Barrel
overview: A thirst for power pulls Surya into a deadly rivalry. But once the violence begins, is there any way back?

title: Imprevisible, inevitable: un trajecte del metro a la Dana de València
The Nation
overview: A First Nation Chief develops radical ideas about sovereignty.

title: Next Step
overview: Trista and Ellis are a young couple, but their relationship is tested when Trista is suffering from an illness that changes her daily life. Ellis refuses to let her face it alone.

title: Discman
overview: A man goes through a neverending routine in order to abtain perfection.

title: Service !
overview: Théo has failed his A-levels, and his sentence is final: he has to spend the summer slaving away in his parents’ restaurant. To survive this punishment, he decides to hire his gang of mates. A stroke of genius? Not really. Between a self-proclaimed chef who thinks he’s a reality TV star, waiters more interested in flirting than serving, and organisational skills that are virtually non-existent, the family restaurant is set to become the scene of some chaotic fun. It remains to be seen whether they’ll manage to get through the summer without burning the kitchen down.

title: Palace Detroit 313
overview: A skate video by Palace, filmed in Detroit over a seven-year period (2018–2025).

title: Amerikan Boy
overview: A short film that explores identity, masculinity, and the search for belonging. At its heart, it’s about the tension between who we are and who we are asked to be. A story told through the lens of Ik a young Nigerian immigrant.

title: Ghost Writer
overview: He has been staying in the town for three days. He seems to be investigating something, although nobody can tell exactly what. One evening, as he stands by the edge of the lake, she approaches him.

title: Killing Time
overview: In an era of economic despair and record-high unemployment, where becoming a YouTuber is the ultimate dream job, the popular YouTube crew 'Killing Time' collapses overnight after an unforeseen accident claims a team member's life during a live broadcast. Desperate for a successful comeback, the members plot to return with far more extreme and sensational content. However, just as success seems within reach, mysterious figures appear and propose the 'real' Killing Time.

title: Finding Our Way
overview: For three years, Nam-cheol and his girlfriend, Joo-hee, have lived together. A rent hike pushes them to search for a new place—only to find worse options. Joo-hee is advised to apply for the newlywed housing program with Nam-cheol. Meanwhile, Nam-cheol's mother—trapped with a conservative husband—urges Nam-cheol to apply for the youth rental housing lottery so she can move into the unit herself, effectively "graduating from her marriage." Nam-cheol must choose just one of the two programs: "graduating from marriage" or marriage. Will they find happiness in the end?

title: Niko
overview: In the troubled night of Seoul on the verge of apocalypse, Niko, a penniless scriptwriter, works a part-time job as a companion for people who have lost their keys. When she can no longer satisfy her longing for true love in this once melancholic, sensual, and bustling city, she disappears. Her boyfriend Jeremy and their new friend Ji-eun start looking for the missing Niko and become entangled in a love triangle. At last, Niko finds a new, reckless, and ultimate way to express her feelings.

title: Joust
overview: A day at the Renaissance Festival.

title: Главная роль
overview: A film about the painful and unrequited love of a young girl, Masha, for an aging actor, Seryozha.

title: Eve
overview: While visiting her father's apartment, a woman discovers that the man who raised her might be something less than human.

title: A city beyond the harbor
overview: Tormented by a mysterious malaise, a woman tries to go on with her daily tasks. Meanwhile, her son becomes involved with another young man as all the spaces around them seem to point towards the end.

title: The Best Summer
overview: Immersive POV camera footage reveals electric performances, candid interviews, and intimate backstage life with the Beastie Boys, Sonic Youth, Foo Fighters, Pavement, Rancid, Beck, The Amps, and Bikini Kill — an all-access view inside an era-defining moment in music.

title: Tales of a Wandering City Girl
overview: Eloíse is an immortal woman who wanders the streets of São Paulo registering everyday life when she finds Lola, a 26 year old photographer who's confused about her future. Together they'll find in each other a way to face the burdens of life.

title: Solitaire
overview: A young woman adjusts to life in a new city, managing remote work, a relationship on thin ice, and single-player tennis.

title: Starguy and I
overview: Awkward and reserved Omar spends his night helping an otherwordly creature find its way back home. In the process, he realizes just how alike they truly are.

title: Knock
overview: Facility No. 6, a juvenile protective detention center, stands on the verge of closure. A documentary crew steps inside to record what little remains, and from the moment the cameras turn on, they find themselves before long-buried wounds and truths no one has wanted to face. In the worn faces of teachers who have spent themselves caring for these children, and beneath the indifference of a society that has long since turned its head away from the other side of the wall, the crew quietly bears witness to how children with nowhere left to go have arrived at this place.

title: Two Pids
overview: After the world premiere of Being John Smith at the Toronto Film Festival a strange experience in the filmmaker’s hotel causes him to ponder the nature of reality.

title: Talion
overview: On their way to a remote vacation spot, a young couple witnesses a fatal hunting accident. Far from civilization and cut off from any help, they start to question the hunters' intentions.

title: Anna by the Window
overview: A filmic portrait of 24 hours in the life of an aimless teen boy as he avoids his overbearing artist father and AI startup founder brother.

title: Mizandrika
overview: After waking up next to a lifeless body, Drika, a trans woman, revisits her past in search of her freedom. The experimental short film guides us through the thoughts and anguish of a woman who murdered a man.

title: Turning girl
overview: Yeorum has lost her self-esteem, trapped in a cycle of failed job searches and constant comparisons to her friend Jimin. The only thing she is truly good at is doing cartwheels. Whenever feelings of inferiority begin to stir inside her, she turns to cartwheels for a small sense of comfort.

title: Break Time
overview: Kyung-jun receives an offer from his old orphanage buddy, Jae-hyun, to rob a local soup joint that "only takes cash." What they thought would be an easy score takes a wildly unexpected turn with the sudden arrival of one man.

title: Pervert
overview: An old man lives with a real doll that resembles his late wife, treating it as if it were her. One day, a man next door discovers the doll’s existence.

title: Siren
overview: One day, Seol-i’s father, Captain Park, captures a mermaid.

title: A Happy Family
overview: Niki has two kids, two jobs, and no money. After a fire turns her life upside down, her children are placed in foster care. Banned from contact, she assumes a new identity risking everything to stay close to them.

title: Terreno
overview: Terrain explores the ruins of a motel in São Gonçalo and draws sensory parallels with the construction of the Rio-Niterói Bridge.

title: Wake
overview: As the sun rises, an old man awakens.

title: Christmas Under Construction
overview: Chelsea (Lowndes) and Jake (Adam Hurtig) are America's sweethearts and the stars of a hit reality show, "Renovation Romance," where they help couples transform their homes and relationships. For a live Christmas special, they're tasked with renovating a cozy New Hampshire cabin alongside a new duo, Cooper (Lissing) and Janice (Samantha Kendrick). But behind the festive cheer, Chelsea and Jake's relationship is fading. As their latest project progresses, it becomes clear to Chelsea that she and Jake have different priorities in life and must decide if their relationship can be salvaged or if it's time for a fresh start.

title: What's That Smell?
overview: A fictional documentary following the exploits of Hank, a Los Angeles plumber going through a bitter divorce who decides he's going to clean up his city... by killing every homeless person he can find.

title: Salitre no more
overview: For around fifteen years, I have been filming a forest of imburana de cambão trees that has been progressively disappearing, located on the border between the states of Bahia and Pernambuco. The visual saturation created through image overlaps and the division of the screen into three parts fosters the emergence of a particular rhythm, in which pulsating texts impose other forms of escape.The gradual disappearance of this forest echoes texts evoking the consequences of climate change, while also inscribing fire and logging as human acts contributing to this impoverishment.The basis of this film was the installation of the same name presented as part of an exhibition at the Frans Krajcberg Space in 2025. The film is denser. The imburanas de cambão burst into flames as the sertão turns into desert.

title: Caussade le Film
overview: Beyond those never-ending fields where there's nothing but blazing sun and quiet nights, only thing reliable is the sky is blue, the grass is green and eyes are red.

title: Watch Out, Kid
overview: A young man is drawn to a handsome guy, but his insecurities stand in his way.

title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 5
overview: The fifth night of Road to G1 Climax 36 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on July 4, 2026, at Yamagata Big Wing in Yamagata, Japan.

title: Don't Run Away
overview: A story about relationships that arise unexpectedly and change the course of life, forcing us to answer the question of whether it is truly possible to run away from ourselves.

title: Dëmm
overview: Haunted by the death of her mother, a young woman drifting through Dakar crosses paths with a secretive sisterhood of soul-eating women — the dëmm — triggering a mysterious metamorphosis that forces her to confront loss and identity.

title: The Great Fish of the Lake
overview: On the shore of a Swiss lake, in a strange time, the fish have vanished. A young fisherman, Foilleron, claims to have found a solution by casting his line into the lake’s depths. He brings up a gigantic creature whose sale sparks a collective frenzy, as he is hailed as a savior. As the town sinks into greed and violence, something begins to shift.

title: Le miracle
overview: After Angelica is disturbed by her adult son Mattia in her relaxation bath, she is finally able to let go. She begins to masturbate in front of the poster of footballer Valenti, her son's idol. Suddenly, Valenti's gaze fixes on her… a cry for help. An absurd euphoria spreads: the miracle crystallises into a struggle for power and intimacy between mother and son.

title: Тихие смыслы
overview: The Nizhny Novgorod Youth Theatre troupe is rehearsing William Gibson's play "The Miracle Worker." In search of authenticity, the actors find themselves behind the scenes of blindness and deafness. They enter the real world of a boy named Petya, his mother, and his teacher. Episodes from the play about the education of a deaf-blind child unexpectedly echo real life, but reality is always more complex and profound than fiction.

title: Last Day
overview: On the last day of humanity, Zhenya is torn between her parents, her ex, sex, and alcohol. Everyone has their own agenda. Zhenya desperately tries not to feel lonely.

title: Septicemia
overview: When a young girl pleading for help knocks on Florence’s door, Florence discovers the girl is hiding more than what she is willing to share…

title: Grifter
overview: A young man tries to jumpstart his career as an influencer by leaning into conservatism, disregarding the feelings of those around him.

title: Good Morning, James
overview: After discovering a mysterious television broadcast, a man's life spirals into paranoia as its disturbing predictions begin to come true.

title: เด็กตลาด Dream beneath The apron
directors: ศศิประภา ทองเย็น
cast: ศรัณย์พร เจริญราษฎร์
ณพล เสนางคนิกร

title: Dopehead
overview: After being Kidnapped from his home, Phoenix finds he is the chosen one, who will be sacrificed to the Sun.

title: Deadly Impact
overview: Told in real time, two men spend the final minutes before carrying out a murder, following a plan larger than themselves that no one tries to stop. As the appointed time approaches, the tension and moral weight of the act intensify.

title: THE (UN)FADED
overview: A famous writer nearing retirement discovers that he possesses the ability to "rewrite the past", however everything has their own consequences.

title: Brón
overview: Nineteen-year-old Sersha Cleary is struggling with adulthood and mental illness when she experiences a harrowing coincidence. Three knocks and a bone-chilling scream hours before her grandmother passes. The signature of a banshee an Irish myth her grandmother told her stories about when she was little. After her grandmother passes Sersha finds herself alone and struck with intense grief, fighting with her family and struggling with her everyday life. Amongst her struggles she finds herself haunted by a banshee unable to escape its grasps.

title: Kriyamana
overview: Kriyamana is a gripping crime thriller that explores how a single choice can set off a chain of events capable of changing lives forever. As secrets unravel and hidden motives come to light, the line between guilt and innocence begins to blur.

title: Next Friday - Magical Meow Meow
overview: A teenage meow-gical cat-girl in training named Salem, must defeat her kaiju-nemesis, Gabby, by next Friday to pass her class! However, her younger sister Daisy seems to get in the way...

title: The General
overview: July 4th, 1976. Two hundred years after the signing of the Declaration of Independence, America has changed a lot. Far removed from the original ideals are some individuals. The youth becoming more and more opposed to the "freedom" promised, while others use their power for their own personal gain. It's enough for the Founding Fathers to be rolling in their graves, literally.

title: Navillera
overview: Two ordinary teenagers in the countryside, Tien and Tin, aim to earn a scholarship, hoping to pursue the life they want in the big city, but soon discover that life’s invisible conditions force them to make choices that may not lead to the future they dreamed of.

title: What Is The Right Way?
overview: A girl who has lost her beauty turns to a local saint for help. Waiting for a miracle, she stays in his house and becomes a hermit. An ancient icon becomes her confidant, prompting her to perform the true miracle herself.

title: Karma
overview: Jong-shin, a devoted husband living an ordinary life, is devastated when his wife is murdered by the enigmatic Moo-young. After serving a mere five-year sentence, Moo-young appears at Jong-shin’s church, claiming to have found God’s forgiveness. Consumed by grief and rage, Jong-shin plots his revenge—but as he closes in, a buried truth from the past threatens to change everything.

title: Jockstrap
overview: A new purchase opens the door to sexual liberation.

title: The Grandmaster's Gift
overview: In the late 1990s, young Yixuan grows up as a “latchkey kid” in Wanhua, Taipei. With his father busy driving a taxi, Yixuan spends lonely afternoons wandering local diners and Youth Park. In the park, he meets Liu Bin, a lonely chess master. Yixuan finds guidance and warmth in his new teacher, who challenges him to daily matches with a small wager. This bond bridges generations, revealing how love can emerge in unexpected places and how life, much like chess, unfolds in unpredictable ways.

title: Petty Thieves
overview: Rio, an introverted young man, tries to make a living for himself by commiting petty theft in restaurants and resorts around the Croatian coast. His life, however, drastically changes when Andrea, a young Serbian part-time worker, enters his life, with the two becoming partners in crime, planning a major heist of two wealthy women staying at the hotel Andrea works at.

title: Last Mankind
overview: After air pollution wipes out all life on Earth, bioengineer Dae-seung lives in a bunker with Sina, whom he subjects to brutal experiments to create a human who can survive outside. One day, a survivor named Taeo appears, claiming that somewhere beyond the bunker, a village of survivors still exists.

title: Boy
overview: While housesitting alone, Danny invites an older stranger over for a casual hookup. The charged encounter pushes Danny out of his comfort zone and into a world of confusion, forcing him to face the mismatch of who he is and who he appears to be.

title: One Piece Heroines
overview: After failing to stop the thieves due to ill-fitting shoes, Nami storms into the shop where she bought them for a refund. However, the head designer offers to make her a new pair from scratch on one condition: she must walk in their upcoming fashion show.

title: Andrea Gibson: Love Letter from the Afterlife
overview: Andrea Gibson's final performance brought to film.

title: Popeye III: Requiem
overview: When a covert research team imprisons Popeye to harness his superhuman strength as a military weapon, their experiment spirals violently out of control. Transformed into an unstoppable force driven by rage, Popeye tears through the facility, leaving destruction in his wake. With time running out and casualties mounting, one scientist risks everything to stop the monster they created - before he reaches the outside world.

title: Gone and Taken
overview: After his brother Jack is kidnapped, Ethan risks everything to track him down. Following clues to a remote house, he faces deadly danger in a desperate attempt to bring Jack home. As time runs out, their mother launches a frantic search, unaware of the nightmare unfolding.

title: Coming of Age
overview: In today’s harsh world, where it’s hard to live even if you want to work, Jae-soon, who struggles to get through each day without any preparation for the future, has a dream. It is to share three warm meals a day with her daughter in a safe and stable home. To prepare a coming-of-age gift for her daughter, Su-min, she sells pieces of her own body.

title: Small talk about the Reptilian
overview: While an expectant couple whispers to each other in a hospital room, a catastrophic news report breaks on the television. As contractions kick in, their surreal imaginings start to fracture their sense of reality.

title: Happy Burstday!
overview: A girl who receives no birthday wishes picks up a cake knife and sets out for revenge.

title: HotSpring SharkAttack 2: Great Kyushu Showdown
overview: A massive swarm of clone sharks rises from hot springs and volcanoes, leading to a jaw-dropping showdown that throws all of Kyushu into total chaos! The story follows a high school girl and her bond with an Onsen Shark.

title: Smile Charles
overview: An unknown actor from Korea, having lost everything after appearing in pornography, hides away as an online sex worker under the alias "Smile Charles." The painful gap between his inner emotions and his forced expressions breeds an unbearable awkwardness that severs him completely from the world. One day, Mari—a con artist who swindled 2 billion—pierces through the cracks of his isolated life. The uneasy companionship between the slick scammer and the awkward sex worker weaves through Bangkok's humid nights and Ayutthaya's silent ruins, leading Charles to confront the forgotten dreams and phantoms of his past.

title: Robert Richardson: The White Devil
overview: What started as a student exercise and master’s degree project soon evolved into a creative partnership and personal friendship between Jana Hojdová, a former cinematography student at Prague’s FAMU, and distinguished cinematographer Robert Richardson.

title: Cursed Meme
overview: Yura, a young girl who struggles to fit in with her classmates, discovers an old smartphone while helping clean out a disused school building. Out of curiosity, she and her friends power it on. Soon afterward, strange videos featuring the children themselves begin appearing on their phones. At first, the clips seem like harmless jokes and are consumed much like viral internet memes. What the children do not realize, however, is that these videos are foretelling a horrifying future that awaits them.

title: Psyche
overview: In-young (18), who suffers from a congenital respiratory disease, is haunted by nightmares following her mother"s death. To cope with the pain, she steals other people"s belongings, eventually ending up in a juvenile detention center.  After her release, In-young transfers to a school in the countryside and moves in with her aunt. There, she meets Eun-ha (18) and feels a subtle, magnetic attraction toward her.

title: Happy Cooking
overview: A knife-edge stroll with a band of killers.

title: MISERY
overview: A rideshare driver holding his life together by a thread carries one stranger after another through an unraveling night, each too consumed by their own lives to notice his, as he tries to make it back to his son.

title: The SU
overview: For decades the Students’ Union at the University of Galway has produced some of Ireland’s leading political figures, including former President Michael D. Higgins. Over the years these young activists not only defended students’ rights, but found themselves on the front lines of battles stretching well beyond campus – from contraception to abortion, from the Troubles in Northern Ireland to war in the Middle East. Some issues have changed over time, though the overall mission remains the same. This documentary follows along as the current union executives organise protests and other events on and off campus, growing into their roles as leaders. Shot over two years, the film celebrates their passion and vitality, as well as the laughter, friendship and exuberance of youth, giving an inspiring insight into the reality of student life and the growth of strong, socially conscious leaders in whose hands the future lies.

title: Ночная няня
overview: In the Siberian village of Yartsevo, there's a boarding school. Every autumn, about thirty children of Old Believers from various villages come here to study. From a familiar world with a set of strict rules, the teenagers find themselves in an environment full of temptations. Studying away from home often becomes a challenge for them. Helping them cope is provided by the nannies who work at the Yartsevo boarding school. They temporarily act as the children's parents.

title: Theoretical Hypothesis
overview: Ali Rashid, the host of *Hypothesis Theory*, appears to be living a normal life, but it is no longer the same as it once was. Since losing his closest friend, he has been carrying a deep sense of loss, confusion, and sorrow within him. Although he continues with his daily life, he is not truly the person he used to be

title: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
overview: In Mexico’s Pacific waters, Bertie Gregory goes in search of one of the ocean’s most iconic predators: the hammerhead shark. Once abundant in these seas, hammerhead numbers have plummeted, making sightings increasingly rare. Bertie investigates what’s driving the hammerhead decline, and how protected waters offer hope for the future. His journey culminates in a rare and unforgettable encounter that shines a light on the future of one of the world’s most famous sharks.

title: La Retirada ou l'exode d'un peuple
The day the Sun didn't rise
Disco Sex Machine : La naissance du porn chic
overview: "120 beats per minute—at this tempo, twice as fast as the human heartbeat, disco music gets the blood pumping and revs up the libido. In the 1970s, when eroticism took over the silver screen and sex ceased to be a purely private matter, disco became the soundtrack of the sexual revolution. A film about the surprising connections between disco and pornography—and how erotic content increasingly found its way into pop culture.

title: Haunted House
overview: Song Hui secretly takes shelter in a haunted house, encountering a series of supernatural phenomena. As she uncovers the terrifying truth of the house, she embarks on a thrilling journey intertwined with trauma and protection.

title: Legend of Qingqiu
overview: Luo Rong'er, an illusion created by the Nine-Tailed Master, begins to question her purpose after meeting the righteous constable Mo Chen. As their bond grows, she must choose between obeying her creator and protecting the man she loves.

title: Crossroads
overview: A man attempts to cross the street before his time.

title: RAYE Live at Montreux Jazz Festival
overview: Marking the opening of the 60th edition of the Montreux Jazz Festival, RAYE invites a host of international pop stars to join her on stage for an evening of music.

title: ORDINARY BOX
overview: An ordinary box can be surprising.

title: Goodbye, Ane!
overview: Ane is a young Lithuanian woman and wife of a fisherman who left for sea. Her husband's wait grows longer and longer until she becomes confused between what is real and what is illusion in an increasingly confused and dreamlike wait until evening falls.

title: Madness
overview: A young couple is trapped under financial strain and domestic dread. Driven by despair and haunted by the dark past of their relationship, they begin to lose their sanity, spiraling into disturbing and unnatural acts. Tension reaches a breaking point when he notices blood running down his wife's thigh. Panicked by the sound of a baby crying that suddenly shifts from place to place, he rushes into the bedroom to seek help. Inside, however, all he finds are broken child mannequins. Before he can escape, his wife slams the door shut and locks him inside, completely alone.

title: To Die to Live
overview: In 2014, Shakhta, Dancer, and Potter volunteered for the army in order to fight in the Russo-Ukrainian conflict in eastern Ukraine. Although the horrible things they experienced during two years on the front accompany them for every second of their existence, they try to return to civilian life. But the Russian invasion in 2022 forces them to again confront the war.

title: The Ones Who Grieve
overview: At the end of the 19th century, on an isolated farm, Zélie is trapped under the authority of her father, Jacob, a deeply religious man. As a mysterious disease known as the “Black Veil” ravages the surrounding countryside and faith begins to blur with madness, she must fight to preserve her humanity and claim her freedom.

title: Night Comes
overview: Against the backdrop of a cataclysmic event that threatens to engulf humanity, two sisters manage to escape the horror only to find themselves thrust into a perilous struggle for survival, tasked with a mission that holds the fate of mankind in the balance.

title: Home A Loan
overview: A tenacious mother Eun-jin forces her family to move into a rundown apartment, hoping for a luxurious rebuild. However, she loses her sanity as her plan fails and becomes harmful to those who she vowed to protect.

title: Newsrot
overview: A lacklustre news broadcast gets hijacked by a series of unrelated clips.

title: Half-Dead, Half-Dead Can't Get Out. Odyssey 1992
overview: Two directors begin casting a film about the 1990s, which gradually devolves into a space of uncertainty where the distinction between document and fiction disappears. This subtle disruption in the process—the appearance of a single actor obsessed with "accuracy"—leads to a loss of control and implicates them. At the edge of this experience, between life and death, both directors find themselves inside their own, never-made film.

title: Popeye 4 : Resurrection
overview: A fanatical cult resurrects Popeye, convinced they can bend his legendary strength to their will. Instead, he rises furious and uncontrollable, cutting a violent path through anyone who summoned him. As chaos spreads and the cult’s plan collapses, one determined survivor must confront the unstoppable sailor and end his rampage once and for all in this explosive finale.

title: Rain Catcher
overview: In rainy, nocturnal London, photographer Miles obsessively captures unforgiving, morbid portraits of oblivious strangers. When not selling them, he shares them online as 'Rain Catcher'. But soon he notices something unsettling: a mysterious woman watching him and photographing him—turning the lens back on Miles. As her gaze closes in, his world fractures—his work is sabotaged, his name defamed, his loved ones endangered. Consumed by paranoia, he spirals into a dark, delirious obsession to uncover the truth behind her motives. Based on the 2018 short film of the same name.

title: Almost in a Whisper
overview: Eulália and Iremar, two women in their later years, share a life divided between neighborhood novenas and motel rooms, freely exploring desire and passion. However, as Eulália turns 60, a question begins to linger between them: at their age, is it still possible to love freely and start over?

title: Fire Tornado
overview: A dysfunctional rehab group is stranded at a rundown cabin as a roaring firenado melts everything in its path. With roads gone and heat rising, the misfits must combine their strange skills to fortify the house and survive the firestorm’s return.

title: The Robber
overview: After an incident in Seoul, a teenage boy with kleptomania transfers to a high school in a coastal town. He only wants to stay quiet until graduation, but his urges continue, and one day his own belongings disappear. Suspecting another thief, he begins following the class president. As she learns his secret too, the two become tied by each other’s weakness, until a stolen object reveals the hidden truth of a model student.

title: The Day I Stopped Walking
overview: When we stop we're so focused on productivity and efficiency that we feel guilty and confused about our own limitless time giving rise to a silent restlessness: the feeling that we should be producing, moving forward, and justifying every minute. With a new emerging force, the human being in its essence becomes increasingly scarce: we can no longer think, speak, and, above all, be. But ultimately, why does it have to be this way?

title: Black Money For White Nights
overview: After years of saving money from the small bribes they collect, 60-year-old Marina and her husband Gosha from Bulgaria are preparing for their dream trip to St. Petersburg to witness the White Nights. But when Russia invades Ukraine and the travel agency vanishes with all their savings, the couple’s dream collapses along with their illusion of control over their moral principles and the relationship they have with each other.

title: The Lion at My Back
overview: Mariama, an asylum-seeker from Senegal, has just turned 18. Stella, at first glance a withdrawn woman in her 40s, has recently decided to break free from the clutches of addiction and to give her life a fresh start. In their attempt at finding their place in a world where nothing comes for free, the two women meet and form an unexpectedly strong bond.

title: Longtake Onetake Mistake
overview: Actor Lee Yong fails even his thousandth audition. Just as he is about to give up on everything, a flyer catches his eye: "7 Days Until Submission Deadline for the Bucheon International Fantastic Film Festival." He seeks out Chang-kyung, a former film director living in seclusion after a devastating failure, and proposes a reckless plan — to make a film in just seven days. With no budget, no crew, and no future, wounded souls begin gathering one by one.
