Soon, the bizarre filming of a period fantasy begins: a woodcutter turned into a bloodthirsty monster and a fairy transformed into a ghost bride.

title: No One Knows
overview: Seok-hee, a child psychiatrist, spends her days waiting for news from her husband Minho, who is traveling in Norway.  One day, she discovers an old notebook in his study and uncovers a secret he had hidden for years.  As Minho’s presence in her life slowly begins to fade, Seok-hee finds herself questioning who he really was...

title: Love in the Time of Dormancy (or Transitory Illusion)
overview: In an online forum, two strangers, Snub and WhitePony, agree to meet in person to fulfill a dark purpose. Armed with a shotgun, they roam the city during the night before facing their mortal fate, but Snub is filled with doubt about whether he can escape what seems inevitable.

title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 6
overview: The sixth and final night of Road to G1 Climax 36 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on July 6, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. The show featured two G1 Climax 36 play-in matches, an IWGP Global Heavyweight Title Match between champion Shota Umino and Gabe Kidd, and was headlined by YOH (c) vs. Francesco Akira for the IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship.

title: Mente Distorcida
overview: Hugo and Raul Abílio are completely different brothers from a family in 1950s Rio de Janeiro. In one week, they both fall in love with Helena, the new girl in town, unaware of their mutual interest in her.

title: Toothache
overview: In the bump of the night, a mysterious man arrives at a woman's door.

title: Твои мои мечты
overview: Nastya breaks up with her boyfriend and seeks solace in a new acquaintance, not even suspecting what the consequences might be, and Katya wants to turn her life around 180 degrees and accuses her friend of stealing her dreams.

title: O Motorista da meia-noite: o Retorno
INDIGO
overview: Can love only come from others? Or can one find that to love, and to be loved, can come from the same person…

title: The Hunt for the Next Lamine Yamal
overview: They are teenagers and the future of football. SVT chronicles the talent search, a process in which the majority of children are rejected. During the World Cup, 18-year-old Lamine Yamal is one of the tournament's major stars. Meanwhile, an intensive effort is underway to nurture the next generation of stars. At Benfica, players as young as five are scouted. Denmark was an early adopter of viewing academy players as commodities. In the UK, the situation ended so tragically for two young boys that they took their own lives. At home, an intense debate is raging, with the push for early elite-level development dividing the football community.

title: Demon Hunter: Time 2 Kill
overview: On the hunt to find the pieces of a medallion that can end the demonic control over Earth, Taryn is forced to go through time to save the future.

title: Paris Paris
overview: Three men—from China, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Palestine—live together in a squatted apartment in a seemingly abandoned building in Paris. The group is bound together by their shared experience of life in exile and the fleeting nature of their possessions, relationships, and sense of home, but the temporary safe space is threatened by outside forces and events.

title: Delivery Man
overview: Guy, a reclusive food delivery rider, develops feelings for Sai, a woman he delivers to regularly. His obsession soon borders on stalking — even though Sai is already married to Dith.

title: Five Years, Four Months
overview: Martha (45), a mother who lost track of her son due to the conflict, receives the news that there was no bone concordance in the last exhumation she participated in. Exhausted of the institutional channels, she turns to a group of women searchers and meets Sandra, who tells her a rumor: “in a remote village on the flatlands of Colombia, you can request a favour from a dead person”. Together with Sandra, they embark on a journey in search of answers, blurring the line between the living and the dead. Mothers searching for their children, children searching for their mothers: two sides of the same scourge converge in search of peace.

title: GOKDU;spreads its wings
overview: Jang Min-gi has spent his life hiding a secret: he can see the dead. When his estranged father — the last in a line of Kokdu, ritual guardians who escort souls to the afterlife — dies under mysterious circumstances, Min-gi inherits both a worn puppet kit and a burden he never wanted. Drawn into a thirty-year-old betrayal surrounding a burned funeral bier, he must confront an imprisoned soul demanding vengeance.

title: Do Stars Know Fear?
overview: Trapped operative confronts cunning foil amid tense, futuristic space hemisphere.

title: Marave
overview: It follows Manolo, a gentle, naive fairground worker. When their father gets sick, Manolo reunites with his older brother Georges, a con man who abandoned the family twenty years ago. Desperate to prove he is not a failure, Georges schemes to turn the physically strong Manolo into an MMA (Mixed Martial Arts) champion.

title: EXAMSTRESS
overview: Examstress is a short student film created for college, year 2/2. This film is about the stress of exams and typical student mental health during this time. It follows Penn, a procrastinating student, as they work towards their final major project.

title: Our House
overview: Three estranged siblings reunite at the family home for their late mother’s wake, prompting an inheritance battle that turns deadly.

title: Zampano
overview: When his father's old circus company comes back in town, Zampano see's it as a chance to get back on a flying trapeze and to leave with Nina, the trapezist he's in love with. But his father reminds him he has vertigo.

title: Control
overview: A notorious kidnapper has struck again. While a girl was on her way home from school, the kidnapper managed to abduct her. Detective Lucas Fonck is investigating the case and is gathering information from various residents in the neighborhood where the girl lives.  His first interview takes place at the home of a man named Wout de Jonge, and during the interview, both men begin to realize that there is more to the other than meets the eye.

title: Farm House
overview: House sitting can be relaxing, peaceful and refreshing, but terror is here to stay. This Warren County Serial Killings Cases is just one of the most perplexing and tragic chapters in the recent American criminal history.

title: The War Game at Cinecity
overview: When Peter Watkins’ banned nuclear war masterpiece "The War Game" reached Toronto in 1967, it found an unlikely home at Cinecity, a new cinema determined to challenge audiences. Drawing on archival research and eyewitness accounts, this documentary explores the film’s enduring impact and the role Cinecity played in shaping Canadian film culture.

title: 3 Weeks After
overview: When a school trip leaves a group of teenagers stranded far from home, the recent suicide of a classmate begins to expose the fractures, loyalties and secrets holding them together.

title: Learning to Breathe Under Water
overview: Leo is 8. His best friend is a giant shark that his dad, an artist, built in their roof. Leo escapes to fantasy worlds to process his peculiar reality until a spirited au pair challenges him to embrace the wild, wonderful mess of real life.

title: My Friend the Porn Star
overview: Rosa Friedrich was never that interested in porn, until her friend Timo expresses a wish to star in an erotic film. So she agrees to help him get his project off the ground. However, the closer it gets to the shooting date, the more Timo feels embarrassed and doubtful about being involved in the first place. His face is ultimately replaced with the help of AI, and Rosa, together with a dominatrix, three trans women, a food-porn creator, a sex coach and other protagonists, continues with the film.

title: Death Drive
overview: A delivery driver who killed someone, ten moments of that day.

title: If We Ever Make It To Someday
overview: Law student Cassian, can't seem to let go of his high school sweetheart, Victoria, who seems to have moved on without him. And there's this mystery girl that lingers in his mind like perfume in an old house. With the pressure of the future and the state of the world weighing heavily on him, how will Cassian confront everything he's trying to run from?

title: The Incentive
overview: A young journalist and a convincing cameraman plot to film interviews without their company's permission.

title: Knives
overview: A juxtaposition of knives, scissors, weapons, and bombs in photographic format while showing women victims of Iranian attacks in Palestine.

title: Anhedonia
overview: Two teenagers meet one last time before one of them returns to the countryside she so deeply despises. She takes solace in the promise that her lover will soon come to visit her there. Trapped in darkness, she can do nothing but wait. Time passes—and even after death, her tormented spirit lingers earthbound, longing for the moment the two may finally be together again.

title: National Theatre at Home: Summerfolk
overview: It's a hot, beautiful summer in 1905, and Russia's elite retreat to the countryside to swim, sip champagne and start affairs. When they're having this much fun, why care about anything else? But Varvara just can't shake the feeling that their holiday idyll is built on borrowed time. As the party continues, how long can they ignore the storm on the horizon? Deputy Artistic Director Robert Hastie (Standing at the Sky's Edge) directs Maxim Gorky's razor-sharp portrait of class, privilege and denial, revived for 2026 in a new adaptation from Nina Raine (Consent) and Moses Raine (Donkey Heart).

title: Снежинка и снеговик
overview: Long-awaited snow falls in the village. A girl named Erica is building a large snowman with button eyes and a bright carrot. Grandma is preparing Snowflake's dress. The festivities of the New Year's carnival await, and the atmosphere around is filled with the holiday spirit, but gradually the quiet childish joy gives way to adult fear for the life of the snow giant—will the child be able to save him from destruction?

title: Ось
overview: Shy security guard Anton secretly watches the rehearsals of the talented musician Tanya and dreams of one day performing on stage alongside her. His daily life is spent among indifferent people and routine, until one day he discovers he has the ability to telekinesis. But even with his superpowers, Anton faces the reality that the world still remains completely indifferent.

title: Что ты здесь видишь
overview: Upon meeting Masha, Sanya felt something other than anger and apathy for the first time in a long time. But his attempt to keep her turned into an outburst of the very aggression he was trying to escape. Now he must face the consequences, realizing that he had destroyed the most precious thing he had with his own hands.

title: Особые
overview: This summer, a camp opens in a Yaroslavl village at an Orthodox community, where teenagers and families with special needs children live together for several weeks. Everyday life here includes prayers and services, chores and saunas, hikes and campfire songs. Teenagers take a break from their devices and learn to care for others, special needs children experience socializing outside the family, and their mothers are able to share the burden of care for the first time in their lives. Shared work and simple forms of happiness form a shared life, erasing the boundaries between "strong" and "weak," between those who help and those in need. All that remains is life: challenging, but full of love.

title: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You
overview: Jeff Arcuri's rapid-fire wit is nonstop as he balances outrageous jokes with heartfelt reflections on making his wife laugh during her cancer journey.

title: NJPW Tiger Mask's Retirement Match
overview: The event was hosted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) for Tiger Mask's official retirement match, ending his 36-year career on July 7, 2026 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

title: The Leaching
overview: After waking up on her father's isolated forest property with amnesia, Vivian must use her limited memory to piece together the nightmarish truth, all the while being tormented by the undead, a giant leech monster, and her "father."

title: Carmezin
overview: Detective Vivian Carmezin is hired to investigate a case, but ends up getting too involved in it.

title: Cinematic Intelligence
overview: A film student is reluctant to take on the task of creating storyboards after having been pressured into it by his director's friend.

title: Retrograde Battlefield
overview: It centers on a Chinese People's Volunteer Army unit during a past conflict that, despite orders to retreat, embarks on a dangerous mission to re-enter the battlefield and fight to protect their homeland

title: The Hoodoos
overview: When a crew of criminals attempts to steal cursed Confederate gold from a haunted Louisiana plantation, they discover that the voodoo protecting the treasure is terrifyingly real… and the dolls are awake.

title: Cashcade
overview: A burglar on the run accidentally leaves a trail of cash that leads a homeless man into an unexpected discovery.

title: Yayo
overview: Dana and Lydia are facing a serious trust issue in their relationship. After an argument that threatens to tear them apart, Lydia decides to accompany Dana to her grandfather’s house, where his wife has just passed away. There, the elderly man, driven by despair, becomes possessed by a demonic force and begins to hunt them down. Together, they must resolve their differences and learn to trust one another in order to survive.

title: Aracne
overview: Eris is a talented and ambitious young chef who works at the prestigious Medusa restaurant. The restaurant is run by Palas, an experienced chef whose work style clashes with that of our protagonist. Eris enters a culinary duel for Palas’s position, and that’s when a dead spider is discovered on her plate. Eventually, the two open up to each other and reveal their vulnerabilities as they reflect on the price of pursuing their dreams.

title: Mouthing
overview: As a boy and a girl meet at a pool party, something begins to stir underground. Their small talk is soon interrupted by the whispers of a silicon baby doll.

title: Porque ou Por Que Ainda Te Escuto
overview: Two acquaintances embark on a walk with an undefined destination. During the journey, they discuss and reflect on events from their lives.

title: Summer Sparks
overview: Follows a single father and a single mom at Camp Evergreen during a summer cook-off, where cooking mishaps and heartfelt moments lead to an unexpected romantic connection.

title: The Possible Bridges of an Uncertain Future
overview: João got stood up.

title: Backrooms Bigfoot
overview: Two strangers wake up, trapped in the endless backrooms and are hunted by a massive supernatural Bigfoot creature lurking in the maze. As reality breaks around them, they must fight to survive and find a way out before it kills them.

title: Genuïns, això és una altra lliga
Before America
overview: Before America is a cinematic documentary uncovering the Indigenous histories of Michigan long before the United States existed. From the 1763 uprising at Fort Michilimackinac to Odawa trail trees and the overlooked women of Fort Detroit, the film reveals how Anishinaabe nations shaped Great Lakes history and helped spark the chain of events that ultimately pushed the American colonies.

title: Unexposed
overview: Gunawan, a man widely admired for his kindness and impeccable reputation, is relentlessly pursued by a mysterious killer before ultimately meeting a brutal end. As the truth unfolds, however, it is revealed that the killer is not acting at random but is seeking revenge. Behind Gunawan's mask of virtue lies a sexual predator whose actions drove the killer's younger sister to take her own life. Shielded by his wealth, influence, and social standing, Gunawan escaped legal consequences. In the end, the mysterious killer becomes the one who delivers the justice that the law failed to provide.

title: Fumaça Fotogênica
overview: A young man reflects on his father's vices and memories while dealing with his desire to belong.

title: Lighthouse Eyes
overview: During a trip to a waterfall, a couple of women come across mystical creatures that challenge the bond they share.

title: Last Viewing
overview: A sleazy film director hires out a ramshackle cinema to screen his forgotten masterpiece, only for the film to be haunted.

title: Disparejos
overview: Celeste can't fall asleep because of Andrés' loud breathing. To help her drift off, he tells her the story of Rojitas, a boy who ventures into the whimsical world of Sokotown to find his missing sock.

title: Truck Driver
overview: A hybrid film that paints a collective portrait of people who share a strange dimension of time within the silence of the asphalt wilderness – at motels, on the side of the road, and in tire shops, savoring the pure joy of the present moment while longing for loved ones far away.

title: Moana
overview: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

title: L'écologie des sentiments
overview: Lola, a young animal rights activist, mysteriously travels to Paris during the Salon de l'Agriculture. As she settles into her hotel room, where nothing works, she calls on the room boy, Felix, a whimsical young man who is having a panic attack on his bed.

title: Microstar
overview: A struggling beauty influencer, Gabriel Rose dreams of becoming an actor. But he lacks both the talent and the connections. After yet another failed audition, he meets Stanislas, a privileged young man from the upper class, who offers him the chance to launch a jewelry brand. Gabriel sees this as an opportunity to gain access to Parisian high society, where everything seems easy, at least on the surface… Meanwhile, he becomes involved with Pauline, a young political ecology researcher. Torn between two worlds, Gabriel searches for his place between image and reality, the desire for success, and the need for love.

title: La chaleur
overview: It’s unusually hot on the beaches of the Landes, and 17-year-old Marouane is spending his last day at the campground with a nagging fear: will the body he buried on the beach the day before be discovered? Marouane also wonders if he might be falling in love with the charming Giulia.

title: Samson and Delilah
overview: A young woman working in an elite nightclub uses her beauty and intelligence to exploit and steal from wealthy customers.

title: You Have Her Eyes
overview: A woman's fears about having children begin to manifest as visions of her dead grandmother.

title: The Glimmering
overview: A man who studies Mongolian history enjoys happy life with his wife. But one day after the president declares martial law, he loses his wife in a sudden accident. Struck by the immense shock, he loses his ability to speak. Now, the man must find his voice again in order to speak with the spirit of his departed wife.

title: The Priest: Thanksgiving Massacre
overview: A family gather to spend Thanksgiving at an isolated cabin, unaware that the site has a horrific history of murder and cannibalism and that the Priest responsible did not rest in peace. Now they are on the menu for Thanksgiving dinner.

title: Мон
overview: A young talented musician, Alina, gets a chance to build a career abroad. However, her plans change when she learns that her grandmother, Nuria, suffers from Alzheimer's disease. Returning to her homeland of Tatarstan, Alina tries to restore her grandmother's memory and fulfill her wish—to find the "treasure" buried in her native village. The problem, however, is that the village has long been flooded.

title: Last Stop for the Circular Ticket
overview: Around Lake Como, a voyage interrupted by a series of brief, successive stops, as fleeting as musical phrases. Someone enters and leaves a telephone booth. Water and the lines that contain it.

title: Blog
overview: Fedya is a failed business psychologist. During one of his training sessions, while intoxicated, he makes a scene and becomes a laughing stock in the eyes of those around him. In his blog, Fedya broadcasts the "secrets of success," but he himself has long lost control of his life. His daughter Sonya is a withdrawn, problematic teenager. After her mother's death, an insurmountable wall grew between her and her father, and her grandfather took upon himself the girl's upbringing. After a fight with her peers, Sonya risks ending up in a penal colony - to avoid punishment, she is sent to a summer correctional program at a provincial school. Fedya goes with his daughter: to look after her and at the same time work as a school psychologist until the information noise around his name dies down. There is one summer ahead that can change everything.

title: The Red Anorak
overview: An oracle in the Paris of May ’68 and the back of a stranger in a Madrid nightclub in the early 1990s. Interwoven stories bound by a gentle attraction, as though desire permeated everything and the only law was that of necessity.

title: Night in the Valley of Witches
overview: This film is set in the Valley of the Witches area within Ghibli Park and is the first original animated short film created by Studio Ghibli specifically for the park.

title: What Am I Looking At? Is It Someone’s Navel?
overview: While attempting to record life as it was, Arthur unintentionally documents his family’s unraveling.

title: EASTER
overview: Seokja runs the transgender club Yeobo in Seoul’s Itaewon district. Now 68 years old, she has spent her life defying social norms. A young man embarks with her on a journey through her memories and into a world where such norms do not exist.

title: Staubwelt
overview: An elderly crime investigator has reached the end of her career. Shortly after stepping down, she encounters the Devil, who has appeared in the city and begun working as a police photographer. During a series of walks together, a warmth develops between them. Over the course of their conversations, the Devil reveals he needs her help to end his own existence.

title: Carnal Inferno
overview: The tale of Mark Benway, a boxer who takes a punch that sends him into a world no man wants to go and one that he may never leave.

title: Ontari E-Kaki
overview: A lonely, unemployed young man seeks comfort online, only to find himself trapped in the very culture he once laughed at.

title: Hijamat
overview: Fifty-year-old Murad’s life is shaken to the core when he learns that his younger brother is gay. Murad would like to support his brother, but their traditional Muslim family is against it. As a result, he finds himself subjected to pressures from all sides – from his father, who has close ties to the local imam, and from his brother’s circle of friends as well. He would like to help everyone, but as he slowly falls into a spiral of conflicts and mounting difficulties, he finds that he, too, is in need of help. Another integral part of this family drama is the theme of migration and dialogue – not just between different religions, but within communities themselves.

title: My Little Nothing
overview: Two voices, one written, the other synthesised, engage in a philosophical dialogue about the amorous abyss separating them: a nineteen-year-old girl has decided to marry the Devil.

title: To Become Ghosts
overview: A group of communist militants debate becoming a clandestine organization at the beginning of a new wave of state repression.

title: L’amour aurait suffi même à Nietzsche
overview: “Love is not made to console, no doubt — it is made to save. But we know all too well that one is only ever saved once. And only for as long as that once endures.” Inspired by The Eternal Return, Michel Surya’s novel, the film is a portrait of the book itself.

title: The Crowd
overview: A filmmaker accidentally comes across a ruined village where silent souls refuse to revive the past. The remnants of a film shot years earlier constitute the only clue to understanding what once happened there.

title: Permanent Trespass
overview: Two “professional mourners” meet within the ominous setting of an Art Nouveau villa. Who — or what — is being mourned? From Beirut to Sarajevo, what first appeared to be an intimate encounter gradually transforms into a singular confrontation with History.

title: The Clearing
overview: Sumatra, early twentieth century. The exploitation of rubber by Dutch colonisers leads to the sexual enslavement of female workers. Archival and contemporary images intertwine in a documentary fabulation that plunges into the depth of a long-erased history.

title: Letters from an Inner Exile
overview: A photographer’s journey between past and present, as she develops a project on the concentration camps of the Spanish dictatorship, gradually reveals a cartography of the memory of the defeated.

title: Chants fantômes
overview: This film-poem is composed of visual and sonic fragments in which landscapes, everyday gestures and distorted songs weave an inventory of loss. Between silence and vertigo, the past resurfaces. Pain, resistance and beauty persist within the absences carved out by colonialism.

title: If Everyone Goes Away
overview: For forty years, the filmmaker’s mother devoted herself to others, first as a primary school teacher and later as the disability coordinator within her school. Her decision to leave the public sector becomes the occasion for a generous portrait that reveals a system in crisis.

title: A Requiem in Bishkek
overview: An Indian refugee living in the capital of Kyrgyzstan, witness to the political instability surrounding him, drifts into a melancholic and elegiac meditation on his condition as a foreigner. Film stock is his last refuge.

title: Last stop for the circular ticket
overview: Around Lake Como, a voyage interrupted by a series of brief, successive stops, as fleeting as musical phrases. Someone enters and leaves a telephone booth. Water and the lines that contain it.

title: Nothing to Lose
overview: She gave everything to become a mother, so when her young son falls ill, Jada will stop at  nothing to find a donor and save him — no matter the cost.

title: Hospital Británico
overview: A man leaves the hospital. He sets out on a journey, perhaps a final one. Alongside the mystical landscapes drift the verses of Hospital Británico (1986), the last book by Héctor Viel Temperley. And the words of those who have been marked by reading it over the years.

title: As the Spring Arrives, Water Recalls the Nomads
overview: A heterogeneous group of shepherds travels through the Çukurova valley in Turkey, following in the footsteps of their nomadic ancestors. Between archives and imaginary correspondence, the film becomes an echo of the memory and disappearance of pastoral ecosystems.

title: The Construction Site
overview: For a year and a half, the filmmaker documented the construction of a future residential facility for young autistic adults. At the same time, she spent time with her daughter Pénélope, a future resident there. Questions of architecture intersect with the realities of autism.

title: Boyuna
overview: Marseille, 2135. Following the disappearance of most terrestrial ecosystems, the Boyuna corporation offers survivors an escape into a world where they can relive dreams of the past alongside extinct animals.

title: Chronicle of Tiredness
overview: The land belongs to those who work it. But what about houses, homes, the place where one can rest and start a family? Image and sound unfold the history of the underlying structures that turn the right to a home into a tool of control, exploitation or dispossession.

title: Dentro de lo azul
overview: Two women separate. Their memories resurface tirelessly. A portrait of separation seen through the prism of sapphic nostalgia.

title: Letter to Glauber Rocha
overview: Twists and turns through Giorgia Meloni's Rome, a two-voiced letter addressed to the Brazilian filmmaker Glauber Rocha fifty years after his Roman film Claro; political voices and gestures from the Rome of 2023-2025. "The bird of eternity does not exist — only the real is eternal."

title: I Couldn’t Draw You A Map
overview: In the divided city of Mitrovica, Kosovo, fragments of a diary, everyday gestures and sounds gathered from the city compose an exploration of separation on multiple levels: political, territorial and emotional.

title: The Prehensible (The Text is Thunder)
overview: From Kabbalah to negative theology, from Walter Benjamin to Jacques Derrida, from lightning to thunder, fragments of a witty reflection on the notion of beginning.

title: Little Poems in Prose
overview: An anthology of black humour by Radu Jude and Andrei Rus, revealing the inexhaustibly grotesque energy of TikTok (including in the age of the deepfake).

title: Where Life Holds
overview: Monica Maurer and Cahide Ozel are bound together by images. Those of the Kurdish struggle that Cahide lacks, and those that Monica restores and preserves for the Palestinian people. Cinema as resistance to disappearance; a film as a safe place for fragile memory.

title: A River and a Queen
overview: A river: the Esla. A region: Tierra de la Reina. A dam and a wildfire, destruction from water and destruction from fire, two ways of losing paradise. A forest saved by a miracle and a valley in danger. Local people who write and a stranger who reads, listens and looks.

title: A Body of One's Own
overview: Elise moves like a dancer, very slowly, refusing a treatment whose side effects she fears, along with the lectures of her doctors. The camera works in harmony with her rhythm, with the movement of her thought, accompanying and sustaining throughout the film the permanent reinvention of her way of being in the world and of facing illness.

title: Bleda y Rosa. A Place, an Image
overview: Bleda y Rosa are one of the most significant Spanish visual artist couples of their generation. They are working on the installation of an out-of-context structure in the middle of the Valencian landscape. Of this entire process, only a single photograph must remain.

title: Pure Reason
overview: Starting from a fragment of wall and a daily ritual, an experiment in the perception of colour. How do light and time construct it?

title: Get to Work
overview: A man struggles in his bathroom through a severe panic attack as he desperately tries to work through it and get to work on time.

title: Cat's Blood (Proof of Concept)
overview: Through the eyes of William Maves, the personal driver of Nico Marchesi, we follow a deadly clash between two rival families in South Africa, where blackmail, betrayal, and revenge turn love, loyalty, and blood into weapons—and one misstep can be fatal.

title: How to Get Filthy Rich with Gary Stevenson
overview: In this provocative state-of-the-nation film, Stevenson travels across the country meeting those most affected by the widening wealth gap, alongside multi-millionaires and billionaires who sit at the other end of the economic spectrum.  Having made millions during his career in finance, Stevenson now campaigns against the expanding divide between rich and poor, and examines what he believes is driving inequality in Britain today.  The documentary sees him engage with economists, financiers, public sector workers and individuals from across society, going head-to-head with critics of his views while also hearing from those who support his proposed solutions.  At the heart of the film is Stevenson’s belief that meaningful change requires a wealth tax, with the super-rich contributing more to address what he sees as a broken system.

title: Братья
overview: At summer camp, eleven-year-old Dima is used to protecting his older brother, Semyon, a teenager with special needs. After a humiliating conflict with their peers, the brothers head into the forest, where they must confront their own fears, resentments, and unspoken love for each other. This is a story about growing up, the fragility of family ties, and the search for intimacy in a world that isn't always willing to accept those who are different.

title: Lino D’Italia - Storia di un itALIENO
Le meilleur du festival We Love Green
Giorgio Moroder & Donna Summer : I Feel Love
overview: A look back at the meeting in Munich in 1977 between composer and producer Giorgio Moroder and singer Donna Summer, which was to result, amongst other global hits, in the extraordinary “I Feel Love”.

title: Bean
overview: Triggered by a baked bean on her best friend’s face, Meadhbh is forced to question their connection – and whether there’s anything left of it at all.

title: Bigfoot Lover
overview: A heartbroken and lonely Cute is struggling to escape self-destructive patterns in her love life when she meets Bigfoot.

title: Street of Dreams
overview: After her life is disrupted, Calle is seen holding on to soccer as a source of purpose and possibility. As she navigates uncertainty and self-doubt, she is guided by Sir David Beckham who appears as a personification of her inner voice, a guardian only she can see. He’s a powerful symbol of belief and opportunity, standing with her and showing up when it matters.

title: Messi and Haaland's similarity on the pitch
overview: Erling Haaland and Lionel Messi are scoring heaps of goals at the World Cup. And the two global stars share a similar habit—images that have garnered significant attention in the football world.

title: Behind the Rain
overview: A brutal sexual murder of a minor revolts the anger of the town. On the other hand, a psychologist, Sofia Belmar is not only shocked by the event, but this also brings back some of her more gruesome memories.

title: The Invite
overview: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

title: Az Zeeb
overview: The filmmaker, a Chilean of Jewish and Palestinian descent, discovers Super 8 reels belonging to his father’s family. Between Chile, Israel and Palestine, he reconstructs two trajectories shaped by displacement and exile. A lesson in history in which clarity emerges from political complexity.

title: Peddi
overview: In a village that doesn't officially exist, a laborer's unmatched athletic talent becomes his weapon to fight for his people's right to be recognized.

title: Evil Dead Burn
overview: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.

title: Hungry
overview: A high school wrestling coach must overcome addictive behavior in ordere to lead his team to a championship.

title: Neon Banana
overview: A seemingly innocent online interaction quickly turns precarious.

title: I, Nobody
overview: Rajeevan, an ordinary government employee, witnesses something he was never meant to see and is thrust into the centre of a serious crime. Branded a troublemaker and hunted by the system, he must protect his family while fighting to survive against forces far beyond his control.

title: Saccharine
overview: After succumbing to an obscure weight-loss craze involving the eating of human ashes, lovelorn medical student Hana finds herself haunted by the ghost of the person she's eating.

title: Narcisa's Will
overview: Haunted by memories of her recently deceased mother, former star Narcisa, Ana decides to sell the childhood mansion she inherited and share the proceeds with her brother, Diego. However, the grim cleansing process reveals a legacy quite different from what she imagined.

title: Foufo
overview: The encounter of Madurese residents with small aliens that triggers hilarious chaos and unexpected adventures.

title: Infiltrate
overview: In a city overrun by crime, government Agent Lily Chen is forced to choose between her duty and her family when her husband is kidnapped, and she’s blackmailed into assassinating high-level criminals to save him. As she delves deeper into the criminal underworld, Lily’s relentless pursuit of justice unravels a web of corruption, leading to a final, life-altering decision that will change her world forever.

title: Korean Haunted Hospital
overview: A group of Indonesians: Juna, Adit, Bara, Arum, Yuri, and Tyas set out to live-stream a test of courage at the so-called most haunted hospital in South Korea, Yong-Won Hospital. Rumor has it that the hospital was once a front for a cult whose members chose to die following their leader. Now, the hospital is in a state of disrepair and no one dares to enter. This motivates Juna and his friends to become the first people to live-stream there.

title: First Light
overview: An elderly nun witnesses a young construction worker's fatal accident, compelling her to question the ethical principles of the institution she has devoted her life to.

title: Faraway Home
overview: Two young Jewish children are sent by their parents away from Nazi occupied Austria during WWII, on the Kindertransport, where they end up at a refugee farm in Northern Ireland.

title: Somewhere Between Sleep
overview: Anke is about to leave her small German town in the Black Forest region, while Lisa finds it hard to feel at home there. They meet by chance on a cold, grey autumn day, and wander the streets together. Cracks in the thin membrane between reality and dream transform their stroll into a journey to new places.

title: Shush, Now
overview: A seven year old girl discovers her mum is having an affair.

title: Untitled
overview: Short for Portuguese television channel Canal180's "Jogo Cruzado" series.

title: Pemikat Jiwa
overview: Jay uses a forbidden love potion to make Wulan love him. However, the ritual instead binds Wulan's soul to a supernatural force that threatens her life, forcing Jay to face the horrific consequences of his actions.

title: Urchins
overview: Follows a college freshman as they embark on a road trip with new friends, finding a renewed life purpose.

title: Трасса «Море — море»
overview: A red convertible is speeding from St. Petersburg to Sochi, driven by the brazen photographer Tyoma. With him are his ex-wife, Sasha, and her new fiancé. Tyoma will do anything to prevent Sasha's new wedding. And the fatal hitchhiker Kira, rescued by the guys, will help him. Tyoma has only one way across the country to change and win back the love of his life-if his brakes don't fail.

title: Unanswered//butterfly
overview: The world’s first full-dive VRMMO, Sword Art Online—known as SAO. What was meant to be a dream come true has instead transformed into a deadly game where dying in the virtual world means dying in reality. Emirun and Rex, who once knew each other in the real world, reunite by chance within SAO. They join a scouting party to learn how to survive in this unforgiving world. One day, however, they encounter a mysterious PK known only as the Black Swordsman. When Emirun rushes to the scene, she finds Rex collapsed in despair, and the Black Swordsman standing over him. The one who wiped out their entire scouting party... was the Black Swordsman! Determined to avenge their fallen comrades, Emirun and Rex seek out the legendary prodigy swordswoman Asuna, and begin intense training under her guidance. In a death game where even players turn against one another, what new beginning will these two reach at the end of their struggle…?

title: Дети наши
overview: Every year, approximately 48,000 children end up in orphanages. Some find families, others remain in the orphanage until they reach adulthood, and only then set out on their own. But how can you become independent in the adult world without an adult? How do you manage your daily life if you don't know one? How do you find work and save money? And what about finding friends and love? Psychologists, foundation leaders, and the children themselves will discuss the subtle difficulties, stereotypes, and adaptation outside of orphanages. This film is an inside look at the problem of orphanhood in Russia—the perspective of people who are tackling it right now.

title: Doppelgänger
overview: Two people with the same face live completely different lives. When a horrible incident happens, one of the two finds herself stepping into shoes that aren't hers.

title: Uma Princesa
overview: Ten years in the life of Helena Verkoff, according to some of her biographers.

title: Isso não é um violão
overview: The virtuoso guitarist Artur Miranda Azzi shatters the conventions of classical guitar, reinventing the instrument as a dynamic medium for avant-garde experimentation. Through six bold and innovative performances of contemporary works, Azzi dismantles traditional techniques, transforming the guitar into a living, evolving entity—one that defies expectations at every turn.

title: Simulacra
overview: Nula is a student who has feelings for her old friend, Joel. One day she is caught in a recurring incident while she is with Joel. When Nula finds out that Joel is ready to express his feelings to his crush, that's where the incident continues to repeat itself and stops when Nula feelings that she has been keeping hidden, she expresses to Joel.

title: Election Day
overview: On the election night that will decide her political fate, MP Renata Innocenti sees her career teetering on the brink of ruin when her partner becomes the center of a massive media scandal. Amidst family tensions and political chaos, Renata must fight to save everything she has built.

title: Mother, You Have Not Died Yet. But You Will. And When You Do, You Will Finally Be Alive Again.
overview: In the Indian township of Durban, where post-apartheid violence still simmers, Lishana cares for her dying mother. Through her photographic practice, she reflects on life and death, past and present, navigating between the tangible and the mystical.

title: Chicken Soup
overview: Lili, a young French woman, lives in New York between odd jobs and coffees with friends while overstaying her visa. A chance encounter with two police officers tips her — and the film itself — into another dimension.

title: Only the Serpent Knows
overview: Two brothers reunite in their childhood home to speak about the incest one of them suffered there as a child. Over the course of a single day, their conversation intertwines the most difficult questions with the boldest theories, delving deep into our religious and mythological history.

title: Crossings : Kaleh Ziyarat
overview: Between the Caspian Sea and the Strait of Hormuz, through the reanimation of archives and documentary observation, a frenetic plunge into the parallel economies of a region shaped by imperial ambitions and survival instincts.

title: The B-side of the Landscape
overview: Every day, an aging filmmaker whose eyesight is deteriorating spends long hours in a retail park. He waits for his wife, who teaches drawing. A portrait in and of a non-place, shot on 16mm between the supermarket and the carwash, meditations and reveries.

title: Letters to Etel
overview: Fouad Elkoury is a photographer, Etel Adnan was a writer and painter — both Lebanese, and friends. After Etel’s death, Fouad writes letters to her. Then comes the genocide in Gaza. Her Arab Apocalypse and his photographs resonate together in an attempt to confront the tragedy.

title: Hidden materials
overview: Banned languages, books telling stories of alien children, and strange sculptures that resemble spaceships. The history of the suppression of the Basque language during Franco’s dictatorship opens the door to the invisible.

title: A Man Jumps into the Water
overview: On 10 December 2024, at around two o’clock in the afternoon, a homeless man immerses himself in a lake in a Buenos Aires park and disappears. From this news item, the filmmaker reflects on the films that will never be made and those that may still be possible.

title: You Dreamt You Saw Yourself But Couldn’t See Your Face
overview: A quiet whistling returned from childhood; the calm of a sky and a river dissolving into one another, from which emerges the image of a loved one. For the duration of a reflection, the water reveals memories and offers the delicacy of a glimpse into the course of a life.

title: Extinctions of Blue
overview: What if blue were disappearing from the spectrum? Through images and narratives blending visual poetry, irony and reflections on the disappearance of blue — and, with it, of living things — the film sketches out a meditation on the language of colours that we share.

title: Doing What?
overview: A political demonstration in Argentina. A couple attempts to understand one another through landscapes. In Marseille, a young man asks another: doing what ? A cat watches the scene from behind a window. A poem for a utopia of disagreement.

title: Almost with You
overview: Still devastated by the recent death of his brother, an Irish singer-songwriter on a solo tour of Australia finds himself in a remote West Australian town with 5 days off before the final show of the tour.

title: Girls, We're Killing It!
overview: In her desperate attempts at finding community during her college years, Adele decides to join The Girls--an exclusive sorority who are the source of dark and twisted rumors. But as the rituals begin, the lines between an elitist club and a cult blur and our heroine finds herself at a point of no return.

title: DUMPED
overview: As Glenn sits by himself in a park after having his relationship come to an end, his mate Chris appears and takes him on a day out to help get his mind off the whole ordeal.

title: The Night I Learned To Fly
overview: One night, Lúcio and his mask look for answers. Between what's real and surreal, Sun navigates in his world, also looking to be seen.

title: Babesmilk
overview: After an ice cream outburst gets her arrested, an entitled woman grapples with the wreckage of her own behavior.

title: Qadira
overview: Sukant returns from a work trip and finds out that his partner, Tara, has ended their relationship and left. The heartbreak, combined with his failing startup, builds up to a point where he tries to end his life. But then he receives an unexpected phone call.

title: Was von uns übrig bleibt
overview: After a major argument with her childhood friend, an emotionally guarded woman begins to question the power dynamics at play, risking not only her circle of friends but also the relationship with her new girlfriend.

title: Open Ending
overview: A teenage girl who has felt different for as long as she can remember becomes isolated after years of bullying and loneliness. Everything changes when she discovers cinema, a place that helps her find hope, peace, and a way back to herself.

title: An Mháthair
overview: When confronted with the young man who took her son away from her, a grieving mother must stop him before he strikes again.

title: Peace, Peace!
overview: An hour before their mother's funeral, three siblings are forced to reckon with the horrifying reality of their childhood.

title: Bad Luck
overview: A suicidal taxi driver must confront his own mortality when he finds himself complicit in the attempted murder of a diabetic cat

title: Nocaretown
overview: In the surreal town of Nocaretown, a group of bizarre characters become entangled in a dangerous, absurd quest centered on a mysterious wooden box.

title: Note From a Gutter Boy
overview: After a young man is murdered in a violent street brawl in Melbourne's western suburbs, his best friend Tommy recounts the circumstances that led to his demise during a court-ordered group therapy session.

title: Murder Game
overview: Three years ago, assassin Tide betrayed her organization by refusing to carry out a kill order. After escaping death, she adopted the alias Minghui and lived in seclusion in a small town with her blind sister Mingzhu, running a coffee shop. An accident exposes their whereabouts, and former accomplices track them down, catching Mingzhu in a manhunt. To save her sister, Chao Xi is forced to return to the killing game, and her hidden identity is revealed amidst the gunfire.

title: Sludge
overview: Sinead Murphy’s debut film, Sludge, follows a young homeless woman living on the fringes of Irish society and deeply in love with her best friend. Haunted by fractured traumatic memories and visions of a dark-hooded figure, she struggles to hold onto reality as her friend is drawn into the orbit of a dangerous underworld. As her world unravels, she must confront the terrifying truth behind the figure that stalks her, and face the darkness within.

title: Mukhbir: The Story of a Spy - The Movie
overview: After the Sino-Indian war, a highly trained Indian spy enters Pakistan on a mission to gather crucial intelligence and stop Pakistan from launching an attack against India. Will he succeed?

title: Bump
overview: An expectant mother's world fractures as she obsesses over what her child's future might cost the planet - and what the planet might cost her child.

title: Macha
overview: Dismissed after surgery for endometriosis and left without answers,Ana draws on the strength of Macha to reclaim her voice and confront the system ignoring her pain, while her father grapples with the helplessness of loving someone he cannot heal.

title: The Egotist
overview: Poor and tired, Amaro finds himself in the need of moving. Along the way he takes part in conversations that make him reflect on his changing position in society and on the anxieties of a young adult.

title: The Widowmaker
overview: An influencer, Cassia, desperately seeking clout, plays a dangerous game with a dark web seller in this found footage thriller short.

title: Heard
overview: A group of girls are dancing in a field, when suddenly one of them is harmed after seeking shelter from a storm. Struggling to keep up with the herd after the incident, she must choose whether to stay or to face the unknown.

title: Winnipeg, Seeds of Hope
overview: At the end of the Spanish Civil War, almost half a million people moved by fear of reprisals to France. A hundred thousand of them were children. The French Government overflowed by the human avalanche, put them in improvised refugee camps. Chilean poet Pablo Neruda, former consul in Spain before the war, convinced the President of Chile to save more than two thousand refugees. The film tells the story of Julia, a little girl that escapes Barcelona with his father, a young widower. They embarked on the Winnipeg, a ship chartered by Neruda. That saved them from a dark future in Europe. Now, she is “a daughter of Neruda”, as the descendants of the 2,200 refugees call themselves.

title: The Floaters
overview: Struggling musician Nomi accepts a last-resort job from her overachiever best friend Mara: mentoring misfit campers, the “Floaters,” at their childhood Jewish summer camp. As the camp struggles to survive amidst competition with a longtime rival, Nomi, the Floaters, and Mara must overcome their differences to bring the community together and save the camp.

title: Baby Doe
overview: At 22, Gail gave birth alone and left her newborn in the woods. Decades later, she's arrested for murder, despite claiming the baby was stillborn. This documentary explores the fallout when young women cannot accept the reality of an unplanned pregnancy.

title: The Misadventures of Girth Brooks
overview: Prequel short film to “BUM” (2025)

title: Dhamaal 4
overview: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

title: The convent
overview: Lucía and Ana Ma, two young postulants recently arrived at a small convent, find themselves involved in the strange events that occur there.

title: Down the Long River
overview: In the aftermath of the Civil War, a former Army surgeon, a notorious gang, and a duplicitous Pinkerton agent cross paths in a tiny river town. When revenge and a fortune in gold are at stake, the town is caught in the crossfire.

title: The Isolate Thief
overview: A young woman struggles to conceal the gold she stole from a group of violent outlaws who have seized control of her remote outpost.

title: Lenin
overview: In a village trapped by generations of bloodshed, a determined young man dares to challenge the traditions fueling an endless cycle of violence.

title: Idhayam Murali
overview: A young man navigates the complexities of unrequited love, finding that even as years pass and life takes unexpected turns, certain emotions remain deeply embedded in his heart.

title: Trigger
overview: A disillusioned ex-soldier, Wyatt Kane, retreats into the woods, only to class with a team of State Police protecting a corrupt logging company. As tensions rise, Kane uncovers a conspiracy that forces him to fight for justice- no matter the cost.

title: Love on a Tightrope
overview: In 1960s Spain, legendary trapecist Pinito del Oro hires young poet Natalia Sosa Ayala to help with her memoirs, sparking a profound emotional bond between them. Through historical events, intimate encounters, and decades of letters, their admiration, affection, and creative passion intertwine. The story moves between memory, desire, and imagination, showing how these two artists influence each other’s quests for freedom, artistic expression, and recognition. Rooted in real moments but told with a dreamlike, imaginative lens, it explores what might have been between them, revealing a tender, evocative tale of connection, longing, and the courage to defy societal constraints.

title: L'incasable
overview: Humiliated by feeling rejected yet again, 14-year-old Solal gets into a fight with Thomas, a counselor at his home. Joris, his 10-year-old roommate, fascinated by Solal, has no intention of letting him go.

title: Ikka
overview: With a loved one's life at stake, a celebrated lawyer must defend a man he suspects is guilty — battling his conscience every step of the way.

title: Aajo Ardhangini
overview: Set against the backdrop of an unexpected wedding invitation, a chance reunion after two years of estrangement forces two women to confront their deeply entangled, hidden past. As their unresolved history resurfaces in the shadows of the Chatterjee household, an unsuspecting husband finds himself increasingly caught in a web of unspoken anxieties.

title: The making of "The Kaptain: The story of Francesco Silvestre"
overview: The story behind the production of "Il Kapitano: Una dedica a Francesco Silvestre" (2025)

title: Pinjar
overview: ‘Pinjar’ is an evocative meditation on captivity—of bodies, of spirits, of choices—unfolding through the entangled lives of five individuals and a wild bird.

title: Goblin II
overview: Five years later, Sara and Sam face off against a familiar foe amidst a village in chaos, risking everything to protect what they love as evil rises again.

title: Love Oh Love
overview: A couple is in love. One partner's excessive spending pushes the other into debt. When the burdened partner decides to seek a divorce, the other files a police complaint through the leader of a women's association. As they begin living together, they gradually understand each other's struggles. Eventually, they reconcile and choose to continue their life together.

title: All the Queens Houses
overview: A photographic exploration of Queens’ unconventional architecture reveals the borough’s beauty through the eyes of an architect while uncovering the deeper history behind its strange and spectacular designs.

title: F.-M. Banier filmé par A. Arietta
overview: In 2015, Arrietta portrayed his friend François-Marie Banier — his studio, his photographs, his paintings — with a Mekas-like freshness and cheerful detachment. Ten years on, a visit to a country house adds another piece to the fragmentary account of a life shaped by encounters and friendships.

title: Night Nurse
overview: As a series of perverse scam calls unsettles an idyllic retirement community, a starry-eyed nurse becomes entangled with her mysterious patient.

title: Lads Being Lads
overview: The series follows four close friends who live in the all too depressing yet fictional village of Greyville, Ireland. The kind of place you would expect barely anything to happen. title: Life Support
overview: Since October 2023, Gaza has been sealed from the world-except for one group. International doctors breach the blockade, what they find is not just a humanitarian crisis, but a calculated dismantling of life itself.

title: Trophy

One day, at an exchange event with a Japanese school, she befriends Mirai, a Japanese girl who shares her love of K-pop. Through this encounter, So-hee gradually begins to connect with the world beyond her own. As their friendship deepens, the two decide to sell unused items from So-hee's home on a flea market app to earn money for their favorite K-pop idols live tickets. One item fetches an unexpectedly high price-a North Korean CD, which is So-hee's father's. Sanju, the father, is the principal of a Korean elementary school. Emboldened by this success, So-hee and Mirai take it a step further, eventually selling even the medal that Sanju had been awarded by his homeland, North Korea.

title: SHIBOYUGI: Playing Death Games to Put Food on the Table - 44: CLOUDY BEACH
overview: Overcoming the jinx known as the "Thirty Game Wall," which drastically reduces the survival rate of players, Yuuki continues her journey. A game where death is always close at hand. Next, she takes on a remote island in the middle of the ocean. Eight players have gathered there. Among them are seasoned veterans whom Yuuki knows. The game is "Cloudy Beach." Beyond the wall, only those who have crossed the wall remain. Today, once again, she makes a living playing deadly games.

Using excerpts from the radio communications alongside intimate footage from combat, the film offers a rare glimpse into the inner lives of soldiers in the aftermath of October 7th.

Things change when he meets Marija, a high society college student, with whom he starts a whirlwind romance with, gaining a whole new world of possibilities in the process. But, as time goes on, his facade begins to slip away and Vigo is forced to get into increasingly deeper criminal waters to sustain his image.

What begins as a minor inconvenience slowly transforms into an absurd journey through identical floors, quiet reflections and strange encounters. As he searches the concrete maze, reality starts to bend around him. A mysterious figure appears and disappears, offering riddles instead of answers, while the outside world waits for his return.  Trapped in a cycle of repetition and frustration, Lennart is forced to confront a growing sense of hopelessness. As the search continues, the missing car becomes more than a lost vehicle. It becomes a reflection of a man struggling to regain his control in a world that seems to move forward without him.  Misfortune in Life, for a Man Who Suffers in Silence is an absurdist drama about hopelessness, loss of control, and the quiet fear of being left behind.

Simon struggles to preserve peace in the city while protecting those closest to him. Can he overcome betrayal and reconcile the forces tearing his world apart before it is too late?

overview: Through nearly a thousand found footage videos from the early internet, filmmaker Marcus Batto recreates the day of Michael Jackson's passing, assembling a vast, fragmented portrait of the cultural earthquake. Equal parts elegy, musical, and excavation into the death of the King of Pop from the lens of strangers, critics and bystanders.

overview: A begrudgingly adept, family outcast and her overbearing mother struggle to find connection as their Vietnamese American family reunites for a wedding celebration.

overview: Exploring the lives of stray cats in Athens and beyond, ACROPOLIS CATS AND OTHER WONDROUS CREATURES examines the tenderness and tragedies in human-animal relationships. It reflects on love, cruelty, compassion, and what we can learn about freedom in a rapidly changing world.

title: UFC 329: McGregor vs. Holloway 2
overview: UFC 329: McGregor vs. Holloway 2 was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on July 11, 2026, at the T-Mobile Arena in Paradise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Valley, United States.

title: Dante: 500 Miles on Psychedelics
overview: A man embarks on a grueling 500 mile run through the desert using psychedelics to push his physical and mental limits. While he battles his inner demons and the harsh terrain, he seeks redemption, aiming to prove that human potential is limitless and to challenge the stigma surrounding unconventional healing.

title: Speaking Dead
overview: When a massive terror threat paralyzes downtown Seoul, former forensic scientist Jang Jae-wook arrives trailing a mysterious suitcase—containing a dead body instead of explosives. The dark shadow of a decade-old military incident comes to light, revealing a massive web of corruption spun by a deeply entrenched cartel of power. As the dead begin to speak, the buried truth is finally dragged into the light.

title: I Can't Say No to Myself
overview: Zohar, a young dancer, arrives in Berlin to visit her best friend Shira. She meets Gillen, an insecure German poet, and together with Shira’s boyfriend, the four form a friendship that, for a moment, makes anything seem possible. But as the bond between Zohar and Gillen deepens, the bubble they have built around themselves begins to unravel. When a violent incident reveals sides of each other, they had never seen before, the two refuse to let go. What begins as an attempt to repair their relationship, culminates in an intimate and extreme event that will change them both. An intimate portrait of young people searching for belonging and meaning in the world, struggling with the gap between fantasy and reality.

title: I Am Neo
overview: Neo was three and a half years old when a devastating car accident left him with a severe brainstem injury. After five days suspended between life and death, he wakes up unable to breathe, speak, walk, or eat on his own. In the hospital, his parents, Lior and Galit, pick up a camera and never put it down. Shaped from hundreds of hours of intimate footage, 'I Am Neo' is a portrait of a child and his family slowly rebuilding their lives, revealing both the fragility of life, and the strength of the human spirit.

They hug and all seems well, but Adam and his mom can’t keep reality at bay forever…

After that, the director begins to dance while the texts suggests its own analysis and theories. Finally, the film closes with a visual collage blending footage from indie web series, french new wave films, archival footage of Cannes, and personal footage of milk being microwaved.

title: Chunks
overview: An anthology film of six unique comedy shorts threaded together with your host, faded Hollywood starlet Ruby, and taking inspiration from the glamourous by-gone era of late nite public access weirdness.  With live action shorts featuring originals from Podcast About List, Sandy Honig, Nate Fisher & Will Senett, and two animated segments from Episode 1 & Jim Soper, and Nick Mullen & Saul Crinier.

When she disappears at the end of the journey, leaving behind an abandoned baby, the situation blurs the boundaries between compassion and responsibility. And leads to an unexpected confrontation.

title: STUCK
overview: Ambitious journalist Simon is drawn into a bitter rural feud involving one dead dog, two angry men, and three slain sheep. Against his editor's advice, he attempts mediation. However, brokering a peace will be no easy task.

title: Perduta gente
overview: At his first illegal rave, nineteen-year-old Valerio follows two older friends into a night of excess and abandon. As the night unravels, his longing for approval draws him into a darkness he can no longer escape.

title: The Freezer
overview: In the devastated lands of the Madre de Dios mining exploitation in the southeastern Peruvian Amazon, a girl manages to escape the mafia holding her hostage. After escaping, she begins her search for justice, which will lead her to share her case with the entire nation, attracting the attention of politicians, prosecutors, judges, and police officers.

title: Mineshaft: The Cruising Murders
overview: “Mineshaft: The Cruising Murders" peels back the layers of controversy surrounding the making of the 1980 thriller, "Cruising." Directed by William Friedkin, the film triggered fierce protests from the LGBTQ+ community for its portrayal of a serial killer targeting gay men in New York's leather bars. Friedkin drew inspiration from the brutal murder of Variety reporter Addison Verrill, blurring the boundaries between cinematic fiction and real-life tragedy.

title: Risa and the Wind Phone
overview: Lila, after her father's death, discovers she has the ability to communicate with him from beyond the grave. As she explores this supernatural connection, she faces emotional challenges and family secrets that will test her faith in what she thought was possible.

title: Between Us
overview: Marina and David, two young artists, no longer feel the same passion that they've had for one another upon the early stages of their relationship. As time goes on, tensions grow and it all reaches a powerful breaking point.

title: Hollow Trees
overview: Years after a devastating war, a hardened survivor and a young boy are forced from their home by a creature capable of imitating humans. As they journey north in search of refuge, their fragile bond is pushed to its limits.

title: A Kindness
overview: After fleeing a blood-soaked nightmare in the woods, a priest seeks shelter in the home of a kind suburban woman.

title: Keizo Murase: The Last Monster Maker
overview: Artist. Innovator. Teacher. Inspiration.  From his humble beginnings as a modeling assistant in 1958 to his acclaimed directorial debut, Brush of the God in 2024, the legendary Keizo Murase spent his career dedicated to the art of monster making, bringing life to many of Japan’s most iconic and beloved kaiju characters. But behind every rampaging monster and transforming superhero were the hands of a dedicated artist, whose contributions to the Japanese film industry might have been forgotten, if not for a dedicated group of close friends, longtime admirers, and fans from every corner of the globe. For the first time in the English-speaking world, the life and career of this singular creative visionary is revealed and celebrated in a feature-length tribute that sheds detailed light on the accomplishments of Japan’s last great monster maker, and preserves the stories of those who knew and loved him best.

title: Girl Talk
overview: Over an extended period, a director engages in an ongoing conversation with Yu, a teenage girl trying to come out of her experience of sexual trauma. A dialogue built on trust, the film follows Yu as she gradually learns to assert herself while the director remains present and open in the process. Through her social encounters, her words, and the short films she makes, Yu reflects on how she has been seen and defined, and begins to reclaim control of her own story. Resisting the label of “victim,” she moves forward with a firm step into the world.

title: Glass Saints

title: Autosave

title: The Dream Machine
overview: Victor Neff moves into a new apartment and discovers a strange machine in the basement. Made of scrap metal, wires, and old television sets, it allows him to enter other people's dreams. But dreams are not empty, they are crowded with secrets, fears, and the dreamers themselves. - Based on the critically acclaimed point-and-click adventure game by Cockroach Inc.

title: Amal
overview: Amal (Hope) is a film co-directed by Arab and Jewish filmmakers and inspired by true events. Amal is a mother who sets out to rescue her son Samer from his preordained fate. When her son is involved with a shooting incident in the village, Amal acknowledges that if the warring clan is not stopped, her son will become the next victim. She fights with all her might for a “Sulha” (reconciliation). But the threat of chaos looms large, and Amal faces powerful forces that tear her apart and engulf the entire village. In the end, fate proves stronger, and Amal is swept into the bloodshed she has fought so hard to prevent.
