As hidden relationships, buried secrets, and long-suppressed truths begin to surface, the lines between justice, guilt, and revenge become increasingly blurred. Set against the backdrop of Canada, Oru Vadakkan Velicham is a Malayalam investigative thriller that explores deception, trauma, and the consequences of the past.

title: The Sands Won't Tell
overview: Kifah, a Bedouin healer, must find her daughter’s body and bury her before the mourning ends. Alone against a male code of silence, rooted in femicide, she fights for justice, not only for her daughter, but for all the other women who have been silenced.

title: All We Do Is Watch Movies
overview: A documentary short about Portland’s iconic Hollywood Theatre and Movie Madness video store.

title: Plötzlich Schwester
overview: Two sisters who couldn't be more different are unaware of their father's double life with two families and the existence of the other until his sudden death. While stuffy Sandra has no need for such a relationship, chaotic Sandy never leaves her new-found sister's side.

title: Fallen From Olympus
overview: Following the Trojan War, a soldier facing death encounters Thanatos and is drawn into a mythological confrontation about life, fate, and the meaninglessness of war.

title: The Wicked Die Young
overview: A young prince embarks on a surreal odyssey across a dangerous landscape filled with mafia gangsters, yakuza vampires, and supernatural witches. Along the way, he is joined by a living wishing star, who has secret motives of her own. Together, they journey towards a Sorceress’s den for revenge.

title: ODISEA 2016
overview: On the brink of turning 18 and terrified of adult responsibilities, a teenager finds a pair of glasses that transports him back to the "safe haven" of 2016. But when the portal begins to collapse, a frantic race against time begins, leaving him with only two choices: remain trapped in his memories forever, or take on the biggest responsibility of all—growing up to save his life.

title: Recall
overview: When a quietly hollowed-out office worker encounters a strange new colleague who seems to know him better than he knows himself, he doesn't realise that every friendly exchange is costing him a piece of who he actually is until there's nothing left to notice.

title: Lale Müldür and All the Nightclubs of Istanbul
overview: Brought to life from the outtakes of director Deniz Yüksel’s long-running Lale Müldür documentary, "Lale Müldür and All the Nightclubs of Istanbul" brings to light a memory of the poet alongside a previously unpublished piece of her writing. The music for the documentary, edited for Postbellek, was produced by Atonal Sounds.

title: Scavenged
overview: After the apocalypse, Bella becomes the target of rival survivor factions who believe she represents humanity's future. Protected by her father's best friend, Josh, she must survive betrayal, zombies, and war in a fight for hope.

title: Better Days
overview: Feature film directed by Hamza Pool, currently in post-production, style and plot kept under wraps.

title: The Pension Heist
overview: The film PENSJONSKUPPET (The Pension Heist) tells the story of three women in their prime who are written off as "too old" by their employers, their spouses, and even the healthcare system. But this feisty trio refuses to take it lying down. Together, they hatch a cunning plan to pull off the ultimate score… robbing Norway’s very own Sovereign Wealth Fund – the famous Oil Fund.

title: A casa que levo no peito
Return to a Strange Land
overview: In this nostalgic and yet dramatic documentary, choreographer Jiří Kylián creates a final work for his lifelong partner Sabine, a deeply personal performance that celebrates love, creation, and the ephemeral nature of life.

title: Go On, Have Another One
overview: David is tormented by Ciggi as he is pressured into smoking

title: Heart Of Gold
overview: Mali Azulai (38), a bus inspector in Ashkelon, is on the verge of losing her job after a violent altercation with a teenage passenger. When she returns to an empty bus to retrieve the body camera she left behind, she finds an abandoned baby on the floor and decides to take him home. Her brother Shimon (32), a prison guard struggling through a marital crisis, joins her, and the two shut themselves away with the child. His presence stirs the siblings’ shared wound of abandonment, as long-buried secrets come to light. When the baby falls ill and a hospital visit becomes unavoidable, Mali is forced to choose, hold on or let go and face the cost.

title: Find Me, Okay?
overview: Saturday morning, Eden Yerushalmi and her best friend, Arbel, are dancing at the Nova Festival. Hours later, Eden is taken to Gaza while her sisters listen helplessly on the phone. What begins as a desperate hope for her return, becomes a journey through uncertainty, public struggle, and devastating loss. Through intimate access to Eden’s mother, sisters, and her best friend Arbel, Find Me, Okay?, follows the fight to bring Eden Yerushalmi home, the moment hope collapses, and the painful attempt to rebuild life afterward. A two-year portrait of love, grief, resilience, and the impossible task of moving forward after trauma.

title: Song of no
overview: Song of No is a short animated documentary that traces people’s stories of street protests as vital spaces for learning, invention, and collective exchange.

title: Bagong tukso 2
overview: Meet the newest faces setting VMX on fire. Angel Castro, Shalanie De Vera, Shannon Sizon, Kim Yashii, and Akira Takamura turn up the heat in this all-new VMX Special. Get to know the women everyone's talking about and discover what makes them the newest VMX craze.

title: COULDN'T AFFORD A JOINT SO I PRETEND
overview: I couldn't afford to buy marijuana. Then I pretend to smoke any.

title: Oracle of the Dragon
overview: During Empress Wu's reign, the court is in turmoil, and a strange drug-related mystery emerges in Zhaoling. Detective Di Renjie teams up with Sima Xiaodao, cracking mechanism puzzles, exposing nobility impersonators, and seizing the Dragon Copper to foil the court conspiracy.

title: The Odyssey: The Making of an Epic
overview: Go behind the scenes of Christopher Nolan's mythic action epic, The Odyssey. This special documentary explores the monumental undertaking of adapting Homer’s foundational saga for the big screen, charting a grueling 91-day principal photography schedule across six countries. From the revolutionary use of brand-new IMAX film technology to the massive coordination of over 5,300 custom-designed costumes, discover how a star-studded cast led by Matt Damon, Tom Holland, and Anne Hathaway brought the dangerous, timeless world of ancient Greek gods and monsters to life.

title: How FIFA Chooses the World Cup Final Referee
overview: See how the process works and who Jonas Eriksson thinks will get the chance to referee the 2026 World Cup final.

title: Cadu: Cin Çıxarma
overview: This is a mockumentary-style project that humorously and satirically explores the themes of exorcism and family drama.

title: Boring Guys
overview: Gary and Garry live a tedious life of TV and rigatoni. Until jealousy strikes...

title: National Theatre at Home: London Road
overview: Autumn, 2006. The everyday life of the Suffolk town of Ipswich is shattered by the discovery of the bodies of five women. The occupant of No. 79 London Road is arrested, charged and finally convicted of the murders. Caught in the headlines and the invasion of their quiet road, the community grapples with what it means to be at the epicentre of the tragedy. Using their own words set to an innovative musical score, London Road is a moving story of ordinary people coming together during an extraordinary time. Director Rufus Norris, writer Alecky Blythe, and composer Adam Cork reunite for this highly anticipated return of the remarkable, award-winning verbatim musical.

title: Obsession Unleashed
overview: Go behind the scenes with in-depth interviews featuring Curry Barker and the cast

title: Bountiful
overview: Retired gunfighter Tash Beckett finds a home in the town of Bountiful, but soon the past comes calling.

title: The Last Woman on Earth
overview: Gu Hana is a blunt blue-haired woman taking a liberal film art class. No one gives her sincere feedback on her screenplay, which is full of anger toward men. But only one person, Song Cheol, an aspiring director who wishes to make a feature film, approaches her and says, “Hey, isn’t this screenplay hatred of men?” He believes a sponsored enterprise didn’t select his screenplay because it didn’t receive the ‘extra points from woman’s film.’ He ridiculously suggests that Hana team up with him…!

title: Teeth of A Fawn
overview: Bea can’t breathe when her girlfriend’s away.

title: Toronto Apartment
overview: After being dumped, a Toronto man subleases his apartment for an hour or two at a time to make rent as a 'community space.'

title: The Saltiz Movie - 100th Vlog
overview: Just before the Saltiz hit the upload button on their 100th vlog - everything disappears. The channel is deleted. No one knows who, no one knows why. The Saltiz embark on the longest and most dangerous journey of their lives to get their channel back, but along the way everything goes wrong.

title: Gentian Sprite
overview: Portrait of the elderly botanist Margaret Bradshaw

After staging a shocking act of protest in Tel Aviv, Sasha ignites the "269Life" movement, which quickly becomes a symbol of radical activism. At the height of the struggle, he meets Maria, a fellow immigrant and outsider who carries the same sense of displacement within Israeli society. Their shared alienation fuels both a fierce global movement and an intimate love story. But as their actions spread across continents and inspire thousands, they find themselves unable to escape the heavy costs of living on the front lines of revolution.

title: Ling tosite sigure Shisshin Sasori TOUR 2025 Tornado in Budokan
overview: A Blu-ray video release fully containing Ling tosite sigure's live performance held at Nippon Budokan on December 27, 2025, finally arrives. This long-awaited release for fans captures the approximately two-hour stage performance in full with outstanding video quality. The package has a special slipcase box design and contains a digipak and a deluxe photo booklet. It is also finished as a collector's item that preserves the heat and tension of the stage as they are. Do not miss Ling tosite sigure's one-of-a-kind sound and the full picture of their overwhelming Budokan performance. A Ling tosite sigure trading card 003 is planned to be included.

title: Comète
overview: As a comet streaks across the Paris sky, lives intersect in a mysterious dance. Two friends roam the city, taking stock of their lives. A young woman reconnects with a father she had long since given up on. Another sells drugs for her brother. Elsewhere, two souls haunted by death cross paths. Meanwhile, actors rehearse a play that strangely mirrors these lives. A portrait of unexpected encounters and the chance events that weave the fabric of our lives.

title: Living Rooms: An Experimental FIlm
overview: A strange walk through a living room.

title: A Quiet Blue
overview: Haunted by post-war trauma, 19-year-old Albert confronts his panic attacks through VR therapy to overcome his fears. Aimlessly wandering with friends through a desolate post-industrial city slowly turns an ordinary day into something he could never anticipate.

title: Kafka
overview: A young man named Grigor Grigoryan wakes up from a strange slumber and finds that he has transformed into the writer Franz Kafka. He is shocked by profound sorrow and frailty and he desperately feels the need to understand how he must continue living now.

title: Solitary Dialogues
overview: Torn between confessing his love to Van and the fear of ruining their friendship, Aren drifts through the Parisian night. An encounter with Théo, a former lover, rekindles buried emotions and compels him to redefine the true meaning of love.

title: Herostat
overview: Hamlet is an ordinary office worker struggling to overcome the loss of his beloved. On the surface he seems to have come to terms with it: he moves through his days mechanically, doing what is required. But beneath that routine, anger and resentment towards the world begin to boil inside him, eventually leading to a series of irreversible distractive acts. Inspired by the themes of Jean-Paul Sartre.

title: Ten More Times
overview: A factory worker martyred on July 15 wants to return to Earth to feel that unique spiritual bliss again. He fights relentlessly to be the target of a few more bullets before the sun rises.

title: Snake Eyes
overview: Plagued by premonitions of a dark future, Kasten sets off to hunt down Zangena the wicked - sister to his old nemesis Zolga. However what the warrior isn't aware of is the manipulation of another slippery sorceress. An ancient evil from beyond the Dreamlands is tightening it's coils around his desires.

title: Just Three Words
overview: Two brothers must prepare for the Christmas season while mourning the mysterious disappearance of their sister.

title: Generations: The Evolution of Spider-Man
overview: Swing through twenty years of Spider-Man history—from Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield to Tom Holland. Explore the evolution of the iconic suits and stunts, follow Tom's journey into the mask, and get an exclusive look at Peter Parker's next chapter with Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton.

title: Without Iraj
overview: An archival documentary exploring the life and work of Iranian photographer Iraj Ganjei through a rediscovered collection of photographs, letters, and other personal documents. As the filmmakers trace the origins of an unidentified photographic archive, they gradually uncover the world of a largely forgotten photographer and his connections to the artistic milieu of 1960s Iran.

title: Let the Women Wait!
overview: In the course of the summer three brothers-in-law at a crucial age become involved in ephemeral romantic adventures in the area of Lake Volvi while their families vacation on the island of Thassos and… can wait.

title: Animal Farm
overview: A group of farm animals rise up against their neglectful owner, dreaming of equality and freedom. But as the pigs take control, the revolution turns into tyranny, with truth rewritten and dissent crushed.

title: Descendants: Wicked Wonderland
overview: Now that the Queen of Hearts is nice and Cinderella is safe, things seem perfect for Red and Chloe… But little do they know that changing the past created a new villain — Maddox Hatter. When Maddox captures the Queen of Hearts, Red and Chloe must work alongside Red’s new sister Pink, Luisa Madrigal’s son Luis, and Maddox’s son Max to save her and Wonderland.

title: Cek Khodam
overview: Nowadays, people are more afraid of empty wallets, late payments, and the end of the month than ghosts. Ghosts are even used as entertainment through the content Cek Khodam (Hodgkin's Check) created by three friends, Sakti, Wira, and Bima. Unbeknownst to them, their actions have drastically reduced the Human Fear Score (AKM). To restore the dignity of the supernatural world and raise the human fear score, the Commander of the Khodam is tasked with descending directly into the human world. However, the mission does not go according to plan. The harder the khodam try to scare humans, the more chaos they create.

title: The Odyssey
overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

title: Only Beautiful Things to Look At
overview: Ingrid works as a gynecologist in a district hospital in Slovakia in the late 1980s. Her marriage is at a standstill, she has an affair with a younger colleague in the hospital, and after work, she sits on the abortion committee where they offer Roma women sterilization after the abortion is approved. Eighteen-year-old Agáta, who grew up in a children’s home, comes to work as a nurse at the hospital. Ingrid unexpectedly becomes close to her.

title: Ninja Motherf*cking Destruction
overview: At 18, Leonie and Marlene are best friends, convinced that nothing in the world can tear them apart. But then Leonie falls in love with Naomi, and as she immerses herself in her first great love, she drifts further away from Marlene. However, Leonie increasingly finds the relationship with Naomi overwhelming, and only after their breakup does she realize how much she has isolated herself. She leaves Berlin and starts training as a gardener in Brandenburg, hoping to sort out her feelings and the world around her. But the past years have left their mark on everyone.

title: Band Together
overview: Two years after the tragic sinking of a fishing boat that shook a small seaside town, members of the rondalla, a traditional Galician music band, decide to get back together in the endeavour to recover their enthusiasm and leave the grieving behind.

title: Die Töchter Europas
overview: A road movie set in long-distance coaches, on motorways and in bus terminals across a supposedly borderless Europe. A cinema documentary in kaleidoscopic snapshots tracing the fates of three very different women, their experiences and encounters.

title: Stiff
overview: Stuck in the bonds of sleep paralysis, a Woman struggles to escape as a creature lurks in the corner of her bedroom.

title: Taboo Cocoon
overview: The life of a hypochondriacal Internet musician takes a turn for the worse after an unexpected reunion with a childhood best friend runs parallel to a wave of mass killings.

title: To Grandfather's Village 2
overview: Vladik is spending his summer holidays with grandfather Yura again, when Viktor, a former diplomat and Vladik's grandfather by dad, suddenly appears in the village. He quickly finds a common language with the locals, gives his grandson expensive gifts and captivates him with stories about traveling around the world. Rivalry for the grandson's attention breaks out between the grandfathers - from caustic jokes to open confrontation. Grandfather Yura feels more and more that he is losing, but when a dangerous secret from Viktor's past comes to light, he has the opportunity to get rid of a competitor.

title: Me Before Me
overview: A young student battling pressure, panic and a demanding father uses a class project to discover that truth — not trophies — might finally set him free.

title: Quando Tudo Joga Contra
overview: On the verge of failing literature, a high school soccer defender begins tutoring sessions with the quiet boy in his class—unaware that their connection will turn into something more.

title: Diamond Made Man
overview: Diamond Made Man" spans epochs and galaxies, marking a cinematic milestone as potentially the first Hollywood production to feature an epic confrontation between prehistoric dinosaurs and advanced robotics.Scenes include intense battles in modern city streets where Dr.E.Sreehari, inside a colossal golden robot, clashes with a life-sized T-Rex using groundbreaking practical effects, animatronics, and motion capture technology.The story delves into ancient times around 4700 BC, where humanity's early struggles intertwine with futuristic elements, such as discovering billions in gold aboard a ship in the sea or confronting demonic forces reminiscent of mythological.  ​"A cinematic masterclass in immersion, this film redefines the future of storytelling by seamlessly integrating groundbreaking performance capture, hyper-realistic physics simulations, and native future-proofed VFX ecosystem."

title: Insects – Hidden Heroes
overview: How did our world come into being? Beneath our feet lies a class of animals far more numerous than any other. Let us embark on a journey through time dating back 400 million years, and witness how scattered pieces fit together to form a complete whole. Insects – Hidden Heroes takes us into the microcosm with stunning visuals. Narrated by screen icon Katharina Thalbach, the film poses a question: Must it be humanity or nature?

title: Lastri: Arwah Kembang Desa
overview: Atmi is terrorized by the spirit of Lastri, a woman who committed suicide 30 years ago due to slander and cruel treatment from her village. Now, Lastri has returned to seek revenge, especially on Atmi and those who destroyed her life.

title: Fake Punks
overview: In a desperate attempt to restart his life, a burnt-out pastor hires three teenagers to kidnap his wife.

title: 125, rue des Malaises
overview: Before leaving, Laurent Perrier wants to settle his affairs and ensure nothing is left unresolved.

title: Takkan Kubiarkan Kau Menangis
overview: Dika felt like he was never enough for his mother, Dini, and their relationship was full of conflict. While pursuing his dreams with Sans Band and receiving guidance from Om Radit, Dika finally realized that beneath all his mother's demands lay genuine love and support.

title: Was haben wir gelacht
overview: An entire generation of Germans was raised on male comedians. But what about their female counterparts? Maren Kroymann, Hella von Sinnen, Bettina Böttinger, Esther Schweins, and Gaby Köster look back at the way women were portrayed on TV in the 1990s and early 2000s, when jokes at women’s expense were the order of the day.

title: The Blurred Line
overview: Crusoe, a young filmmaker, reunites with his estranged Uncle who draws him into a violent underworld, which he twists into an opportunity for his own benefit.

title: Zoocânticos I
overview: Forms of the beings on Earth.

title: Ghost Buzzer: Antar Aku Pulang
overview: Four mystery-loving friends investigate a haunted basement and encounter the spirit of Maria, who begs for help returning home. Their mission leads them on an adventure filled with terror, puzzles, and friendship as they help the spirits find peace.

title: Zoochant I
overview: Ways of looking at Earth's beings.

title: Wrecked
overview: Driven by her ambition to win a scholarship to study abroad, a college student leads her close-knit group of friends into an abandoned junkyard to film the season finale of their ghost-hunting channel, hoping to create a viral sensation. But what begins as a quest for views soon turns into a deadly nightmare.

title: Devil's Breath
overview: Upon a date with another man, John was drugged and all his money stolen. He has no choice but to turn to his brother, Frank, for help; a small-time gangster looking for his next fight.

title: The Woman with Three Husbands
overview: Concerned her impressionable brother has joined an isolated polyamorous family, Natalie investigates her new 'in-laws'. The strange death of one of Marcus's fellow 'brother husbands' leads Natalie to realize her brother is living with a killer

title: In another life, I was a typist
overview: Triggered by a familiar face, an elderly man with Alzheimer’s journeys through the vivid, golden memories of his teenage love — the one who once gave color to his life — while grappling with his unfulfilled desire to transcribe his history before it fades into the quiet serenity of his present.

title: Poppy McCorn
overview: Your favorite hot-buttered movie mascot welcomes you to the theater, and reminds you to be quiet and courteous...or else...

title: Hysteria
overview: In a surreal clinic where women's grief is diagnosed, categorized, and prescribed, two patients — one after miscarriage, one after hysterectomy — confront the absurd rituals of institutional care and begin to reclaim their rage.

title: Rumours of Madam Roach
overview: A woman is monitoring her neighbours through a pair of world altering binoculars, while the world around her deteriorates.

title: No Name, No Address
overview: Sérgio is a charismatic radio host who presents the show "The Sound of Love", where he reads letters from people seeking help with their relationships and offers them advice. However, when a letter with no return address arrives at the show, Sérgio begins to spiral into a frenzy of guilt and sorrow.

title: Take a Piece of Me With You for the Rest of Your Life
overview: Cornélia is on her way to meet her wife, Carmem, at a restaurant that holds special memories for both of them. As the meeting unfolds, small cracks appear in their conversation and silences, revealing hidden layers of their relationship and leaving the impression that not everything is quite as it seems.

title: Wrecked
overview: Three friends run a ghost-hunting livestream channel. In a quest for viral content, they perform a ritual to summon "Gong Goi," a cursed spirit from local legend. What starts as a fun stunt turns deadly when a tragic accident occurs, and they choose to cover it up. Haunted by guilt and hunted by the supernatural, the trio must face a terrifying truth — or become part of an endless nightmare.

title: Newlyweds
overview: After murdering his bride on the night of their wedding, a panicked groom races down a road to dispose of her body before dawn. But as the miles disappear beneath his tires, unsettling phone calls, impossible visions, and a growing presence in the backseat begin to blur the line between reality and nightmare. Trapped alone with his guilt, he soon discovers that some truths refuse to stay buried.

title: Pocong Cantengan
overview: The search for a missing friend leads four young people to a house haunted by the Pocong Cantengan and the secret of human sacrifices ritual.

title: Archivepelago: Nursery Road
overview: As a director, artist Garin Nugroho consistently reflects on Indonesian culture through his films, exploring diverse perspectives—ranging from artists to the general public—regarding a culture that is gradually eroding and losing its appeal among the current generation, a trend that threatens the very loss of cultural identity.

title: Virginpur
overview: The series starts with a village boy named Jitu who reaches Virginpur to study.  He plans to live at Madam Niwas. There, he sees Rai, a beautiful, intelligent girl, and instantly falls in love with her. But his dream turns into a nightmare when both Jitu and Rai are involved in a kidnapping scandal. Will Jitu and Rai come out of the situation and get into a relationship?

title: OLD SOUL
overview: An old-fashioned young man meets a modern girl in a theatre class, and their connection slowly unravels, leading him through unrequited love, faith, and a quiet spiritual reconciliation.

title: La Finale - Italia Francia 2006 - Il cielo è azzurro sopra Berlino
overview: On July 9, 2006, Zidane’s headbutt on Materazzi turned the World Cup final into a legend—a symbol of the rivalry between France and Italy. Twenty years after Berlin, the key figures and commentators look back on that iconic match.

title: My සිම්බා
overview: My සිම්බා (My Simba, 2026) is a heartwarming Sri Lankan Sinhala forest adventure directed and written by Janardhanan Krishnamoorthy (JK), marking a unique milestone as the first local feature film to star a live, real-life lion. The emotional narrative follows an innocent villager and his young son who unknowingly rescue an orphaned lion cub, raising it as part of their own family. As the cub grows into a majestic predator and the truth about its origins comes to light, the family is forced to navigate danger and sacrifice in a touching journey of love, courage, and the call of the wild. Releasing in theaters on July 17, 2026, the film features a strong ensemble cast led by Kalana Gunasekara, Roshan Ranawana, Nayomi Thakshila, and Suraj Mapa, alongside Rajitha Hiran and Meenuka Premarathna.

title: Mız
overview: Farid finds himself in a different field while trying to become a screenwriter.

title: Afterglow
overview: When her mother begins to appear in fleeting daydreams, Danna must overcome her grief in order to find her way back to her sister Victoria.

title: Noche de Entierro
overview: Overwhelmed by her mother and tired of her grandmother's wake, Noelia escapes to a party with her best friend in search of a break. But leaving the wake proves much harder than she imagined.

title: Get afloat
overview: After becoming paraplegic, Lucas, a young competitive swimmer, isolates himself from the world, sinking into depression. His former coach, Raúl, refuses to abandon him and confronts him harshly. In this emotional turmoil, Lucas must decide whether to let his new reality overwhelm him or find the motivation to rise above it.

title: Remnants of memory
overview: Jeisson Castillo, a Colombian artist, returns to the Amazon to continue an art workshop with children from the indigenous community of El Itilla. But while painting in a sacred place, an unexpected illness transforms his journey. Guided by the traditional knowledge of Kumú, he begins a profound healing process that questions the boundaries between art, territory, memory, and spirituality.

title: Scrambled Eggs
overview: The movie Yesterday never happened, and Mary's the only one who knows.

title: Watchful Eyes
overview: Sebastian, a grieving man, takes a janitor job on a university campus. While monitoring students linked to a professor’s death, he uncovers a ghost story that may be more real than anyone believed.

title: Beyond the Mast
overview: On a fuel-supplying oil tanker in rivers, Old Maqbool, a compassionate cook, wishes luck to all the crew. But the power-hungry helmsman suspects him of being a spy for the vessel owner and harasses him all the time. During port maintenance, Maqbool befriends Noora, a young stowaway seeking refuge. The helmsman exploits the downtime to smuggle oil, which attracts the owner's attention. During a sudden visit, impressed with Maqbool's cooking, the owner allows Noora to stay as his assistant. Desperate to hide his deeds, the helmsman falsely accuses Noora of theft, sparking a web of lies and friction among the crew.

title: Horsegirls
overview: As her mother battles an uncertain diagnosis, neurodivergent 22-year-old Margarita discovers a source of strength in an unexpected place: the sport of hobbyhorsing.

title: Heartstopper Forever
overview: It's a new school year for the Truham-Higgs gang. As Nick and Charlie's relationship deepens, their thoughts turn to life after the last bell rings.

title: Kill Trip
overview: On the way to a Texas music festival, a group of friends catches a ride with a magnetic van driver. But when people start vanishing, the real headliner becomes survival.

title: Kingdom 5: The Clash of Souls
overview: Except for the state of Qin, the six rival states join forces to form an allied army led by military adviser Riboku. The allied army then targets Qin. Meanwhile, Shin of Qin jumps into the war that will determine the fate of Qin.

title: 28 Hours Later
overview: 28 hours after the Rage virus began to spread a group of young people begin to travel to a new safe space

title: For Those
overview: Armenia, Spring 2021. Léon, a Frenchman of Armenian descent, returns to his family to bury his cousin Hrant, who died six months earlier during the 44-day war.

title: The Man in the Second Story Window
overview: A Man sits at a desk, typing. Another Man sits across from him in a chair, sleeping. Outside, beneath them, reality plays out, as it has forever. Today, however, that changes.

title: Oh..! Sukumari
overview: Follows an aspiring politician who falls in love with Sukumari, a beautiful and soft-natured woman, while her father conceals a secret that threatens their relationship.

title: American Pachuco: The Legend of Luis Valdez
overview: Against political resistance and industry skepticism, Luis Valdez pushes Chicano storytelling from the fields to the film screen with Zoot Suit and La Bamba, crafting iconic works that challenge, celebrate, and expand America’s story.

title: Arjunan Per Paththu
overview: Arjunan, who witnessed his parents being killed by lightning in front of his eyes, cannot bear the shock and arrives in Chennai from his hometown Madurai. Arjunan, who joined a kayalang shop in Chennai, starts to love a woman. Before marrying that woman, he was a worker and wanted to become an entrepreneur. He gave away all the money he had saved up until then and bought an old Tata Ace and married the woman he loved. Arjuna happily starts driving the vehicle, thinking that his life has become as happy as he thought it would be. Arjuna, who has been facing constant problems with that old vehicle, realizes that he has been completely cheated in buying the vehicle. He brings together all those who have been affected like him and exposes all the frauds in buying and selling old vehicles, seeking justice for himself and all those who have been cheated like him.

title: Anbe Diana
overview: Set in Perambur, a local Telugu youth falls for an Anglo-Indian girl, sparking a chaotic and humorous clash of cultures between their families.

title: Arulvaan
overview: Follows Muthuvel, a resolute collector who overcomes all obstacles to educate a tribal girl and provide school access for the entire forest community.

title: You, Fireworks, and Our Promise
overview: The coming-of-age romance is set during the Nagaoka Festival Grand Fireworks Show, one of Japan's three major fireworks shows that draws several hundred thousand visitors to Niigata Prefecture every year. What connects Makoto (a Tokyo high school boy without social skills or self-confidence) and Aki (a popular high school girl and class president with beauty and talent) is a drawing of a fireworks display. At the mercy of the drawing's mystery and fate itself, the two have to make a choice in a limited amount of time.

title: Operation Kino
overview: A trio of thieves infiltrate a movie theater to obtain an object

title: Dastaar
overview: A Sikh immigrant rises from newcomer to community leader following a devastating racist attack.

title: The Living Dragon
overview: For more than half a century, Yasuaki Kurata has been one of the most prominent and singular Japanese actors in international action cinema. After becoming a major star in Hong Kong during the Golden Age of kung fu films - appearing alongside such icons as Jackie Chan, Sammo Hung, Jet Li and Donnie Yen - Kurata now marks both the 60th anniversary of his acting career and his 80th birthday with an ambitious and deeply personal new project, "The Living Dragon."  Structured as an anthology of three interconnected stories, the film brings together leading action directors Koichi Sakamoto, Kenji Tanigaki and Yuji Shimomura - all former members of the Kurata Action Club, who went on to earn their own fame in Japan and abroad. Moving between realism, fantasy and memory, the stories they've written for their sifu revolve around aging, unrealized dreams and the enduring spirit of those who continue to devote themselves to cinema.

title: Dead Parents Club
overview: Dead Parents Club is a hybrid documentary blending observational footage, experimental performance, and cultural analysis to challenge the pervasive "orphan trope" in popular culture.  While children's media like The Lion King, Frozen, and Finding Nemo frequently use parental loss as a narrative tool to spark a character's independence, the lived reality of grief is vastly more complex.  The film follows real individuals who have lost parents as they collaborate on a unique theatre production. By stepping into the roles of iconic fictional orphans like Simba and Frodo, the cast members weave their personal stories of trauma into the scripted scenes. The resulting performance offers a poignant, absurd, and unexpectedly funny exploration of identity and healing.  Moving between fantasy and lived experience, this documentary examines how we navigate profound loss, build deep connections, and ultimately learn to parent ourselves.

title: The Mole Must Die

title: Prompt: Make a Documentary
overview: Prompt: Make a Documentary investigates the growing influence of artificial intelligence on the film industry.  The documentary places the rise of AI within the broader historical context of cinema’s evolution, drawing parallels with earlier technological shifts such as the introduction of sound, colour, and digital visual effects. By revisiting landmark moments in film history, the film demonstrates that disruption has always been part of cinema’s DNA, while questioning whether AI represents a fundamentally different kind of change.  Featuring insights from directors, academics, and practitioners, Prompt: Make a Documentary explores the tension between innovation and integrity, the democratisation of creative tools, and the ethical implications of automation in the arts. The film ultimately asks whether artificial intelligence will empower the next generation of storytellers or redefine creativity itself.

overview: An amateur sleuth named Morton attempts to uncover the identity of a legendary detective known as “The Eye” during a chaotic and deadly Hollywood luncheon

title: Glorious Disaster
overview: Documentary on Laurel & Hardy by David Cairns and Fiona Watson

title: The Hunted
overview: Three deadly stories of pursuit collide in this horror-thriller anthology: a concussed runner and her dog are stalked in the wilderness, a serial killer targets an abusive man, and bank robbers turn on one another over a priceless score.

title: Massa Mãe
overview: Maria and Matías feel life is slipping through their fingers, and turn to birds, real and imagined, in a search for meaning and connection.

title: Pramuka
overview: Panji and his Scout Patrol are preparing to attend a Penggalang Scout camping trip in the mountain forest. Unbeknownst to everyone, Budi, Panji's younger brother and a Cub Scout (Siaga) secretly sneaks aboard the group's truck, eager to experience the excitement of camping alongside his older brother. When Budi's presence is eventually discovered, he is allowed to stay and join Panji's group. What begins as an ordinary journey soon turns into a dangerous adventure when Panji and his patrol become separated from the main camp and find themselves lost deep within the forest. While searching for a way back, they stumble upon a terrifying secret: a hidden, abandoned warehouse where a criminal gang is holding kidnapped children captive. Caught in a life threatening situation, Panji and his friends must rely on their courage, ingenuity, teamwork, and the principles of the Scout Law (Dasa Dharma Pramuka) to survive, find help, and rescue the imprisoned children before it is too late.

title: Alien Storm
overview: A father, businessman and secret doomsday prepper escorts people to the safety of his bunker – actually an underground house – when a massive and potentially deadly fog descends and cuts the power at his home.

title: Thingy
overview: A young woman will do anything to avoid her ex at a secluded house party. But a supernatural virus passing through the partygoers may take care of him for her.

title: Horror and Love
overview: A love letter to the world of freaks, this documentary retraces the birth of Horrorland, voted Europe's Best Scream Park, as well as the love story between Cristina Raya and David Moreno, the two main driving forces behind this Catalan theme park. From St. Louis to Vilassar de Dalt, by way of Newcastle, the camera accompanies them on their odyssey to build a dream called Horrorland.

title: Someone's Daughter
overview: A criminal defence lawyer, Sam, (Pascale Bussières, Ma Vie en cinémascope, When Night is Falling), finds herself kidnapped and abandoned on a remote island along with former client Paul (François Arnaud, Heated Rivalry, Fucktoys, The Borgias), who she previously cleared of sexual assault charges. As they make their way through the unrelenting Canadian wilderness, Paul’s behaviour forces Sam to question the man she once defended. As doubt gives way to fear, she finds herself facing a choice no lawyer should ever have to make.

title: Something Borrowed
overview: On the morning of her wedding, a bride does anything it takes to fit into her wedding dress.

title: Fruitless
overview: Oscar, an aspiring fashion designer, is faced with a painful decision following the events of a turbulent night..

title: Los Vampires
overview: In 1930 Hollywood, a Spanish actor is cast in the night shoot of a soon-to-be-legendary vampire film, forced to imitate the English-speaking star who performs the same role by day. The two actors regularly meet at the transitory hours of their shoots, and a rivalry stirs between them. All the while, a string of murders are occurring on and around the soundstage.

title: Depths of Fear
overview: A team of divers enters one of the deepest holes in the ocean, but they discover more than they expected: something has made that deep hole its home and now they will have to fight for survival.

title: Permanent Damage
overview: Prison escapee Tommy Gods spirals into deeper trouble when he falls for Joe Plísek and is forced to work for her crooked uncle. Together, the couple plots to steal his "golden goose."

title: FESTER
overview: Unable to digest the end of his relationship, Robert develops a haunting gut-rot that sends him spiraling down the toilet... and into his ex-girlfriend's new lover's apartment.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 4
overview: The fourth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on July 21, 2026, at Sendai Sun Plaza Hall in Sendai, Miyagi, Japan, and was headlined by an A Block match between Shingo Takagi and Oleg Boltin.

title: Ends Meat
overview: A woman is confronted with the realization that she's misunderstood the meaning of a common phrase.

title: Evangelion: Death (True)² & Rebirth
overview: In celebration of the historic property's 30th anniversary, GKIDS presents the EVANGELION 30th Movie Fest. This special theatrical event features EVANGELION: DEATH (TRUE)² & REBIRTH. The feature is composed of EVANGELION: DEATH, a comprehensive compilation of episodes 1-24 of the original landmark television series, paired alongside EVANGELION: REBIRTH, the legendary partial alternate ending to episode 25.

title: Mozart: The Magic Flute @  Aix-en-Provence Festival 2026
overview: For years, *The Magic Flute* has been one of the most frequently performed operas at the Aix-en-Provence Festival. After an eight-year absence, Mozart’s work is now back on the programme. Clément Cogitore interprets the plot as a modern coming-of-age story: Tamino and Pamina leave the world of childhood behind and enter a reality in which beauty is fragile and truth is uncertain.

title: Soulbreaker Sword
overview: At the end of the Song Dynasty, the martial world is filled with bloodshed, with everyone fighting for the peerless Soulbreaker Sword. A charming disciple of Emei flees with the sword and runs into Mo Huicong, a disciple of Qingcheng. The divine sword is stolen, and a mystery about their origins suddenly unfolds. It turns out that the sword's original owner is his father, and the head of Emei's beauty trap hides a blood feud for the whole clan. In a desperate battle at the martial arts conference, Mo combines with the sword to take revenge. Finally, to end the chaos, he abandons the divine weapon and roams the world with his beloved.

title: Jana Nayagan
overview: A clash of ideologies. One stands for the people, the other feeds on control. Their paths collided once before. Years later, a child’s silent fear ignites the past, drawing a former police officer into a battle far bigger than personal revenge.

title: CONATUS
overview: Soyeong, a woman with a disability, harbors a nightly dream: performing on stage. In her imagination, she dances effortlessly in a "normal" body, yet remains wary of praise. Her dance teacher, Heejeong, guides her through movements, encouraging her to chase her aspirations. Their shared performance is a cherished moment, but the following day brings a return to Soyeong's ordinary life. As she begins documenting her experiences, we embark on a journey alongside her, through changing seasons and flowing waters, towards an unknown destination.

title: Les Madeleines
overview: Every Sunday, at mass time, a man in a bow tie prepares twenty-four madeleines. These pastries used to put him off: who wants to bite into a cake bearing his mother's name? But now that Madeleine has died, Stéphane-Jacques feels like spending a little time with her at tea time.

title: Bad Counselors
overview: After committing a crime on campus, two frat-stars pretend to be Christian camp counselors in order to fulfill court ordered community service.

title: Elize: Shadows of a Woman
overview: In this retelling of a real case, a former escort discovers her wealthy husband's infidelity and struggles to cope as betrayal poisons their marriage.

title: Take Care of Yourself
overview: Alaa, a radio host who fears commitment, enters relationships that end for trivial reasons until he meets Farida, who seems perfect. He then discovers she is one of the largest arms dealers. When he tries to leave her, she forces him to marry her, dragging him into a series of dangerous situations.

title: Will You Come Find Me?
overview: Ten-year-old Yu and his younger sister loved playing “The Countdown Game” with their grandfather, who could always find the hidden watch in seconds. After Grandpa’s sudden passing, u feels lost and is misunderstood as having taken the watch. As he searches for it with his sister, he is forced to confront the grief he has tried to avoid. A moment of honesty with his mother finally opens the door for Yu to release his long-held emotions and find the courage to face his sadness.

title: Ip Man: Kung Fu Legend
overview: In 1950s Hong Kong, British merchants and Chinese triads have joined forces to expand their territory, forcibly demolishing factories without regard for public welfare. This move draws fierce opposition from Ip Man, standing up for the workers, he faces pressure from all sides. Framed for murder, he is sent to prison. Within the prison walls, the triads set multiple deadly traps. Can Ip Man overcome these trials, escape the danger, and clear his name?

title: Days that Shocked the World: Concorde Crash
overview: Concorde was an icon of the skies, but on 25 July 2000, Air France Flight 4590 left Paris for New York and caught fire during take-off before crashing to the ground just over a minute later, killing everyone on board. The tragedy brought an end to the dream of supersonic passenger flight. But what caused the disaster? Investigators, survivors’ loved ones and those who examined the wreckage recall the tragedy and describe how the evidence led to a shockingly simple conclusion about what went wrong.

title: The Disconnection
overview: Luke is pressured by a pair of stereotypical bullies to get a new phone, so he enlists the help of his unpredictable, dumb friend Liam, but their mission quickly spirals into chaos when a pair of rich, phone-obsessed twins enter the classroom, turning a simple task into a ridiculous, absurd adventure.

title: The Fire We Choose
overview: Brian, a newly married outsider in a religious extremist family, is torn between faith and morality when the Wards kidnap a lesbian couple, Kennedy and Mia, determined to save them at any cost.

title: Purge
overview: Gee, a writer trapped in a cycle of anxiety, depression, and stalled ambition, joins a clinical trial at Glass Solutions, where an experimental drug called BriteNol promises a way out. When she takes the pill, her body undergoes a violent transformation, expelling a thick, black substance that leaves her feeling lighter than she has in years. For the first time, Gee feels the joy, clarity, and freedom she’s been chasing, but as her sense of self slowly begins to fracture, she is forced to confront the terrifying possibility that the reflection in the mirror isn’t her at all.

title: Ballad Of The Trumpet
overview: An inexperienced robber brings his obnoxious best friend along for his last job. But, as the night grows colder; dark secrets and horrific truths are revealed.

title: Role Models
overview: Role Models follows Sophie, Erin and Fletch as they spend the day recovering from a part from the night before. Erin who ruined the party by letting it slip that the birthday girl cheated on her boyfriend. Spends the day on the couch thinking about what she’s done, out of pity fletch offers to go to the shops for her which is. Decision he would soon regret. On the flip side of all of this Sophie spends the day setting up to do a dj set at what she presumes is a night club as she arrives it soon becomes clear she’s made a mistake

title: Bangungot
overview: In a quiet rural town in the outskirts of the Philippines, an impoverished young man dreaming of a better life finds himself ensnared by the Batibat during his sleep, causing him to enter a deceptive dream of comfort and wonder that slowly turns into a calming nightmare in which he may never wake up again— nor the rest of the town.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 5
overview: The fifth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on July 22, 2026, at Aore Nagaoka in Nagaoka, Niigata, Japan, and was headlined by a B Block match between Zack Sabre Jr. and Callum Newman.

title: A Toxic Love Story
overview: A string of threatening emails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly married US marshal and his ex-girlfriend.

title: My Grandfather Charles Manson
overview: Sophia was always the good girl growing up and her father's rock, but her quest to identify her unknown grandfather results in a shocking discovery: He is Charles Manson, history's most notorious criminal; and he bears striking physical similarities to her beloved father. Sophia's discovery propels her into an underworld of Manson family members and unreliable narrators as she traces her grandfather's life. Along the way, her genetics unlock never-before-released records and audio recordings that illuminate Manson's pathology in startling ways. But the more Sophia uncovers, the more her relationship with her father is strained. For Sophia, there's no turning back. What has she inherited, and how will she reckon with her family legacy?

title: How to be a Billionaire with Xavier Niel
overview: Xavier Niel hosts a comedy show about his success.

title: Sinking Road
overview: Dotty Duette gets pushed into the waters to drown by an unknown assailant, where she is then stuck on a magical golden road which drags her down to the underwater "Sinking Road Village". Once there, she meets the embodiments of the Buddhist precepts, some welcoming her and making her feel right at home until the road comes back down for her, and some, like the infamous 1st precept, being out for her blood.

title: Wild Blackberries
overview: An insight into living in London, United Kingdom in 2026

title: Grandmonster
overview: An American dropout inadvertently triggers a zombie outbreak at a remote Norwegian nursing home while trying to save her grandmother from dementia. As if flesh-eating seniors weren’t enough, she’s also forced to contend with budget cuts, bureaucracy and Scandinavian conflict aversion.

title: The Session
overview: Haunted by a recurring nightmare, a woman battling insomnia must undergo a cryptic therapy session to uncover a dark, suppressed memory before the guilt she buried consumes her.

title: Motor City
overview: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl and lands in prison for a crime he didn't commit. With his life ruined, Miller plots revenge against the man who took his girl away.

title: Blood on Snow
overview: A hit man falls for his client's wife, who happens to be the target of the assassin's latest assignment.

title: To my sisters
overview: Four women are on an existential journey in Morocco, connecting with local women from all walks of life bonding in sisterhood, and share their common quest for empowerment.

title: Colours of Time
overview: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. No one has lived there since the 1940s, and the cousins are intrigued by all of the items they find there, little things that help them to understand their ancestor, Adèle Vermillard. Jumping back and forth in time, they meet the mysterious Adèle, whose bohemian lifestyle, and her relationships with the leading artists of the time, changes their lives.

title: Future Future
overview: In a rainy Brazilian city, an amnesic man is taken in by a lonely clickworker at a course for people with a strange neurological syndrome. After using an addictive AI device, he embarks on a tragic and absurd journey to find where he truly belongs.

title: Little Creatures
overview: Brasília, 1986. Helena has barely settled in with her family in Brazil's futuristic capital when her husband leaves on a business trip. Stranded in an unfamiliar city, she questions her choices, feeling frustrated and lost. Her teenage son rebels and discovers his first love; her seven-year-old finds magic in unlikely friendships and unseen possibilities. In a democracy less than a year old, everyone lives in limbo—trapped between what was and what could be.

title: Mojoku Hilang!
overview: Adi, a corporate climber at Moo Magic Farms who turns a distinctive cow named Mojo into a viral sensation while pursuing aggressive rural farm acquisitions. His plans take an unexpected turn when he encounters a resistant farming community and its determined inhabitants.

title: Hasta el fin del mundo
overview: Manuel's life is upended when Esmeralda, his lost love from 15 years ago, calls unexpectedly. Despite being set to marry another, he rediscovers Esmeralda, and they realize their love transcends time.

title: Penny Lane Is Dead
overview: Set in 1986, during a scorching Aussie summer, three best friends' celebration at a beach house turns into a blood-soaked fight for survival when a prank goes horribly wrong.

title: Ancestral Beasts
overview: In the haunting landscape of rural Canada explores the terrifying idea: what if a severe mental health disorder took on a physical form—a creature lurking in the shadows?  After cutting ties with her toxic sister, Elyse retreats to her ancestral home to rebuild her mental health. But her journey toward healing is derailed when a grotesque creature begins to stalk her. It feeds on her emotional turmoil, forcing her to confront the past she tried to escape or lose herself and those she loves.

title: Contention
overview: Siblings are taken hostage by a young girl with mysterious abilities. However, their captor is on the run from a cunning man who is hellbent on returning the girl to her prison.

title: Detective Conan: Fallen Angel of the Highway
overview: When a string of deadly highway incidents begin, Conan Edogawa's investigations point towards an orchestrated plot rather than mere accidents. As he uncovers a conspiracy involving hidden identities and advanced technology, the case escalates into a high-speed race against time to stop a calculating mastermind before more lives are lost.

title: Honey Bunny
overview: Tonina has always taken care of her family, however she never felt like they really reciprocated her with an equal amount of help and love. Believing that it's her given right, she decides to aquire the ownership rights to a small family holiday home on the island of Hvar. However, after the rest of her kin realize what she had done, tensions begin to brew and a small family gathering turns into a turf war.

title: Dream High
overview: A cinematic rock opera and an homage to teen films, adapted from the stage musical with the same name by Amit Ulman, scripted completely in Hebrew rhymes. Yoav, a teenage boy who lives with his single mother, who struggles to finance them, moves to a new city. He joins Magshimim High, where words hit harder than punches, and your rhyming skills determine the food chain. After the "class king" demolishes him in a rap battle, Yoav is determined to prove himself and win the heart of the "class queen", Maya. He encounters Hamorabi, a legendary former rapper who hides under the image of the school's kiosk cashier. With his help, Yoav turns from an outcast to the Star of the Battles. But as he climbs high, he draws apart from the friends who stood by his side, the girl who really saw him when no one else had, and the authenticity taught to him by Hamorabi. In the National Rap Championship, Yoav will have to choose between chasing the shining lights of fame or staying true to himself.

title: Mones
overview: Cici, a trans woman, confronts her gender dysphoria at her younger brother Teddy’s fraternity during a historic Pride party/drag show she put together with her best friends. As the drag performers, frat boys, and queers mingle, Cici has a romantic encounter with a familiar young man that leads to her overcoming her mental hurdles around being a woman. Ultimately, she learns the universal truth of womanhood… sometimes your titties just hurt! A high energy comedy that explores questions of identity.

title: Ecos do Teatro Experimental do Negro
My Wild Friend: Returning Home
overview: When Sasha meets his wild friend, Red the fox, again, he learns that the fox's family has been kidnapped by a traveling zoo. The boy resolves to bring them home at all costs. A dangerous journey and a meeting with a new true friend awaits him.

title: Home Bodies
overview: Two children, raised in total isolation by an automated house, begin to confront the mysteries of their existence after an enigmatic stranger arrives from outside.

title: Fruit Gathering
overview: In industrial Yangon, young factory worker San Kyi dreams of returning to her native village. Her relationship with co-worker Theint Theint Oo evolves from closeness to growing distance, revealing tensions between their expectations and life prospects. Amid exhausting labour, social repression, and economic uncertainty, both women seek escape and intimacy.

title: Love in Slow Motion
overview: When Haya's best friend Jawad gets engaged, her chronically-single world unravels — because who knew true love could be hiding in the friend zone?

title: "It's Murder!"
overview: Officer Wray is determined to prove to his boss that he has what it takes to bring justice for an innocent victim involved in a murder case gone wrong. His boss assigns him onto a recent murder case involving 7 suspects who all had the potential to have committed this murder. As Officer Wray digs deeper into this mystery, with the help of a key witness and a helpful journalist, the situation becomes more and more dangerous for not just himself, but for everyone involved...

title: Idols
overview: A wannabe kpop idol meets her famous lookalike.

title: Mosquito Halo
overview: Police investigate Dream Harvester, a political faction opposing the digitization of consciousness.

title: Fake Hundreds
overview: After a cancer diagnosis, a man tries to confront God.

title: Butterfly Effect: Azzam
overview: Azzam a 12-year-old boy is suddenly transported to an isolated world of butterflies during a family trip to the south of Saudi Arabia. Transformed into a butterfly, he must find himself to find his way back to the real world and his family.

title: A Malevolent World
overview: A full improv feature film that explores the awful realism of a zombie apocalypse in Northern England.

title: Juminten Edan
overview: Juminten, a mute woman, returns to her hometown with her husband and child after eight years away. Initially welcomed warmly by her family, their happiness changes when Juminten begins to behave strangely and endanger those closest to her. When her dark past is revealed, the safety of her family and the entire island is threatened.

title: Sihir Tanah Kubur
overview: After his mother's death, Yusuf is shocked when his younger brother, Ashar, moves her grave due to a mysterious will. The appearance of the Wurung Tomb triggers a mystical terror that divides the family and the villagers. Amidst the escalating conflict, dark family secrets are revealed, posing a demonic threat that jeopardizes their future.

title: Anak-Anak Bambu
overview: Netta planned to sell the orphanage to solve her family's problems. However, after getting to know the orphans living there, especially Gebang, she realized that family isn't just about blood ties, but about caring for each other. This journey led Netta to discover the meaning of family that had been missing from her life.

title: Rubberhead: The Life & Monsters of Steve Johnson
overview: Known for his intense work ethic, perfectionism, and obsession with breaking new ground, Steve Johnson has created iconic creatures and effects for some of the most beloved genre films in cinema history, working with everyone from John Carpenter, David Cronenberg, and Sam Raimi to James Cameron, Steven Spielberg, and Guillermo del Toro. His drive and ambition also led to heartbreaking acts of self-sabotage, divorce, and a serious drug addiction.

title: Behind the Screens
overview: Seven close friends reunite for a dinner gathering and decide to play a seemingly harmless game. Throughout the evening, every message, email, and phone call they receive must be shared openly with the group.

title: Sia: Nostalgic for the Present
overview: A bold experience that challenges the genre that trades pop poetry for pure art. Impressive voices, impressive choreography and iconic performances, captured cinematically and sounded by an unparalleled catalog of hits.

title: Free Wifi
overview: Davi, an online motorcycle taxi driver, fakes a wealthy image on social media to attract Grace's attention. Their relationship is opposed by Grace's ex-fiancé, who hires a detective to uncover Davi's true identity. The revelation of the truth triggers a series of misunderstandings, conflicts, and chaos involving both families.

title: Quando abandonamos a humanidade, o que resta de nós?
Polis
overview: Two Dutch-Turkish cops are forced to team up for a thankless assignment; escort computer nerd Jordy, who's posing as the world's most dangerous hacker.

title: Blue Marks
overview: A young Israeli women moves to Paris to study fashion. after a chance encounter turns into rape, she faces an unwanted child and seeks revenge against the man who killed her dreams.

title: Compliment Sandwich
overview: A couple, over the hump of the honeymoon period, moves into a more serious state of communication in their sexual relationship.

title: Sangkal
overview: Luna, a final-year university student, begins her thesis under the supervision of her lecturer, Mr. Garda, who initially seems kind and supportive. Behind his friendly facade, however, Mr. Garda abuses his position of power by sexually harassing Luna and threatening to delay her graduation if she refuses his advances. Deeply traumatized, Luna disappears without a trace. Her best friend, Laras, grows suspicious, only to find herself becoming the next victim of the same abuse.

title: Come to Brasil
overview: Look in the comment section of any celebrity and you'll see one comment more than any other: “Come to Brasil.” In the west, the phrase is brushed off as a meme, but for Brazilian fans, it's a rallying cry, a plea that unites fandoms in a country that even the biggest stars pass over on their so-called "world" tours. Through the eyes of four Rio de Janeiro pop music superfans, the most popular comment on the internet is explored as a vessel to highlight the uniting forces of music and the resilience of music lovers.

title: Fuga
overview: Life has not been fulfilling to Mari.

title: The House
overview: For decades, Gabriel García Márquez envisioned a novel titled La Casa (The House), inspired by the home in Aracataca where he lived with his grandparents. Fragments emerged, but it was only after living in another house —in Mexico City— that he was able to develop the work that became Cien años de soledad (One Hundred Years of Solitude), his magnum opus. In this documentary directed by Eva Villaseñor, the writer’s sons, Rodrigo and Gonzalo García Barcha, return to their childhood home—a place where memory transforms time.

title: Secondhand Embarrassment
overview: When two young shoppers spot a vintage sweater at a thrift store a high stakes battle ensues.

title: Semeei Vermelho
overview: Teresa, a Catholic girl, is torn between the desire she thinks she feels for Maria, her long-time friend, and her faith, which she is no longer sure she has. Teresa is increasingly consumed by the world around her, by her confirmation dress and by the moment that is brewing in this closed space: the confession of her sin.

title: Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
overview: In this new pseudo-vintage silent short film, a scientist discovers the horrible consequences when he allows his dark side complete control. This is directed by Gary Hill, and the novella "Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde" by Robert Louis Stevenson.

title: EQUILIBRIVM II
overview: Anitta returns once again for the definitive look of "EQUILIBRIVM", her seventh studio album. On a healing journey through music and religion, we see the singer return to her roots once again.

title: Riviera 76, le Woodstock oublié
overview: This legendary event was meant to be “the French Woodstock.” Almost no one remembers it today, because nothing — absolutely nothing — went according to plan... But in 2020, this extraordinary story resurfaced with the discovery of 153 metal canisters hidden away in a cellar, containing an untold number of film reels. Unseen for decades, these reels preserve the memory of an incredible chapter in music history : three days of a music festival at the height of the summer of 1976. A 350-hectare open-air site at the Paul Ricard Circuit in Le Castellet. The American organizers behind the legendary Woodstock at the helm. Joe Cocker roaring on stage. An expected crowd of 100,000. A budget of $1 million. The Rolling Stones' mobile recording truck on site to capture the performances for a live album... And yet, in the end, it all collapsed into spectacular failure—against the backdrop of the Var region's criminal underworld.

title: Talking Tom Hero’s on the Big Screen
overview: Talking Tom Heroes are coming to the big screen! An hour-long show featuring your very favourite episodes of the hit series and never-seen-before surprises!

title: Revenge: Australia
overview: Two friends run a gun-selling business in Australia. When one kills the other’s girlfriend and flees to Turkey, the betrayed friend sets out to take revenge. A tale of love, betrayal and revenge in Australia and Turkey.

title: Wait!
overview: Inspired by a true-ish story, this tale dives into the quietly epic, absurdly mundane test of human patience: waiting at a crosswalk.

title: SURPRISE
overview: A bathroom mishap at a surprise party sets off a chain of disastrous events that spiral wildly out of control.

title: N!PS
overview: A journey of a woman who braves public scrutiny to finally set her nipples free.

title: Camila
overview: Camila (2026) is a Brazilian psychological drama short film written and directed by Anthony Candido. The film explores the aftermath of trauma and the transformative nature of the creative process through an intimate, psychologically driven narrative.  The story follows Clarice, a writer struggling with a debilitating creative block who moves into an isolated apartment in search of a fresh start. Cut off from the outside world, she is left with no choice but to confront emotions and memories she cannot fully understand herself. As the boundaries between reality, memory, and imagination begin to dissolve, the enigmatic figure of Camila (?) emerges as a guide through Clarice’s inner descent, while the unsettling presence of a supposed neighbor slowly turns the apartment into a space of growing unease.

title: The Woman Who Cannot Feel
overview: Tasha is a woman diagnosed with Congenital Insensitivity to Pain. This condition makes her incapable of feeling pain – be it physical or emotional pain. And because of her condition, she also has no idea how love works. Until she meets Ngongo, a man with cleft palate. Ngongo becomes an instrument who made Tasha feel again, especially the joys of love and pains of heartache. And together, they experience an adventure that they will never forget.

title: 72 HOURS
overview: To save his career, a 40-year-old ad exec joins a crew of twentysomethings for a wild Miami bachelor party after they mistakenly add him to a group chat.

title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
overview: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

title: Max, Min and Meowzaki
overview: Max and Min are about to break up. They argue endlessly about dividing their possessions, including their cat, Meowzaki, whom they have named after their favorite artist Miyazaki Hayao. Max’s father Ramesh, who lost his wife and has since been suffering from insomnia, meets charming therapist Dhaara. Max’s grandfather Sridhar, secretly enjoys drinking with his new friend Jennifer at the nursing home.

title: Karavali
overview: Karavali is a film that explores the struggles between man and nature, set against the raw, untamed beauty of coastal Karnataka. The story revolves around the world of Kambala, a traditional annual buffalo race, showcasing the unique culture and challenges of the region.

title: The Dink
overview: Desperate to save a struggling country club and earn his father's respect, a washed-up tennis pro is compelled to break a sacred vow and do the unthinkable: play pickleball.

title: The Outer Threat
overview: After making a groundbreaking extraterrestrial discovery, astrophysicists Daniel and Michelle are forced to flee from home with their family — pursued through the countryside by a relentless and anonymous assailant. As their flight unfolds, the line between cosmic revelation and human paranoia blurs, leading to a tense and emotional confrontation that challenges the boundaries of understanding, science, and survival.

title: Haunted Heist
overview: Four estranged friends reunite at what appears to be a typical house, But one friend has ulterior motives; he plans to rob the place and needs their help to find an antique worth a fortune. But the house is straight up haunted, and the group must squash their differences to survive the night and an insane pack of ghosts.

title: Tera Yaar Hoon Main
overview: Sanju moves from Nagpur to Mumbai for work and stays with his late mother's friend Viswanath. He falls for Viswanath's daughter Anu, but her marriage is arranged with another man, leaving Viswanath caught between friendship and fatherhood.

title: I Blew Out the Candles Before Making a Wish
overview: Young Jojo suddenly comes into a stack of casino chips worth a million and decides to pay off her runaway father’s debt, asking the down-on-his-luck debt collector Hua to gamble on her behalf. In Macau’s chaotic casinos, they form an unlikely alliance, navigating wins, losses, and life’s challenges together. When the final bet arrives, fate cruelly tests them, stripping them of everything, yet revealing the true gift life has been offering. I Blew Out the Candle Before Making a Wish explores money, family, and responsibility, capturing the shadows and resilience of human nature.

title: Chennai Love Story

Their beginnings are modest, but gradually a connection develops between them, based not on pity but on shared humanity.

title: Shambhala Story

There, he meets a cantankerous elderly man and his parolee granddaughter, Emi. As Tashi grows closer to them, the distance between the lonely Emi and Tashi begins to shrink, and forbidden feelings start to emerge between them.

title: Katukutu Buro

title: Bushe
overview: Marta, a lovesick 15 year old, pines for a local boy named Karlo. As the traditional local carnival approaches, its mystical atmosphere and mask making tradition will take her on a personal journey where she will discover the true meaning of her identity.

title: Con City

title: The Taro Donatella Story
overview: From Underdog to legend - From silence to legend. The Taro Donatella Story is the true rise of a man who built an empire alone. A journey of ambition, obsession, and belief in the impossible. - "Mark Zuckerberg & Taro Donatella. One code. One invention. Who actually created the real-time algorithm? The truth behind the biggest lie in social media history - Coming Summer 2026."

overview: Essay film based on the homonymous book  by Juliet Berto.

overview: A nervous courier delivers a mysterious package to a rich drug boss on a remote road, but when their deal reveals an unexpected twist, a sudden police chase turns a simple exchange into a high-stakes fight to escape.

After some students take part in it, their ordinary days begin to change, and before long, a "certain incident" occurs. Taking the situation seriously, the school brings in a counselor, Koharu, to provide mental care for the students who witnessed the incident. However, one of the students who played the "game" turns out to be Koharu's sister, Nanami. One by one, the students are drawn into bizarre phenomena.

title: The Truthers

title: Eiga Kamen Raidā Zettsu Sayonara no Misshon
overview: Baku Yorozu/Kamen Rider ZEZTZ is accused of terrorism by the National Public Safety Commission. overview: Negative Emorgy emanating from MultiEarth A0073 coalesced into a massive void that swallowed the sun. The world lost its light and was engulfed in deep darkness. title: Ricochets
overview: Deeply affected by a series of unlikely and violent events in his youth, a solitary man has a fortuitous encounter.

title: SORTIE
overview: A private detective investigating a missing person case becomes trapped in a hypnotic noir labyrinth, where he discovers that every exit leads back inside.

overview: Two friends are having a sleepover and when one thing is said it all goes wrong

overview: The third installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

overview: Navya, the only daughter of powerful businessman Devi Prasad, is set for a grand wedding that soon goes off track due to unexpected twists. As secrets unfold and egos clash, the celebration turns into a modern-day swayamvar.

overview: After a social media meltdown, a middle aged man embarks on a wild journey to restore his reputation.

As each new victim is discovered, Captain Rocio Cortes and Detective Soto race to stop a killer who always seems one step ahead. Their investigation uncovers hidden secrets, broken family ties, and painful events from the past that connect several lives in unexpected ways. As suspicion shifts from one person to another, two brothers, Leo and Elias, find themselves at the center of a mystery that will test their loyalty and force them to confront the truth. overview: In a country dominated by repressive police and institutional powers, The Nebula operates clandestinely at night. To strengthen the Resistance, it reconstructs and revives corpses. Two members embark on a mission to break this cycle of violence.

overview: On the day of a solar eclipse, Ramiro accompanies the parents of his best friend to their house outside the city. During the visit, the son’s absence, while on exchange abroad, becomes evident and places him in an uneasy position.

overview: Leanne gradually falls into a dependence on virtual reality. These dreamlike worlds, infinite in beauty, give her a euphoria she can no longer find in real life. Until one experience shakes her deeply: the line between reality and the artificial blurs, and her grip on the real world begins to falter.

title: Bhootam Bhayyam
overview: Seven unemployed friends move into a cursed mansion and discover a mysterious coin. Using it in planchette sessions for quick cash, they awaken ancient forces. Now spirits and occultists hunt them as dark secrets emerge.

It traces the movement's rise, peak, and fall, the birth of a new nation, and invites us to question the narratives that have shaped our identity and the present we inhabit.

title: Heartstopper: Ending on a Hi
overview: After the ending of the hit Netflix series “Heartstopper”, this special combines never-before-seen behind-the-scenes footage, cast and crew interviews, larger cultural commentary, and fan input.

title: Last Night
overview: Strangers Arun and Tam meet on a rooftop the night they both intend to end their lives. When Arun suggests they spend the night together instead, just until sunrise, they embark on an unexpected journey through the city.

overview: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences.

Tam follows the revolutionary path, taking on the mission to Con Dao Island as a doctor to treat prisoners and work with the revolutionary organization.

title: Triple Decker
overview: Over the course of one bizarre day, a couple with a dangerous plan and a stranger with her own agenda find their lives colliding in the most unexpected ways. As secrets simmer beneath the surface, everything quickly spirals into a wild mix of chaos, dark humor, and perfectly timed misfortune—where every move only makes things worse.

title: Dr. Strangelove
overview: The Cameri Theater's adaptation of the widely famous Kubrick satire.

overview: When two roommates head into the woods to make a found footage movie, they stumble across something they never expected. Their low-budget film shoot quickly turns into a fight for survival in this horror-comedy.

overview: A young man tries to get his driver's license to fulfill his lifelong dream.

overview: A pizza delivery driver crosses paths with a bank robber.

title: The Terrible Power of Fiction
overview: María Finojosa, wife of Spanish settler Juan de Cervantes, tunes into the fragile memory of the exact moment when her husband became obsessed with founding a town that would perpetuate his family name. In the middle of the 19th century, in the mountains of Costa Rica, María's memory of her husband's Quixote-like delusions, unravels like the reel of an old film, projected onto the persistent rain and the constant lurking of the cracks of fiction.

title: Nowhere Left to Hide
overview: A desperate woman starts over again in a small seaside town after faking her own death to escape from her abusive husband. But when he tracks her down, he starts to threaten the lives of those around her until she agrees to be with him forever.
