overview: Andrea, her daughter Alex and her fish are moving out of the city. Andrea wants to brings them together despite the tensions, Alex does not speak, the fish is a bother and nobody really want to move out.

title: 俺の血はピンクの血 映画俳優久保新二
overview: A documentary about pink actor Shinji Kubo, "the King of Pink", that explores his fifty-year career spent racing through the fringes of the Japanese film industry.

title: Pura Vida
overview: 8 delegates set off for an all-expenses-paid Eco convention, in one of the worlds most exotic locations. But fantasies of sun, sea and salsa come crashing down when dreams turn to nightmares full of crocodiles and murder.

title: Moms Guardian
overview: When the mom who abandoned her passes away, Victoria must confront her feelings about the situation when someone unexpected shows up. Her mom's guardian.

title: Indrajaal
overview: A legendary treasure hidden during colonial times reappears every 12 years during a solar eclipse. Treasure hunters race to find it but become caught in an ancient prophecy, leading to a gripping tale of ambition and survival.

title: Kubana
overview: In Rwanda, KUBANA explores, through stories and silences, how a society chooses unity and coexistence, offering a poetic and political look at living together.

title: First Night Nerves
overview: Yuan Xiuling, a former star and has-been actress plans to return to the spotlight of the theater a year after her philandering husband died. She decides to star in Two Sisters, written and directed by transwoman An Ouyang. But, her biggest rival, He Yuwen, a rising actress, also stars in the play. Yuwen plans her theatrical debut through it. During the preparation of the play, such a drama unfolds at the backstage as much as on stage. With the opening night at Hong Kong’s City Hall Theater just seven days away, tensions at rehearsal increase and tempers flare as actresses Xiuling and Yuwen’s buried resentments rise to the surface.

title: Sudesha
overview: The story of a woman living in a village in the lower Himalayas. In this area, people depend entirely on the forest for their daily needs of firewood, food and water. But the forests have been destroyed by powerful timber traders. And along with the forest, the livelihood of the people has been greatly altered. The women of this region played an active role in the "Chipkow Movement". Sudesha was imprisoned for her protest.

title: The Belief
overview: In the twenty-second year of the Kangxi Emperor's reign (1683 A.D.), in an attempt to stop Zheng's blatant attempts at independence in Taiwan, the Kangxi Emperor sent Shi Lang, the governor of the Fujian Naval Division, to lead an army to collect Taiwan. An advance team from the imperial court paid a terrible price to lure Zheng's navy into a trap. Shi Lang led a large naval force to attack Penghu in a surprise attack, wiping out the main force of Zheng's army and eventually unifying Taiwan.

title: The Decisive Moment
overview: In the future, three Chinese astronauts, on their way back to Earth, encountered a complicated situation and lost contact with the ground. At the moment of crisis, they received an electronic signal, and their destiny will be completely changed by a mysterious code hidden in this signal.

title: Meadowhawk
overview: When washed-up actor David Eastman participates in a comic convention in order to earn money for his granddaughter, he encounters his former co-star and rival Rick Majors for the first time in 40 years.

overview: Three friends find themselves in an unprecedented search for an unknown man around their hometown.

title: Homo Machina
overview: As a lonely man isolates himself, the line between the digital and physical world blurs.

overview: The hugely popular manga "Chainsaw Man" by Tatsuki Fujimoto is being adapted into a stage play! The highly anticipated second installment "Reze Arc."

title: Kado untuk Ibu
overview: Faris, a firefighter expecting his first child, cancels his trip to the hospital to be with his wife because he has to help Ara find a birthday present for her mother. Their journey becomes an exciting adventure that teaches many good deeds and the meaning of unexpected loss.

title: Love Under the Mistletoe
overview: Interior designer Grace (Lilley) runs a business with her best friend and her brother in the quaint town of Ivy Glen, but is too busy for a real relationship. Ryan (Bateman), a successful New York City financial adviser and Grace's former high school crush, returns home planning to sell his grandmother's historic St. Nicholas House. The mayor convinces him to revive the beloved "Ribbons and Bows" charity fundraiser and brings Grace on board to help. Working side by side to pull the event together, the former couple reminisces and feelings they once shared slowly resurface. But will this yuletide reunion lead to love under the mistletoe?

title: いってらっしゃいの花
Breakfast
overview: On the cusp of a big announcement, a frazzled mom prepares a glorious breakfast for her family. But, when they run for the door before even sampling her buffet, Mom takes matters into her own hands - holding them hostage until every scrap of food is gone.

title: Light Through The Dust
overview: When the 2011 Christchurch earthquake struck, tattoo apprentice Bonnie Singh was inside Southern Ink, the studio where she had finally begun chasing her dream. The tattoo studio collapsed and Bonnie, trapped in the rubble, suffered a broken back, a shattered neck, and a brain injury that would affect her for life.  With the help of fellow tattooist Jak Law, Bonnie is determined to push through physical and neurological limitations to master the craft of tattooing that once seemed out of reach. A story of resilience, reinvention, and the invisible scars we carry, this is not just a film about tattoos but instead is about what it means to rebuild a life and the importance of having a dream when everything has fallen away.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 6

Modeste claimed recurring encounters with extraterrestrials, documenting them through photography before her unexplained disappearance gave her an almost mythical status. Together, Océane and her anonymous friend reconstruct a portrait of this ghostly figure through a docufiction collage of memories, images, and small-town gossip.

overview: In a world where people have forgotten how to love, Tetsu, driven by a strange longing for something lost, embarks on a journey to recover what seems to have vanished from her world. Guided by a witch, she sets out in search of three strange beings who, in one way or another, still know how to love. Through encounters that blur the boundaries between memory, fantasy, and perception, her journey will lead her toward emotions and memories she believed had been forgotten.

overview: Benny is haunted by guilt after his fiance dies in a car accident. In his spiral, he reconnects with Kam, a troubled childhood friend who pulls him into robbery and fraud, a desperate plan to flee to Mexico and leave their lives behind.

The roommates face their toughest battles during recovery while pushing each other to continue training for their next bouts.

overview: After surviving a horrific car crash and losing his arm, an unstable family man develops a bizarre fascination for augmenting his body with bionic prosthetics.

Among sculpted dancers, scant costumes, and sky-high platforms, she feels awkward, alien, and instantly out of place.

overview: A seamstress tries to make her grandmother’s impossibly-narrow-waisted-heirloom dress fit. After it refuses to be altered, visions of her grandmother encourage her to alter herself instead.

title: I'm in Love with a Stripper
overview: Alone on Christmas Eve, Michael makes a last-ditch effort to win back his ex-girlfriend. Although repelled by his sudden reappearance, the promise of $1000 buys ten minutes of Honey’s time as she reluctantly sits through his declaration of love. Michael’s dreams of a heartfelt reunion are shattered when he is promptly rejected by a stripper who refuses to participate in his fantasy, challenging toxic romantic comedy tropes normalized through contemporary media. Based on her semi-autobiographical stage play, Never Walk Alone, Julie Phan offers a desensationalized interpretation of sex work through an intimate representation of the person underneath the projection.

title: KING
overview: King, a champion of a gruesome fighting organization, lives, trains, and brawls under one roof with his roommate Sam. They compete in grueling matches that leave them bruised and battered, however, still motivated. The fighters are driven by a distant concept of success they can only view on the TV screen. The roommates face their toughest battles during recovery while pushing each other to continue training for their next bouts.

After a traumatic experience with his church, he is forced to undergo one of the hardest years of his life, and uncover his own individuality while unbeknownst to him, he is being followed by a mysterious figure known only as The Phantom.

overview: Lucas breaks the silence of the early morning in search of something to satisfy his hunger; what seems like a harmless act sets off an odyssey filled with determination and unexpected rivals.

In a waiting room filled with eccentric patients and absurd stories of masculinity, Rekki begins to question what it truly means to be a man.  But when he finally meets Neng Esih IX, a young therapist and heir to a legendary ancestral healing practice, something that no treatment has ever been able to awaken emerges on its own. An absurdist comedy about masculinity, hope, and how human connection can sometimes be more powerful than any mystical remedy.

overview: Stray Kids RUN IT concert in SEOUL

title: Rienzi: Bayreuth Festival 2026
overview: Opening the 2026 Bayreuth Festival in its 150th anniversary year, this live stream presents Wagner’s Rienzi, his early grand opera and once his greatest success, in the Festspielhaus for the first time. The staging is entrusted to award-winning directors Alexandra Szemerédy and Magdolna Parditka, while Nathalie Stutzmann conducts a superb cast led by Heldentenor Andreas Schager in the title role, with Gabriela Scherer as Irene and Jennifer Holloway as Adriano. With its massed choruses, public spectacle and private tragedy, Rienzi promises to open this landmark Bayreuth Festival in unmissable style.

title: K-Pop Shark Heroes
overview: Follows Ken Jeong and Rei Ami as they launch a public awareness campaign to reshape the perception of sharks across East Asia using K-Pop after shark encounters off the Korean Peninsula.

title: El pez que fuma

The media crucifies her, turning her into a controversial figure. Decades later, she returns to the iconic film, now as the lead. As she embarks on the remake's production, her personal life spirals into a passionate affair with the married director and a complicated romance with the young male protagonist. Life and art intertwine as her real-world turmoil mirrors the love triangle she portrays on screen. More than just the professional redemption she seeks, The Smoking Fish will once again change her life in unexpected ways.

title: The Ultimate Linemarker
overview: We follow Borus, a road line marker who treats asphalt like a sacred canvas, as he passionately explains the emotional and deep importance of straight lines, proper spacing, and precision. His manager and a rival crew who see the job as “just paint” are brought into the world of Borus, who always has a new way of sharing his passion of the job. His world is thrown into chaos when a reckless young teammate commits the ultimate workplace sin: unauthorized road doodling. As Borus spirals over compromised line integrity, In the ultimate irony, he is “punished” with the assignment of his dreams — the very stretch of road he’s been dreaming about for years. For Borus, it’s not discipline. It’s destiny.

title: Man Chicken
overview: In this found footage comedy, two brothers go on an adventure to find the urban legend known as "Man Chicken." The trip takes a turn for the worst, as the truth begins to reveal itself, the deeper they travel into the forest.

title: Schlüssel-Schloss-Witz
overview: Strange sounds emit from an apartment. An isolated man decides to investigate, shortly before being evicted himself.

title: Wham! 10 Days in China
overview: In 1985, WHAM! made history as the first Western pop act to perform in communist China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley’s concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou were a cultural milestone – East meets West, music meets politics. Now, newly restored footage reveals the untold story of the iconic tour that helped launch WHAM! to global superstardom.

title: Mary Beth Barone: Galaxy Brain
overview: Is an ex-best friend the worst ex? Can dating apps save democracy? What's with NYPD merch? Mary Beth Barone has all the answers in this witty special.

title: Bagman
overview: A graduate researcher monitoring wildlife cameras notices a garbage bag suddenly appear in a forest clearing. She sends her senior technician to check it out--watching his every move through the live camera feed.

title: Hackneyed
overview: Two guys kiss at a club and find themselves with different expectations for how the night will unfold, leading to a deep conversation about relationships and feelings.

title: RESET
overview: In a world where citizens are reset to six at age 65, a young woman must care for her newly-reset mother and find her estranged father before the state intervenes— only to discover that healing her family means reparenting the child her mother never got to be.

title: Winky's Speakeasy
overview: Booze, banter and boings. Welcome to the saloon for washed-up cartoons.

title: Jurassic Sharks
overview: The special takes viewers deep into prehistoric waters to explore the ancient ancestors of today's sharks. Using animation, the episode highlights some of the most feared prehistoric ocean creatures, including the Dunkleosteus, the buzzsaw shark (Helicoprion), and the scissor-toothed shark (Edestus).

title: Marvelous Mornings
overview: At her grandmother's funeral, Charlie learns that she already has a place reserved in the family vault. In search of an escape, she herself delivers the crate of disco vinyls her grandmother left to the wine merchant in a village in the south of France. In the deserted seaside resort, the records bring back bitter memories of lost loves. Here, time has a different value, and people are more bored than busy. Charlie only has eyes for Marina, the waitress at the pizzeria. Nothing predestined clumsy, overly sincere Charlie and wounded tornado Marina to mend fences together. But sometimes destiny reunites lost mermaids.

title: The Gorals
overview: With 200 days left before college entrance exams, In-hye, who cares for the school's animal pen, spends her time lecturing a duck instead of studying. Seo-hee, punished for carrying a knife, joins her, and they discover an abandoned meadow where they lose the duck, Hee-seon. Meanwhile, teacher Kim Ah-tae forms a college interview prep group for four neglected students. On interview day, In-hye and Seo-hee ditch school to find Hee-seon, camping in the meadow and gradually learning to survive in the wild.

title: Madame
overview: To make ends meet, Laura takes a job working for Souria in a grand mansion in Paris’s Golden Triangle. Installed there by her lover, a wealthy Saudi prince, Souria lives in anticipation of his visits. As Laura struggles to adjust to this world of excessive luxury and constant surveillance, a fragile bond begins to form between the two women. But Laura senses that Souria is in danger, and that this gilded cage may be closing in on them both.

title: The Devil's Mouth
overview: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

title: Saint Eulalia
overview: Eulàlia, a sixteen-year-old girl with a gift for healing, has always cared for those most in need in the village of Alaior. But lately, the strain of her gift has left her exhausted and alone.

title: Filíocht Na Corcaí
overview: An intimate documentary showcasing the vibrant poetry scene of Cork City and the talented community of artists involved in these incredible nights.

title: Love/Bug
overview: A couple, affectionately naming each other Love and Bug, test the limits of their love living with each other for fifteen months.

title: Empty Pockets
overview: Ada and Ewa are two young schoolteachers in love who discover that their apartment building is scheduled for demolition. Unwilling to return to their families, and lacking both savings and clear prospects, they embark on a chaotic quest for a new home. Their journey through the city transforms into an absurd odyssey, introducing them to various fellow citizens navigating the housing crisis. Amidst this systemic uncertainty, they fight to preserve both their sense of humor and their relationship.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 8
overview: The eighth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on July 29, 2026, at Yamato Arena in Suita, Osaka, Japan, and was headlined by an A Block match between Yota Tsuji and Yuto-Ice.

title: Ceiling King
overview: A woman visits her childhood home one last time and accidentally discovers an old answering machine. It still works. On the tape, she hears a message from the past, her own childhood voice and her father's: "We are not home right now. Please leave a message after the tone..." A glitch from another time. But when the message ends, there is suddenly another one.

title: God Hunter
overview: In a world where beings from myth and folklore have entered our realm, an undercover cop infiltrates a trafficking ring that smuggles and sells these beings to find his son.

title: Cattle
overview: A quiet farmer is pushed to the breaking point by a group of teenagers.

title: Jared Leto: Hollywood's Dark Secret
overview: An investigative documentary exploring long-standing and newly detailed allegations of sexual misconduct, grooming, and criminal sexual conduct against Oscar-winning actor and Thirty Seconds to Mars frontman Jared Leto.

title: Cigarette Smoke
overview: Two places, two kinds of smoke: one cigarette says everything, one vape says nothing at all.

title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

title: Wishlist for Superagüi
overview: Martelo is a 70-year-old fisherman who has not yet been able to retire. He is the lighthouse man, points his light towards the island of Superagüi and illuminates earthly desires: better working conditions, retiring with dignity, returning to the way things used to be.

title: He Who Saw the Abyss
overview: The gun pointed at the head is a delirium that expands into disorderly controlled chaos. “He Who Saw the Abyss” by Gregorio Gananian and Negro Leo, is like a car that enters the curve at 300km/h, but slowly. In an experimental whirlwind, moving between a noisy sound and an almost idyllic musicality, the film is structured out of a pile of images that seem as intimate as they are delirious, accelerating into a trance that is fragmented by a montage, signed by João Dumans and Gregorio Gananian, who strive to articulate an intense experience on the big screen.

title: Restlessness
overview: A mysterious story of a man who got stuck at a provincial hotel, where strange things are happening and guests keep dying one after another.

title: Sajen Satu Suro
overview: Tania (Aisyah Aqilah) returns to Maduabang Village with Jeff (Cinta Brian Glenn Roberts), Laura (Frislly Herlinda Balqis), and Robby (Munggaran Meldrat). They plan to return the heirloom keris belonging to her grandfather, Sapto Dilogo (Clift Sangra), in order to cure her mother, who is suffering from a mysterious illness. Their arrival with the keris stirs up the villagers’ fears that the spirit of Sumarni (Assila Corina ) has returned. The bride-to-be was murdered by Sapto Dilogo with that very keris. Tania and her friends find themselves caught up in the revenge plot of Suparti (Yurike Prastica) and Aryoseno (Harris Syaus), which is closely tied to a past tragedy that occurred on the night of 1 Suro. Amid supernatural terror and a series of attacks that claim victims, Tania finally uncovers the dark truth about her family.

title: Andai Waktu Bisa Diulang Kembali
overview: Dinar falls for Faiz, who brings color to her dull life. Amid their romance, she faces mounting troubles—unpaid tuition, her late father’s debts, and her mother’s cancer. Then, Firman, a wealthy man, offers her an easy escape—but at the cost of betraying Faiz.

title: Margeado
overview: The river is not the same. It has turned into contaminated mud. Residents of a fishing village face an uncertain future after the dam burst. Yara and Dingue resume their lives, remain and drift in the memory of the place while the waters run down the mountains in the face of the indomitable forces of nature.

title: Pluto
overview: Follows the unexpected arrival of an extraterrestrial visitor in a quiet Kerala village, which turns everyday life completely upside down.

title: Pure Scum
overview: After a drug-fueled car crash, ex-private schoolboys Ayden and Jesse escape into the Melbourne CBD and are plunged into a night of unbridled debauchery and rapidly escalating violence.

title: The Invisible Half
overview: Elena, a "half" Japanese high school girl, struggles with her identity. While constantly watched, she discovers she's also being watched by something else—a monster that can only be seen through her smartphone and heard through her earphones.

title: Interstate
overview: Set in 2009, a group of lost high school graduates embark on a road trip to find themselves before they enter the next chapter of their lives. However, their plans take a twist when both old and new drama emerges, threatening to break their fragile group bond.

title: За любовь
overview: A couple on the brink of divorce receives a magic bottle that grants wishes, turning their lives upside down.

title: Ashes
overview: One night. One gun. Two estranged brothers reunited by the man who killed their parents and a choice that will either damn them both or lead one to grace.

title: Srinivasa Mangapuram
overview: Vasu Babu and Manga are living in their own blissful world, until a ruthless threat targets their romance. As powerful enemies move to separate them, Vasu must fight for his woman.

title: The Fabulous Time Machine
overview: What if it were possible to travel back in time to dream of other futures? In the hinterlands of Brazil, young girls navigate the delicate transition from childhood to adolescence while grappling with social media, religion, their dreams, and the stories of the women who came before them. By inventing a time machine, they revisit the pasts of their mothers and grandmothers and imagine a future in which they can be free, fulfilled, and in control of their own choices.

title: Bhai Tera Star Hai
overview: An actor's cricket gambling debt puts him on a deadly deadline. His lie about his sister sets off a catastrophic evening of confused criminals, botched crimes, and pandemonium racing across London.

title: A Prince in Paradise: A Royal Wedding
overview: When the fairytale royal wedding of Olivia Perkins and Prince Alexander is derailed by an archaic law, the couple must confront an uncertain future and fight for their right to be together.

title: The Elder Eagle
overview: The old man refuses to leave his native village, abandoned by other residents long time ago. To stand up to the local authorities, who have their own plans for the beautiful mountain land, he lures by deceit his son and grandchildren from Moscow – they must help him turn the village into an eco-touristic place. The family members get a chance to reconnect with their roots, see each other in a new light, and become a close, loving family.

title: Encore, encore...
overview: On the last night of his closing Cambodian restaurant, Pou struggles to accept his career is coming to an end.

title: Death Note - The Musical
overview: If you had the power over life and death, what would you do?  Now, boldly reimagined for the London stage in close collaboration with the original Japanese producers, HoriPro, this new musical features an electrifying score by Tony, Grammy and Emmy nominee Frank Wildhorn, lyrics by Jack Murphy and a book by Ivan Menchell. Death Note: The Musical is set to be the theatrical event of the summer.  When brilliant student Light Yagami discovers a notebook with the power to determine who lives and who dies, his mission to reshape society quickly spirals out of control and attracts the attention of the elusive and ruthless detective L. What begins as justice descends into obsession and forces both Light and L to confront the limits of morality itself.

title: Tomb Quest
overview: In a suburban basement, five old friends meet on the night of their friend's funeral to fulfill his final request: finish the Tomb Quest role-playing campaign they abandoned after their high school graduation.

title: Pentacide
overview: In 1999, a series of grisly, religiously inspired killings struck the country repeating every five years, now in the present day (2024) the story follows two detectives who are trying to solve the biggest serial killer case the UK has ever seen!

title: Addicted to Change
overview: In a near future Britain, at a biotech lab on the brink of collapse, three interns invent a cognitive enhancing drug. They begin full scale manufacture, only to become targets of government forces who view their breakthrough as a threat.

title: The Ungrateful Tenant
overview: It’s 2026 Auckland, New Zealand, through the black-and-white lens of the German expressionist silent era. If it weren't for the online group chat and the overused electric heater, the city’s 100-year-old bungalows with no insulation would make you believe it’s the 1920s.  The Ungrateful Tenant follows an anxiety-ridden millennial renter who dreams of one day buying his own house. When his paranoid frustration comes to a head, he kicks out his ‘nightmare’ flatmate, only to be struck back by instant karma, sending him on a cursed odyssey in and out of flats across Auckland. Experience the brutal absurdity of the housing crisis in slapstick fashion.

title: Tiny Rejections
overview: Taylor and her friend try to climb a fence at night but something looms in the shadows.

title: Screen of the Dead
overview: In a quiet backyard, Gaby finds her friends frozen over their phones. When they finally look up, an ordinary afternoon spirals into a bloody, absurd fight for survival.

title: Mickey's Country Farm
overview: Mickey and friends use their new farm vehicles to build the Fairest Farm Fair ever — hoping Daisy’s cowgirl idol, Lasso Lucy, will stop by for a visit.

title: Fuga 22
overview: A snappy and hyper-saturated ode and eulogy to growing up in Tegucigalpa, Honduras, and immigrating to Canada. A slice of life through the lens of a camcorder.

title: The Two Year Rule
overview: On the way to a cottage weekend with friends, a couple’s drive takes an unexpected turn when a passing cemetery stirs unresolved tensions.

title: AMUCK
overview: A man who laments "not even feeling like the main character of his own story" suddenly finds himself aware of the camera that's watching him, eliciting a mind-bending journey of self discovery.

title: Afterliving
overview: A woman arrives at The Bureau, a mysterious in-between, where her life is put to a test before her fate can be decided.

title: Familiar Strangers
overview: A short drama exploring how different people deal with grief.

title: Hierophany
overview: An extraterrestrial-obsessed man is troubled by nightly visitations from a mysterious presence.

title: Sisters of the Shattered Moon
overview: When a teenage girl discovers the corruption of her futuristic suburban idyll in the clouds, she is expelled to a vast underworld of endless night.

title: windowfilm
overview: A journey between Astoria and Herald Square through the windows of the train.

title: Chasing Home
overview: A 30-year-old British-Mexican comic creator visits her parents to secure a deposit for her first flat, only to find help won’t come because her mother, 51, is pregnant.

title: La Otra Mejilla
overview: 'When you're slapped, there are many ways to respond besides crying: you can slap back, you can offer the other cheek, and you can also say, "Hit, but listen."' This is the film adaptation of the visual album "La Otra Mejilla" (The Other Cheek) by Argentine singer Feli Colina, where a unique universe is created, bringing the album's emotional, theatrical, and poetic power to the screen. It follows a woman as she navigates the versions others have constructed about her until she rediscovers herself.

title: Fenestral
overview: After an argument with his roommate, Luca sees a creepy face at the window - On the third floor.

title: Simon Says
overview: A group of friends gathers for a party when a mysterious entertainer named Simon arrives to host a game of Simon Says. What begins as a harmless game becomes a deadly fight for survival, where one wrong move can cost them their lives.

title: Favorite Child
overview: A group of siblings must confront their tensions and secrets when a family dog accidentally ingests one brother's pills. As fear and guilt surface, the crisis forces the fractured family closer together.

title: Birds of a Kind
overview: An innocent love story between a Jewish German Genetic Researcher  and a beautiful Arabic history student becomes a life changing drama when they are involved in a terror attack in Israel that puts him into a coma. When his father returns to Israel to be with him until his recovery, he is forced to face the horrible secrets in the relationship of his parents that caused him to leave Israel and change both his past,  future and his whole identity.

title: Tomb Quest
overview: In a suburban basement, five old friends meet on the night of their friend's funeral to fulfill his final request: finish the Tomb Quest role-playing campaign they abandoned after their high school graduation.

title: Silent Traces
overview: Faris, a teenager raised by a single father after losing his mother at a young age, grows up believing that he is no longer valued. His father's constant busyness causes every attempt to seek attention and affection to end in disappointment. However, an unexpected loss forces Faris to see a side of his father that he had misunderstood all along. Beneath his father's silence and stern demeanor lies the love and unwavering support he had always longed for, leaving Faris with profound regret and an apology that can never be spoken.

title: The Garden of Sinners: Future Gospel
overview: A side story of the original Kara no Kyōkai - the Garden of sinners movie series divided into 2 parts. In the first part, Shizune Seo, who finds her life too predictable due to her precognition, and Mitsuru‎ Kamekura, who uses his precognition to be a professional bomber, meet Mikiya and Shiki, respectively, and their futures begin to change. In the second part, 10 years after the original series, Shiki and Mikiya's daughter, Mana Ryōgi, spends a day with Mitsuru.

title: Soulm8te
overview: After a ruthless tech giant acquires a small robotics company, a grieving engineer is tasked with testing their new AI companion. But when he attempts to reprogram her to be a truly sentient soulmate, she develops needs of her own—unleashing a relentless spree of precision-engineered mayhem.

title: Jimmy
overview: In November 1948, James Baldwin left New York and, thanks to a fellowship grant, relocated to Paris. The 24-year-old writer would spend most of the next decade there, escaping American racism and his own social alienation, ensconcing himself in the city’s Algerian quarters and the community of Left Bank artists in Saint-Germain-des-Prés, and writing his first books.

title: Lost Men
overview: My grandfather, married for 57 years in Costa Rica, died in a fire in 2019. My father revealed to me that, like myself, my grandfather was gay. After this revelation, together we revisit my grandfather's life, seeking to give him one last act of liberation while discovering ourselves in the process.

title: Rao Bahadur
overview: Plagued by guilt and fear, an eccentric aristocrat retreats into his ancestral manor, creating an alternate world that deeply blurs reality and imagination.

title: The Gentleman Thief
overview: A retired master thief must protect his impulsive brother from disaster when a 100 million dollar yacht heist spirals into a dangerous web of deception. Old foes emerge as the stakes rise, forcing him to use every trick he knows to stay alive.

title: Wild Inside
overview: On February 2, 2023, Flaco — a male Eurasian eagle-owl, the largest species of owl in the world — was discovered missing from his cage at the Central Park Zoo in Manhattan. What follows when Flaco, who had lived his entire life in captivity, was released in New York City is a surprising story revealing the delight, concern, and fascination of millions in the city and beyond.

title: Gatta Kusthi 2
overview: Picks up after the first film, with Veera and Keerthi balancing parenthood and Keerthi's wrestling career, featuring a role reversal where Veera takes on more domestic responsibilities.

title: Black Burns Fast
overview: Black Burns Fast is a queer and quirky coming of age film set in at a prestigious boarding school in South Africa. 17-year-old adorkable Luthando is on track for a normal academic year, until Ayanda arrives at the school and forces her to rethink everything. In the aftermath, Luthando struggles with juggling multiple identities to avoid rejection from her mother and her schoolmates as she comes to terms with her sexuality.

title: Last Night in Taipei
overview: Blanche, Jake, and Axin went their separate ways six years ago, after sharing a close friendship and a dream of becoming actors. Since then, they've had no contact. What happened? Fate reunites them tonight in the heart of Taipei, but they only have a few hours to uncover the secrets hidden in each other’s hearts.

title: The Beast of Gevautwo
overview: Six months after the events of the first film, we find the mayor still alive at the bar, the beast is striking again, so they’ll have to fight back...

title: Unmadham
overview: A police constable reopens a long-forgotten case and experiences an unsettling world.

title: Crayon Shin-chan the Movie: Very Bizarre! My Yokai Vacation
overview: Shin-chan and his family visit his father's home town of Akita in order to view the Omagari Fireworks Festival. When a strange incident to causes the residents of “Yokai Land” to begin running wild throughout Akita and the rest of Japan, Shin-chan and company are lured to “Yokai Land” for an unusual adventure.

title: Bonecos de Estado em Golpes de Plástico
Kids' Festival! All the Heroes of Justice Appear
overview: Kids' Festival! All the Heroes of Justice Appear was a televised celebration of tokusatsu heroes in 1976.

title: HANDMEDOWN
overview: An experimental micro-documentary and multigenerational handing down of queer sexual wisdom and whimsy.

title: Bad Beast
overview: An orphaned girl named Atenea lives in isolation with other children. When adopted by a family, she glimpses a chance at belonging, but her fear of losing this newfound home drives her to extreme measures.

title: Dead & Breakfast
overview: The story follows Danielle Stanbreaker, a paranormal consultant investigating a strange supernatural occurrence at a local Bed and Breakfast that ultimately ends up being real.

title: Comparable
overview: A Writer struggles to tap into his imagination as another, younger Writer shows off in front of him.

title: Tokyo Nightfall
overview: A young man named Amenashi is haunted by the death of his younger sister Anna, who took her own life after witnessing a classmate’s suicide in high school. Burdened by guilt, he continues to chase her memory. One night, he learns of a secret mass suicide event held in a Tokyo nightclub and is drawn to it. His close friends, Nozu and Hattori, grow suspicious and follow him inside. In a closed-off space filled with despairing youths, the three attempt to escape, but are ultimately forced to confront the emotions they have each been carrying deep within.

title: Super Duper
overview: On the night of a highly anticipated Super Duper Moon, two people embark on an intimate nighttime journey together. As clouds obscure the sky and the night stretches on, anticipation gives way to waiting, uncertainty, and presence. With the spectacle they planned for absent, the meaning of the evening must be negotiated through behavior, silence, and choice—revealing whether love is sustained by symbols or by staying.

title: Ma Ago Timi Pani
overview: Ma Ago Timi Pani is a Kumude Hidto Hero Banna movie song

title: GALAXIES
overview: An aimless weed dealer has all of his product stolen along with his beloved Nike Galaxy Foamposites.

title: One Guy, Too Many Dates
overview: After one too many disastrous dates, a talented software engineer creates a women-centered app where users can anonymously review their dating experiences. What begins as a simple idea quickly turns into a viral phenomenon, igniting chaos between men and women online, attracting media attention, and complicating Emily’s own love life. In a world where everyone has opinions about dating, Emily discovers that building an app about relationships might be easier than surviving one.

title: Consequence
overview: After risking a patients life while unfit to operate, a surgeon tackles his guilt as his daughter's wedding approaches.

title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
overview: When Snoopy's beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.

title: Toe Tags
overview: TOE TAGS – Feet as Fetish, Fragment, Ghost  From Phallacies, which stripped the male body of shame and censorship, to Analogies, exploring the taboo of the anus, Toe Tags steps into a new obsession: the foot.  Feet become fetish, memory, and horror: a woman inherits her mother’s shoes (CLARA), a transvestite searches for feet that fit (THE PERFECT PAIR), a child avenges his monstrous father (PODOPHILE), a schizophrenic confuses nail visions with reality (NAILS), a man dances one last time with his wife’s ghost (SHOES NUMBER 43), and a mermaid mourns the tail she abandoned (PART OF YOUR WORLD).  ToeTag – where obsession walks, steps, and sometimes, kills.

title: The Secret Battlefield
overview: In April 1941, months before the Pacific War begins, Japan’s brightest young elites, bureaucrats, military officers, and civilians, are secretly assembled at the Total War Research Institute. Tasked with simulating a conflict against the United States, they confront harsh realities through intense analysis.

title: Mimic
overview: A car in the night. Two voices talking about death. Outside, something decided to listen.

title: Roadkill
overview: An unknown man is on the loose, murdering people and leaving them on the side of the road. You must be careful when driving, or you could be next.

title: The Delivery
overview: On his final delivery of the day, a courier finds that the address leads to a house that seems long abandoned. But the package carries a specific instruction: deliver in person...

title: Obsess
overview: Lucy Bel, a literary icon and woman of power, sees her empire threatened by an admirer whose fascination turns into obsession. When admiration is no longer enough, becoming her becomes a necessity. How far must one go to stay on top?

title: Birdcall
overview: Years after an avian-spread disease forces humanity into secluded cities, a foolhardy scientist and his wife, a wayward survivor, spend a night at a cabin outside of their compound. Recently infected and unbeknownst to his partner, he uses their seclusion as a trial run for his untested cure.

title: Intralight
overview: INTRALUZ follows Ella, a woman caught between memories and symbols that come to life, reminding her of past moments and unresolved emotions. Through poetic encounters and elements of magical realism, Ella journeys through her inner world, confronting fears, desires, and doubts. This voyage allows her to reconcile with herself and accept who she truly is, discovering the freedom that emerges when one dares to look within.

title: One Day, Five Years
overview: Two aspiring actors fall in love on a walk home from class—five years later in LA they take the same walk, this time to let each other go.

title: Doomed
overview: A psyhological thriller story about a boy who is trying to find himself

title: One Day: Look At The Sky
overview: A reflective soul journeys through memories of love, loss, and identity, ultimately embracing humility and the eternal cycle of transformation, reminding us that even fallen stars can rise again.

title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 9
overview: The ninth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on July 31, 2026, at Takamatsu City Gymnasium in Takamatsu, Kagawa, Japan, and was headlined by a B Block match between Yuya Uemura and Aaron Wolf.

title: Merci Charlotte !
overview: In a romantic jazz bar atmosphere, Émile’s first date takes an unexpected turn when he realizes the woman he’s meeting has lied about her age.

title: Atelo
overview: After a brutal race, Damian and Amelia attempt to escape with the blood money they stole.

title: No Eggs For Breakfast Today
overview: A young man attempts to destroy the evidence of his girlfriend's murder, only to wake up the next morning and discover that his efforts were in vain.

title: DON'DUT
overview: Aflah and his team began working on a personal documentary about Aflah challenging himself to lose weight. But as time went on, his goals began to crumble, his diet slowly lost focus, while Aflah’s desire to control the direction of the film only grew stronger. His team began to question whether this documentary was truly about change, or simply about Aflah wanting to make himself the center of the story.

title: No One Goes to the Movies Anymore
overview: Everyone’s been whispering about the haunting figure in the theatre, the silent presence that appears rows behind, watching. Fear has emptied the cinemas, leaving audiences to hide at home. But Lauren refuses to let go of the big screen. Determined to bring her reluctant friend to the film she’s been dying to see, she risks discovering whether she was right all along... or if the nightmare in the dark is real.

title: La Chandleur
overview: Albert, a young man in his twenties, lives alone in his grandfather's country house under one condition: he must take care of the farm animals. While getting ready for a date, he discovers that a fox has attacked the ducks in the coop. Determined to protect the last surviving goose, Albert cancels his dinner and spends the night waiting for the animal. But he realizes that what he is hunting is not just a simple fox, but a far more terrifying entity: the Chandleur.

title: Objection My Lord
overview: A father burns himself alive outside the Hyderabad High Court, demanding justice for his missing daughter, Sameera. When the system moves on and forgets, one question remains.Did Sameera ever exist? A forgotten lawyer, Parshuram, is forced out of self imposed exile to fight for the answer.

title: Bakom Svärtan
overview: Go behind the scenes of the TV series *Svärtan*. It follows a group of young people who discover an injured mermaid on an island in the archipelago. The series is based on the book *Sommaren 1985* by John Ajvide Lindqvist, a master at blending Swedish realism with the supernatural. Behind the scenes, an intensive effort is underway to create the mermaid and make her look authentic.

title: Beautiful Birds
overview: When a widowed birdwatcher reluctantly teams up with her granddaughter for a local birdwatching competition on an island in Scotland, their search for rare species becomes a heartfelt journey through grief, love, and letting go.

title: Summer '16
overview: Set during the summer of 2016, Jared's world shifts when his best friend, Bando, lands his first job—forcing Jared to confront the one thing he's been avoiding: growing up.

title: Maaran
overview: In a patriarchal society, two strangers - Birwa, a trafficking survivor, and Tara, who faces the same fate - are drawn into the path of a ruthless predator. Maaran exposes the devastating impact of gender-based violence and oppression.

title: The Twin Who Lived
overview: After discovering she once had a twin sister who died when she was a child, Claire begins receiving strange gifts signed with her sister's name. What at first seems like a cruel prank soon escalates into disturbing signs that someone is breaking into her home and trying to take control of Claire's life.

title: Blind Road
overview: Completed in 2019, this short film remained unreleased for years before finally premiering at various film festivals in 2025, where it screened to critical acclaim and won multiple awards. In 2026, it made its official broadcast debut on television and was released online for global audiences.  Driven by Dhaka's relentless traffic, a reckless motorcyclist dangerously rode onto a sidewalk, terrifying pedestrians and aggressively confronting a visually impaired man who was using the guided path. As an outraged crowd gathered to confront the illegal rider for his blatant disregard for safety and decency, the blind man remarkably stepped in to shield his aggressor. Ultimately, his unexpected act of grace transformed a moment of hostility into a powerful lesson in compassion.

title: Newton's 3rd Law
overview: Follows an investigation into a double murder in 1999, with unexpected characters roped into the case as they search for justice amid intrigue and secrets.

title: Backpack Thieves
overview: It's 4 PM at the Hollywood Reservoir... and there's a backpack thief on the loose. Tracking the thief through "Find My," two teenage boys chase him down to Compton, California.

title: The Soap Star Murder Mystery
overview: A soap star moves to the suburbs after a terrifying stalking incident. A shocking murder pulls her into a web of intrigue where no one can be trusted.

title: VILLAIN
overview: Home for winter break, Clyde asks his estranged brother, Sean, to reunite with the family for Christmas Eve dinner. The table is set, and still, no response.

title: Anthôman
overview: Gooré and Kalou maintain a deep friendship. The first is a talented drummer, while the second excels in the art of dance. One day, during a hunting trip, Gooré, through an unfortunate combination of circumstances, accidentally takes Kalou's life. Despite the negative result of the Zri, a traditional test supposed to establish the guilt or innocence of an individual and from which Gooré emerges unscathed, the villagers accuse him of having murdered his friend out of jealousy. Determined to clear his honor, Gooré then made a radical decision: he entered the Second World War. According to tradition, his return alive from the front would constitute irrefutable proof of his innocence.

title: Lovergurl
overview: A woman begins to loose her grip on reality after a one night stand

title: Wendy (Mao Remix)
overview: Official music video for “Wendy (Remix)”, the electronic reinterpretation of the Delta V track by Italian singer-songwriter Mao, released on 31 July 2026 as the closing chapter of the album “In fatti ostili RMX”. Mao’s remix holds the voice back for almost two minutes while the arrangement circles and expands, projecting the original songwriting into a nocturnal and rarefied space.  Directed by Brussels-born, Montreal-based filmmaker Nicolas Fransolet and shot entirely in Tokyo, the film has no protagonist and no narrative. It follows the city through a single arc of hours, from daylight into night, moving inside the flow of streets, stations and suburbs. The images are observed rather than staged: what appears on screen is what happened in front of the lens.  What emerges is the portrait of a place at once distant and familiar, where the vast scale of the metropolis and the smallness of individual gestures inhabit the same frame. Proximity and connection almost never coincide.

title: Verticals: The Movie
overview: When a young aspiring actor, Milo, arrives to his first acting job ever, he’s quickly hit by the realization that this isn’t just any film set…this is a vertical drama set. As he’s thrusted into the insane world of verticals, Milo navigates their absurdity with the question: is the chaos worth the pursuit of his lifelong dream?
